'use client'

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import {
  Search,
  Calendar,
  ClipboardList,
  Plus,
  Printer,
  Moon,
  Sun,
  Terminal,
  Atom,
  FlaskRound,
  X,
  Command,
  ArrowRight,
  AlertTriangle,
  GraduationCap,
  User,
  Monitor,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { useTheme } from 'next-themes'
import { MASTER_ROUTINE } from '@/lib/master-data'
import { useUserScope } from '@/hooks/use-user-scope'
import { useCommandPalette } from '@/hooks/use-command-palette'
import { useAcademicYear } from '@/lib/context/academic-year-context'

export default function CommandPalette() {
  const { isOpen, close, toggle } = useCommandPalette()
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('')
  const router = useRouter()
  const { setTheme, theme } = useTheme()
  const { scope: userScope, isTeacher } = useUserScope()
  const { systemActiveYearName } = useAcademicYear()

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault()
        toggle()
      }
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        close()
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)
  }, [toggle, close])

  if (!isOpen) return null

  const filteredRoutines = MASTER_ROUTINE.filter((item) => {
    if (!query) return false
    return (
      item.subjectCode.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||
      item.subjectTitle.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||
      item.teacher.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||
      item.grade.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||
      item.lab.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())
    )
  }).sort((a, b) => {
    if (!isTeacher || !userScope) return 0
    const teacherName = userScope.teacherProfile?.name || userScope.fullName || ''
    const aMine = a.teacher.toLowerCase().includes(teacherName.toLowerCase()) ? 1 : 0
    const bMine = b.teacher.toLowerCase().includes(teacherName.toLowerCase()) ? 1 : 0
    return bMine - aMine
  }).slice(0, 6)

  const handleSelect = (action: () => void) => {
    action()
    close()
    setQuery('')
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center pt-24 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
      <div
        className="w-full max-w-xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col transition-all font-mono"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Search Input Bar */}
        <div className="px-4 py-3.5 border-b border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center gap-3 bg-zinc-50/50 dark:bg-zinc-900/50">
          <Search className="h-4 w-4 text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={query}
            onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search sessions, faculty, or actions..."
            className="w-full bg-transparent text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus:outline-none"
            autoFocus
          />
          <kbd className="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-500 rounded border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700">
            ESC
          </kbd>
        </div>

        {/* Results / Command Items */}
        <div className="p-2 overflow-y-auto max-h-80 divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800/60 text-xs">
          {/* Quick Actions */}
          <div className="py-1">
            <div className="px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>System Operations</span>
              {isTeacher && userScope?.teacherProfile && (
                <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">
                  {userScope.teacherProfile.name}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={() => handleSelect(() => router.push('/records/new'))}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 transition-colors group text-left"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-zinc-500" />
                <span>Record New Practical Session</span>
              </div>
              <ArrowRight className="h-3 w-3 text-zinc-400 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity" />
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => handleSelect(() => router.push('/schedules'))}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 transition-colors group text-left"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <Calendar className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-zinc-500" />
                <span>ROUTINE // Master Schedule {systemActiveYearName}</span>
              </div>
              <ArrowRight className="h-3 w-3 text-zinc-400 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity" />
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => handleSelect(() => window.print())}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 transition-colors group text-left"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <Printer className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-zinc-500" />
                <span>PRINT // Daily Laboratory Register</span>
              </div>
              <ArrowRight className="h-3 w-3 text-zinc-400 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity" />
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => handleSelect(() => router.push('/computer-lab'))}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 transition-colors group text-left"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <Monitor className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-500" />
                <span>FLOOR PLAN // Computer Lab CAD Floor Plan &amp; Cockpit</span>
              </div>
              <ArrowRight className="h-3 w-3 text-zinc-400 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity" />
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => handleSelect(() => router.push('/incidents'))}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 transition-colors group text-left"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-rose-500" />
                <span>INCIDENT // Incident and Damage Workspace</span>
              </div>
              <ArrowRight className="h-3 w-3 text-zinc-400 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Search Results from Master Routine */}
          {filteredRoutines.length > 0 && (
            <div className="py-1">
              <div className="px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Matching Academic Sessions
              </div>

              {filteredRoutines.map((item) => (
                <button
                  key={item.id}
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(() => router.push('/schedules'))}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 transition-colors group text-left"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-400" />
                    <div>
                      <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                        {item.subjectCode}
                      </span>{' '}
                      — <span className="text-zinc-500">{item.subjectTitle}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
                    {item.day} • {item.timeSlot}
                  </span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Theme & System Controls */}
          <div className="py-1">
            <div className="px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
              System Environment
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={() => handleSelect(() => setTheme(theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'))}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 transition-colors group text-left"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                {theme === 'dark' ? (
                  <Sun className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-zinc-400" />
                ) : (
                  <Moon className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-zinc-400" />
                )}
                <span>THEME // Toggle Dark / Light</span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{theme?.toUpperCase()}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer Shortcut Guide */}
        <div className="px-4 py-2 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/60 border-t border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
          <span>Navigate with arrows, Enter to select</span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <Command className="h-3 w-3" /> + K
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react'
import {
  Calendar,
  Plus,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Loader2,
  RefreshCw,
  Clock,
  Sparkles,
  ShieldAlert,
  ShieldCheck,
  ArrowRight,
  Check,
  X,
  Edit3,
  Trash2,
  Lock,
  Info,
  FileText,
  Users,
  Monitor,
  LayoutGrid,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { NepaliDatePicker } from '@/components/ui/nepali-date-picker'
import {
  getAcademicYears,
  setCurrentAcademicYear,
  createAcademicYear,
  updateAcademicYearAction,
  checkAcademicYearDependenciesAction,
  deleteAcademicYearAction,
} from '@/app/actions/academic-years'
import type { AcademicYear, AcademicYearDependencyReport } from '@/lib/types/academic-years'

interface AcademicYearsManagerProps {
  isEditModeUnlocked: boolean
  triggerToast?: (msg: string) => void
}

export function AcademicYearsManager({
  isEditModeUnlocked,
  triggerToast,
}: AcademicYearsManagerProps) {
  const [academicYears, setAcademicYears] = useState<AcademicYear[]>([])
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true)
  const [actionLoadingId, setActionLoadingId] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // Create Modal State
  const [isCreateModalOpen, setIsCreateModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false)
  const [newYearId, setNewYearId] = useState<string>('')
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState<string>('')
  const [newStartDate, setNewStartDate] = useState<string>('')
  const [newEndDate, setNewEndDate] = useState<string>('')
  const [setAsCurrentOnCreate, setSetAsCurrentOnCreate] = useState<boolean>(false)
  const [isSubmittingCreate, setIsSubmittingCreate] = useState<boolean>(false)
  const [createError, setCreateError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // Edit Modal State
  const [isEditModalOpen, setIsEditModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false)
  const [editingYear, setEditingYear] = useState<AcademicYear | null>(null)
  const [editName, setEditName] = useState<string>('')
  const [editStartDate, setEditStartDate] = useState<string>('')
  const [editEndDate, setEditEndDate] = useState<string>('')
  const [isSubmittingEdit, setIsSubmittingEdit] = useState<boolean>(false)
  const [editError, setEditError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // Safe Delete Modal State
  const [isDeleteModalOpen, setIsDeleteModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false)
  const [deletingYear, setDeletingYear] = useState<AcademicYear | null>(null)
  const [dependencyReport, setDependencyReport] = useState<AcademicYearDependencyReport | null>(null)
  const [isCheckingDeps, setIsCheckingDeps] = useState<boolean>(false)
  const [isSubmittingDelete, setIsSubmittingDelete] = useState<boolean>(false)
  const [deleteError, setDeleteError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [deleteConfirmText, setDeleteConfirmText] = useState<string>('')

  const showToast = useCallback(
    (msg: string) => {
      if (triggerToast) {
        triggerToast(msg)
      } else {
        alert(msg)
      }
    },
    [triggerToast]
  )

  // Fetch Academic Years
  const fetchYears = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoading(true)
    try {
      const res = await getAcademicYears()
      if (res.success && res.data) {
        setAcademicYears(res.data)
      } else {
        setAcademicYears([])
        if (res.error) showToast(res.error)
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load academic years'
      console.error(msg)
      setAcademicYears([])
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }, [showToast])

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchYears()
  }, [fetchYears])

  // Active current year
  const activeYear = useMemo(() => {
    return academicYears.find((y) => y.is_current) || null
  }, [academicYears])

  // Handle Switch Active Year
  const handleSetActiveYear = async (targetYear: AcademicYear) => {
    if (!isEditModeUnlocked) {
      showToast('🔒 Precaution Active: Unlock "Admin Edit Mode" at the top to modify academic cycles.')
      return
    }

    if (targetYear.is_current) return

    setActionLoadingId(targetYear.id)
    try {
      const res = await setCurrentAcademicYear(targetYear.id)
      if (res.success) {
        showToast(`✅ Academic year switched to ${targetYear.name || targetYear.id}`)
        await fetchYears()
      } else {
        showToast(res.error || 'Failed to switch active academic year.')
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error'
      showToast(msg)
    } finally {
      setActionLoadingId(null)
    }
  }

  // Handle Create Submit
  const handleCreateSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setCreateError(null)

    if (!isEditModeUnlocked) {
      setCreateError('🔒 Precaution Active: Unlock "Admin Edit Mode" at the top before creating academic years.')
      return
    }

    const cleanId = newYearId.trim()
    const cleanName = newName.trim()

    if (!cleanId || !cleanName || !newStartDate || !newEndDate) {
      setCreateError('All fields (Year ID, Title, Start Date, End Date) are required.')
      return
    }

    setIsSubmittingCreate(true)
    try {
      const res = await createAcademicYear({
        id: cleanId,
        name: cleanName,
        start_date: newStartDate,
        end_date: newEndDate,
        is_current: setAsCurrentOnCreate,
      })

      if (res.success) {
        showToast(`🎉 Academic Year ${cleanName} created successfully.`)
        setIsCreateModalOpen(false)
        setNewYearId('')
        setNewName('')
        setNewStartDate('')
        setNewEndDate('')
        setSetAsCurrentOnCreate(false)
        await fetchYears()
      } else {
        setCreateError(res.error || 'Failed to create academic year.')
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error creating academic year'
      setCreateError(msg)
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingCreate(false)
    }
  }

  // Handle Open Edit Modal
  const handleOpenEditModal = (year: AcademicYear) => {
    if (!isEditModeUnlocked) {
      showToast('🔒 Precaution Active: Unlock "Admin Edit Mode" at the top before editing.')
      return
    }
    setEditingYear(year)
    setEditName(year.name)
    setEditStartDate(year.start_date ? year.start_date.split('T')[0] : '')
    setEditEndDate(year.end_date ? year.end_date.split('T')[0] : '')
    setEditError(null)
    setIsEditModalOpen(true)
  }

  // Handle Submit Edit
  const handleEditSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!editingYear) return

    if (!isEditModeUnlocked) {
      setEditError('🔒 Precaution Active: Unlock "Admin Edit Mode" at the top to modify academic cycles.')
      return
    }

    const cleanName = editName.trim()
    if (!cleanName || !editStartDate || !editEndDate) {
      setEditError('Display name, start date, and end date are required.')
      return
    }

    setIsSubmittingEdit(true)
    setEditError(null)
    try {
      const res = await updateAcademicYearAction({
        id: editingYear.id,
        name: cleanName,
        start_date: editStartDate,
        end_date: editEndDate,
      })

      if (res.success) {
        showToast(`✅ Academic Year ${cleanName} updated successfully.`)
        setIsEditModalOpen(false)
        setEditingYear(null)
        await fetchYears()
      } else {
        setEditError(res.error || 'Failed to update academic year.')
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error updating academic year'
      setEditError(msg)
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingEdit(false)
    }
  }

  // Handle Open Delete Modal with Real-time Pre-Flight Inspection
  const handleOpenDeleteModal = async (year: AcademicYear) => {
    if (!isEditModeUnlocked) {
      showToast('🔒 Precaution Active: Unlock "Admin Edit Mode" at the top before deleting.')
      return
    }
    setDeletingYear(year)
    setDependencyReport(null)
    setDeleteError(null)
    setDeleteConfirmText('')
    setIsDeleteModalOpen(true)
    setIsCheckingDeps(true)

    try {
      const res = await checkAcademicYearDependenciesAction(year.id)
      if (res.success && res.data) {
        setDependencyReport(res.data)
      } else {
        setDeleteError(res.error || 'Failed to inspect academic year dependencies.')
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Error inspecting dependencies'
      setDeleteError(msg)
    } finally {
      setIsCheckingDeps(false)
    }
  }

  // Handle Confirm Delete
  const handleDeleteSubmit = async () => {
    if (!deletingYear || !dependencyReport) return
    if (!isEditModeUnlocked) {
      setDeleteError('🔒 Precaution Active: Unlock "Admin Edit Mode" at the top before deleting.')
      return
    }
    if (!dependencyReport.canDelete) {
      setDeleteError('Deletion is strictly blocked to preserve historical operational records.')
      return
    }
    if (deleteConfirmText.trim() !== deletingYear.id.trim()) {
      setDeleteError(`Please type "${deletingYear.id}" exactly to confirm deletion.`)
      return
    }

    setIsSubmittingDelete(true)
    setDeleteError(null)
    try {
      const res = await deleteAcademicYearAction(deletingYear.id)
      if (res.success) {
        showToast(`🗑️ Academic Year ${deletingYear.name} permanently deleted.`)
        setIsDeleteModalOpen(false)
        setDeletingYear(null)
        setDependencyReport(null)
        await fetchYears()
      } else {
        setDeleteError(res.error || 'Failed to delete academic year.')
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error deleting academic year'
      setDeleteError(msg)
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingDelete(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Top Metric Header Row: Direct Grid, No Double Nesting */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        {/* Metric 1: Current Active Cycle */}
        <div className="glass-card p-3 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="h-9 w-9 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 dark:bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
              <Calendar className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Current Cycle</div>
              <div className="text-base font-extrabold font-heading text-zinc-900 dark:text-white tabular-nums">
                {activeYear ? activeYear.name : 'None Selected'}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          {activeYear && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20">
              <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse" />
              Active
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Metric 2: Total Defined Cycles */}
        <div className="glass-card p-3 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="h-9 w-9 rounded-xl bg-purple-500/10 dark:bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
              <Clock className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Total Cycles</div>
              <div className="text-base font-extrabold font-heading text-zinc-900 dark:text-white tabular-nums">
                {academicYears.length} Years
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-medium">B.S. Calendar</span>
        </div>

        {/* Metric 3: Safety Guard Status */}
        <div className="glass-card p-3 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div
              className={`h-9 w-9 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center font-bold ${
                isEditModeUnlocked
                  ? 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400'
                  : 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400'
              }`}
            >
              <ShieldAlert className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Precaution Guard</div>
              <div className="text-xs font-bold font-heading text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
                {isEditModeUnlocked ? 'Unlocked (Edit Mode)' : 'Precaution Active'}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <span
            className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
              isEditModeUnlocked
                ? 'bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400'
                : 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-slate-400'
            }`}
          >
            {isEditModeUnlocked ? 'Caution' : 'Locked'}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Academic Years Card */}
      <Card className="border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-2xs overflow-hidden">
        <CardHeader className="p-4 px-5 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:bg-zinc-900/40 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
              <Calendar className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-500" />
              <span>Academic Year Operational Cycles</span>
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
              Governs student enrollments, timetable schedules, and practical logbooks across the institution.
            </CardDescription>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={fetchYears}
              disabled={isLoading}
              className="p-2 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 text-slate-500 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white transition disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
              title="Refresh Academic Years"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${isLoading ? 'animate-spin text-indigo-500' : ''}`} />
            </button>

            <Button
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => {
                if (!isEditModeUnlocked) {
                  showToast('🔒 Precaution Active: Unlock "Admin Edit Mode" at the top to create a new academic year.')
                  return
                }
                setIsCreateModalOpen(true)
              }}
              className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm"
            >
              <Calendar className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>New Academic Year</span>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>

        <CardContent className="p-0">
          {isLoading ? (
            <div className="py-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 text-zinc-500 text-xs">
              <Loader2 className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin text-indigo-500" />
              <span>Loading institutional academic years...</span>
            </div>
          ) : academicYears.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-12 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500">
              No academic years registered yet. Click &quot;New Academic Year&quot; above to initialize.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
              {academicYears.map((year) => {
                const isCurrent = year.is_current
                const isActionLoading = actionLoadingId === year.id

                return (
                  <div
                    key={year.id}
                    className={`p-4 px-5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 transition-colors ${
                      isCurrent
                        ? 'bg-indigo-500/[0.03] dark:bg-indigo-500/[0.06]'
                        : 'hover:bg-zinc-50/50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/30'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* Left: Identity & Badges */}
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-3.5">
                      <div
                        className={`h-10 w-10 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center font-bold shrink-0 ${
                          isCurrent
                            ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-indigo-600/20'
                            : 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-400'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <Calendar className="h-5 w-5" />
                      </div>

                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <h4 className="text-sm font-extrabold font-heading text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
                            {year.name}
                          </h4>
                          <span className="text-[11px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-slate-500">
                            {year.id}
                          </span>

                          {isCurrent ? (
                            <Badge className="bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/20 text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5">
                              Current Active Cycle
                            </Badge>
                          ) : (
                            <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700">
                              Archived / Past
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                          <span>
                            Start: <strong className="text-zinc-700 dark:text-slate-200">{year.start_date}</strong>
                          </span>
                          <span>&bull;</span>
                          <span>
                            End: <strong className="text-zinc-700 dark:text-slate-200">{year.end_date}</strong>
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Right: Actions */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 self-end sm:self-center flex-wrap">
                      {isCurrent ? (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 text-xs font-bold">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          <span>Active Cycle</span>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <Button
                          size="sm"
                          variant="outline"
                          onClick={() => handleSetActiveYear(year)}
                          disabled={isActionLoading || !isEditModeUnlocked}
                          className="text-xs font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 hover:bg-indigo-600 hover:text-white hover:border-indigo-600 transition disabled:opacity-50"
                          title={
                            !isEditModeUnlocked
                              ? 'Unlock Precaution Active at the top to switch the active cycle'
                              : 'Set this academic year as the active operational cycle'
                          }
                        >
                          {isActionLoading ? (
                            <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                          ) : (
                            <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-500" />
                          )}
                          <span>Set as Active</span>
                        </Button>
                      )}

                      {/* Edit Button: Safe modification preserving immutable ID */}
                      <Button
                        size="sm"
                        variant="outline"
                        onClick={() => handleOpenEditModal(year)}
                        disabled={!isEditModeUnlocked}
                        className="text-xs font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 transition disabled:opacity-50"
                        title={
                          !isEditModeUnlocked
                            ? 'Unlock Precaution Active at the top to edit this academic year'
                            : 'Safely edit display title and date range without touching primary key ID'
                        }
                      >
                        <Edit3 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-500" />
                        <span>Edit</span>
                      </Button>

                      {/* Safe Delete Button: Omitted for active cycle */}
                      {!isCurrent && (
                        <Button
                          size="sm"
                          variant="outline"
                          onClick={() => handleOpenDeleteModal(year)}
                          disabled={!isEditModeUnlocked}
                          className="text-xs font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/30 hover:bg-rose-500/10 hover:border-rose-500/30 transition disabled:opacity-50"
                          title={
                            !isEditModeUnlocked
                              ? 'Unlock Precaution Active at the top to delete academic cycles'
                              : 'Safely check dependencies and delete empty/accidental cycle'
                          }
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-rose-500" />
                          <span>Delete</span>
                        </Button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Modal: New Academic Year */}
      {isCreateModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#101726] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] rounded-2xl w-full max-w-lg shadow-2xl">
            <div className="p-4 px-5 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-white/[0.08] flex items-center justify-between bg-zinc-50/60 dark:bg-white/[0.02]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="h-8 w-8 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
                  <Calendar className="h-4 w-4" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">New Academic Year</h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Initialize a new academic operational cycle</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsCreateModalOpen(false)}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/[0.06] transition"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleCreateSubmit} className="p-5 space-y-4">
              {createError && (
                <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 text-rose-500 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
                  <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                  <span>{createError}</span>
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Year ID / Code</label>
                  <Input
                    placeholder="e.g. 2084"
                    value={newYearId}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewYearId(e.target.value)}
                    className="text-xs h-9 rounded-xl border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#151E32]"
                    required
                  />
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Database primary key</span>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Display Label</label>
                  <Input
                    placeholder="e.g. 2084/85 B.S."
                    value={newName}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)}
                    className="text-xs h-9 rounded-xl border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#151E32]"
                    required
                  />
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Shown across UI</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Start Date (वि.सं.)</label>
                  <NepaliDatePicker
                    value={newStartDate}
                    onChange={(dateStr) => setNewStartDate(dateStr)}
                    placeholder="सुरु मिति / Start Date"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">End Date (वि.सं.)</label>
                  <NepaliDatePicker
                    value={newEndDate}
                    onChange={(dateStr) => setNewEndDate(dateStr)}
                    placeholder="अन्त्य मिति / End Date"
                    align="right"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#151E32] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.06] flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">Set as Active Year Immediately</div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">All daily rosters and schedules will switch to this cycle</div>
                </div>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={setAsCurrentOnCreate}
                  onChange={(e) => setSetAsCurrentOnCreate(e.target.checked)}
                  className="h-4 w-4 rounded accent-indigo-600 cursor-pointer"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-white/[0.06]">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setIsCreateModalOpen(false)}
                  className="text-xs rounded-xl"
                >
                  Cancel
                </Button>

                <Button
                  type="submit"
                  size="sm"
                  disabled={isSubmittingCreate}
                  className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm"
                >
                  {isSubmittingCreate ? (
                    <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  ) : (
                    <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                  )}
                  <span>Create Academic Year</span>
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Modal: Edit Academic Year */}
      {isEditModalOpen && editingYear && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#101726] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] rounded-2xl w-full max-w-lg shadow-2xl">
            <div className="p-4 px-5 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-white/[0.08] flex items-center justify-between bg-zinc-50/60 dark:bg-white/[0.02]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="h-8 w-8 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
                  <Edit3 className="h-4 w-4" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">Edit Academic Year</h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Update display name and operational date range</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsEditModalOpen(false)}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/[0.06] transition"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleEditSubmit} className="p-5 space-y-4">
              {editError && (
                <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 text-rose-500 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
                  <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                  <span>{editError}</span>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Data Integrity Protection Notice */}
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/[0.06] border border-indigo-500/20 text-xs text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 flex items-start gap-2.5">
                <Info className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                <div className="space-y-0.5">
                  <p className="font-bold">100% Relational Data Integrity Guaranteed</p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Primary Key ID (<span className="font-mono font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">{editingYear.id}</span>) is locked and immutable. All linked practical logs, student enrollments, and timetables remain completely unharmed.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <span>Year ID / Code</span>
                    <Lock className="h-3 w-3 text-slate-400" />
                  </label>
                  <Input
                    value={editingYear.id}
                    disabled
                    className="text-xs h-9 rounded-xl border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 font-mono text-slate-500 cursor-not-allowed"
                  />
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Primary Key (Locked)</span>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Display Label</label>
                  <Input
                    placeholder="e.g. 2083/84 B.S."
                    value={editName}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditName(e.target.value)}
                    className="text-xs h-9 rounded-xl border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#151E32]"
                    required
                  />
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Shown across all UI pages</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Start Date (वि.सं.)</label>
                  <NepaliDatePicker
                    value={editStartDate}
                    onChange={(dateStr) => setEditStartDate(dateStr)}
                    placeholder="सुरु मिति / Start Date"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">End Date (वि.सं.)</label>
                  <NepaliDatePicker
                    value={editEndDate}
                    onChange={(dateStr) => setEditEndDate(dateStr)}
                    placeholder="अन्त्य मिति / End Date"
                    align="right"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-white/[0.06]">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setIsEditModalOpen(false)}
                  className="text-xs rounded-xl"
                >
                  Cancel
                </Button>

                <Button
                  type="submit"
                  size="sm"
                  disabled={isSubmittingEdit}
                  className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm"
                >
                  {isSubmittingEdit ? (
                    <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  ) : (
                    <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                  )}
                  <span>Save Changes</span>
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Modal: Safe Academic Year Deletion & Pre-Flight Dependency Inspector */}
      {isDeleteModalOpen && deletingYear && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#101726] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] rounded-2xl w-full max-w-lg shadow-2xl">
            <div className="p-4 px-5 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-white/[0.08] flex items-center justify-between bg-zinc-50/60 dark:bg-white/[0.02]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="h-8 w-8 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
                  <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">Safe Academic Year Deletion</h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Pre-flight relational dependency & audit inspection</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsDeleteModalOpen(false)}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/[0.06] transition"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="p-5 space-y-4">
              {deleteError && (
                <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 text-rose-500 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
                  <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                  <span>{deleteError}</span>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Target Cycle Card */}
              <div className="glass-card p-3 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Target Academic Cycle</div>
                  <div className="text-sm font-extrabold font-heading text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
                    {deletingYear.name} <span className="font-mono text-xs font-normal text-slate-400">({deletingYear.id})</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs font-mono">
                  वि.सं. {deletingYear.id}
                </Badge>
              </div>

              {/* Dependency Inspection Telemetry */}
              {isCheckingDeps ? (
                <div className="py-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2.5 text-zinc-500 text-xs">
                  <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-indigo-500" />
                  <span className="font-medium">Inspecting relational databases across practical logs, enrollments, and timetables...</span>
                </div>
              ) : dependencyReport ? (
                <>
                  {!dependencyReport.canDelete ? (
                    /* CASE A: Deletion Blocked due to existing records (e.g. 1000 logs) */
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/25 flex items-start gap-3">
                        <ShieldAlert className="h-5 w-5 text-rose-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                        <div className="space-y-1">
                          <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400">
                            Deletion Strictly Blocked (NEB Compliance Lock)
                          </h4>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600/90 dark:text-rose-300 leading-relaxed">
                            {dependencyReport.blockReason}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* High Density Metric Breakdown */}
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                        <div className="glass-card p-2.5 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2.5">
                          <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-500" />
                          <div>
                            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Practical Logs</div>
                            <div className="font-extrabold font-heading tabular-nums text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
                              {dependencyReport.practicalLogsCount} Logs
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="glass-card p-2.5 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2.5">
                          <Users className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-500" />
                          <div>
                            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Student Enrollments</div>
                            <div className="font-extrabold font-heading tabular-nums text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
                              {dependencyReport.enrollmentsCount} Students
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="glass-card p-2.5 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2.5">
                          <Monitor className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-500" />
                          <div>
                            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Seat Assignments</div>
                            <div className="font-extrabold font-heading tabular-nums text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
                              {dependencyReport.seatPlansCount} Desks
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="glass-card p-2.5 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2.5">
                          <LayoutGrid className="h-4 w-4 text-purple-500" />
                          <div>
                            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Timetable Schedules</div>
                            <div className="font-extrabold font-heading tabular-nums text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
                              {dependencyReport.schedulesCount} Slots
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/40 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.06] text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        💡 <strong>Institutional Policy</strong>: Academic operational data is permanent. To protect historical NEB 75% attendance audits, completed years must remain preserved in archive mode.
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    /* CASE B: Safe Deletion Allowed (0 records detected, accidental year) */
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/25 flex items-start gap-3">
                        <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                        <div className="space-y-1">
                          <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">
                            Zero Operational Records Detected
                          </h4>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-600/90 dark:text-amber-300 leading-relaxed">
                            This academic cycle has 0 practical logs, 0 student enrollments, 0 seat plans, and 0 schedules. It is confirmed to be an empty or accidental creation.
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-1">
                        <label className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                          Confirm Deletion by Typing Year ID: <span className="font-mono text-zinc-900 dark:text-white font-bold">{deletingYear.id}</span>
                        </label>
                        <Input
                          placeholder={`Type "${deletingYear.id}" to confirm`}
                          value={deleteConfirmText}
                          onChange={(e) => setDeleteConfirmText(e.target.value)}
                          className="text-xs h-9 rounded-xl border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#151E32] font-mono"
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </>
              ) : null}

              {/* Action Buttons */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-white/[0.06]">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setIsDeleteModalOpen(false)}
                  className="text-xs rounded-xl"
                >
                  {dependencyReport && !dependencyReport.canDelete ? 'Understood — Keep Archived' : 'Cancel'}
                </Button>

                {dependencyReport && dependencyReport.canDelete && (
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    size="sm"
                    disabled={isSubmittingDelete || deleteConfirmText.trim() !== deletingYear.id.trim()}
                    onClick={handleDeleteSubmit}
                    className="bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {isSubmittingDelete ? (
                      <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                    ) : (
                      <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                    )}
                    <span>Permanently Delete Empty Cycle</span>
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function areWorkstationsMatching(
  a: WorkstationWithIssues[],
  b: WorkstationWithIssues[]
): boolean {
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false
  const bMap = new Map(b.map((w) => [w.id, w]))
  for (const wa of a) {
    const wb = bMap.get(wa.id)
    if (!wb) return false
    if (
      Math.abs(wa.pos_x - wb.pos_x) > 0.5 ||
      Math.abs(wa.pos_y - wb.pos_y) > 0.5 ||
      wa.label !== wb.label ||
      (wa.row_label || '') !== (wb.row_label || '') ||
      ((wa as any).position_id || '') !== ((wb as any).position_id || '')
    ) {
      return false
    }
  }
  return true
}

  }, [hasUnsavedChanges])

  // Add Extension Row to Expand Capacity (Strictly aligns with canonical wing column x-coordinates and 12% vertical row spacing)
  const handleAddExtensionRow = (side: 'left' | 'right' = 'left') => {
    if (!isEditModeUnlocked) return

    triggerLayoutModification()

    const sideIndex = side === 'left' ? 0 : 1
    const sideExistingExtSlots = addedGridSlots.filter((s) => s.sideIndex === sideIndex)
    const sideExtRowCount = Math.floor(sideExistingExtSlots.length / 4)
    const totalExtRows = Math.floor(addedGridSlots.length / 4)
    const rowLetter = String.fromCharCode(77 + totalExtRows) // 77 = 'M', N, O, P...
    const sideLabel = side === 'left' ? 'Left Wing' : 'Right Wing'
    const rowLabel = `Row ${rowLetter} (${sideLabel} Extension ${sideExtRowCount + 1})`

    // Canonical column alignment:
    // Left Wing: cols at 6%, 18%, 30%, 42% (xStart = 6, xStep = 12)
    // Right Wing: cols at 58%, 70%, 82%, 94% (xStart = 58, xStep = 12)
    const xStart = side === 'left' ? 6 : 58
    const xStep = 12
    // Vertical spacing strictly aligned with rows A..F / G..L (spacing 12%):
    // First extension row on this side is at 88 + 12 = 100%
    const yPos = snapCoordinate(100 + sideExtRowCount * 12, snapGrid)

    let maxPcNum = 48
    localWorkstations.forEach((w) => {
      const match = w.label.match(/\d+/)
      if (match) {
        const num = parseInt(match[0], 10)
        if (!isNaN(num) && num > maxPcNum) maxPcNum = num
      }
    })
    addedGridSlots.forEach((s) => {
      const match = s.suggestedHardwareLabel.match(/\d+/)
      if (match) {
        const num = parseInt(match[0], 10)
        if (!isNaN(num) && num > maxPcNum) maxPcNum = num
      }
    })

    const newSlots: CustomRoomGridSlot[] = Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, c) => {
      const col = c + 1
      const posId = `${rowLetter}${col}`
      const pcNum = maxPcNum + col
      return {
        slotIndex: canonicalGridSlots.length + addedGridSlots.length + c,
        sideIndex,
        rowIndex: 6 + sideExtRowCount,
        globalRowIndex: 6 + totalExtRows,
        colIndex: c,
        rowLabel,
        positionId: posId,
        suggestedHardwareLabel: `PC-${String(pcNum).padStart(2, '0')}`,
        suggestedLabel: posId,
        pos_x: snapCoordinate(xStart + c * xStep, snapGrid),
        pos_y: yPos,
      }
    })

    setAddedGridSlots((prev) => [...prev, ...newSlots])
    setSaveToast({
      text: `Added ${rowLabel} (+4 desk positions: ${rowLetter}1–${rowLetter}4).`,
      type: 'success',
    })
    setTimeout(() => setSaveToast(null), 3000)
  }

  // 4. Save Entire Layout (Enables updating Institutional Default with warning, or saving custom presets)
  const handleInitiateSaveLayout = () => {
    if (!isEditModeUnlocked) return

    if (selectedPreset === 'official_dual_wing' || selectedPreset === 'draft_custom') {
      let nextNum = 1
      savedTemplates.forEach((t) => {
        const m = t.name.match(/Custom(?:\s+Layout)?\s*(\d+)/i)
        if (m) {
          const n = parseInt(m[1], 10)
          if (!isNaN(n) && n >= nextNum) nextNum = n + 1
        }
      })
      setCustomPresetName(`Custom ${nextNum}`)
      setSaveLayoutMode('default_or_new')
      setIsSaveLayoutModalOpen(true)
    } else {
      // Currently on an existing custom layout template
      const tplId = selectedPreset.replace('tpl_', '')
      const currentTpl = savedTemplates.find((t) => t.id === tplId)
      let nextNum = 1
      savedTemplates.forEach((t) => {
        const m = t.name.match(/Custom(?:\s+Layout)?\s*(\d+)/i)
        if (m) {
          const n = parseInt(m[1], 10)
          if (!isNaN(n) && n >= nextNum) nextNum = n + 1
        }
      })
      setCustomPresetName(currentTpl ? `${currentTpl.name} (Copy)` : `Custom ${nextNum}`)
      setSaveLayoutMode('update_or_new')
      setIsSaveLayoutModalOpen(true)
    }
  }

  // Update Institutional Default layout in PostgreSQL baseline
  const handleConfirmUpdateInstitutionalDefault = async () => {
    setIsSaving(true)
    try {
      const wsUpdates = localWorkstations.map((w) => ({
        id: w.id,
        pos_x: w.pos_x,
        pos_y: w.pos_y,
        row_label: w.row_label || null,
        label: w.label,
        position_id: (w as any).position_id || null,
      }))
      const landmarkUpdates = localFloorElements.map((el) => ({
        id: el.id,
        lab_id: selectedLabId,
        element_type: el.element_type,
        label: el.label,
        pos_x: el.pos_x,
        pos_y: el.pos_y,
        width: el.width || 12.0,
        height: el.height || 4.0,
        rotation: (el.rotation || 0) as 0 | 90 | 180 | 270,
        is_active: el.is_active,
      }))

      const [wsRes, lmRes] = await Promise.all([
        batchUpdateWorkstationPositions(selectedLabId, wsUpdates),
        saveLabFloorElements(selectedLabId, landmarkUpdates),
      ])
      if (!wsRes.success) throw new Error(wsRes.error || 'Failed to save workstation positions.')
      if (!lmRes.success) throw new Error(lmRes.error || 'Failed to save floor landmarks.')

      // Synchronize in-memory boardData baseline
      setBoardData((prev) =>
        prev
          ? {
              ...prev,
              workstations: localWorkstations.map((w) => ({ ...w })),
            }
          : null
      )

      setSelectedPreset('official_dual_wing')
      setHasUnsavedChanges(false)
      setIsSaveLayoutModalOpen(false)
      setSaveToast({
        text: 'Institutional Default Layout updated successfully in database.',
        type: 'success',
      })
      setTimeout(() => setSaveToast(null), 3500)
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Save error'
      setSaveToast({ text: msg, type: 'error' })
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false)
    }
  }

  // Save new custom preset
  const handleConfirmSaveLayout = async (name: string) => {
    const trimmed = name.trim()
    if (!trimmed) return
    setIsSaving(true)
    try {
      const wsUpdates = localWorkstations.map((w) => ({
        id: w.id,
        pos_x: w.pos_x,
        pos_y: w.pos_y,
        row_label: w.row_label || null,
        label: w.label,
        position_id: (w as any).position_id || null,
      }))
      const landmarkUpdates = localFloorElements.map((el) => ({
        id: el.id,
        lab_id: selectedLabId,
        element_type: el.element_type,
        label: el.label,
        pos_x: el.pos_x,
        pos_y: el.pos_y,
        width: el.width || 12.0,
        height: el.height || 4.0,
        rotation: (el.rotation || 0) as 0 | 90 | 180 | 270,
        is_active: el.is_active,
      }))

      const config: CustomRoomGridConfig = {
        sides: customSides,
        rows: customRows,
        columns: customCols,
        rowNaming: 'letters',
        terminalNaming: 'preserve',
        positions: wsUpdates,
      }
      const tplRes = await saveCustomLayoutTemplate(selectedLabId, trimmed, config)
      if (!tplRes.success || !tplRes.template) {
        throw new Error(tplRes.error || 'Failed to save custom layout template.')
      }

      const [wsRes, lmRes] = await Promise.all([
        batchUpdateWorkstationPositions(selectedLabId, wsUpdates),
        saveLabFloorElements(selectedLabId, landmarkUpdates),
      ])
      if (!wsRes.success) throw new Error(wsRes.error || 'Failed to save workstation positions.')
      if (!lmRes.success) throw new Error(lmRes.error || 'Failed to save floor landmarks.')

      setSavedTemplates((prev) => [
        ...prev.filter((t) => t.id !== tplRes.template!.id),
        tplRes.template!,
      ])

      // Synchronize in-memory boardData baseline
      setBoardData((prev) =>
        prev
          ? {
              ...prev,
              workstations: localWorkstations.map((w) => ({ ...w })),
            }
          : null
      )

      setSelectedPreset(`tpl_${tplRes.template.id}`)
      setHasUnsavedChanges(false)
      setIsSaveLayoutModalOpen(false)
      setSaveToast({
        text: `Layout saved as "${trimmed}".`,
        type: 'success',
      })
      setTimeout(() => setSaveToast(null), 3000)
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Save error'
      setSaveToast({ text: msg, type: 'error' })
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false)
    }
  }

  // Update existing custom preset in place
  const handleConfirmUpdateExistingLayout = async () => {
    const tplId = selectedPreset.replace('tpl_', '')
    const currentTpl = savedTemplates.find((t) => t.id === tplId)
    if (!currentTpl) return
    await handleConfirmSaveLayout(currentTpl.name)
  }

  // 5. Discard / Revert Changes with confirmation
  const handleDiscardChanges = () => {
    if (hasUnsavedChanges) {
      const ok = window.confirm('Discard all unsaved layout modifications and revert to last saved state?')
      if (!ok) return
    }
    if (boardData) {
      setLocalWorkstations(boardData.workstations.map((w) => ({ ...w })))
    }
    setAddedGridSlots([])
    setHasUnsavedChanges(false)
    if (selectedPreset === 'draft_custom') {
      setSelectedPreset('official_dual_wing')
    }
    setSaveToast({ text: 'Changes discarded. Restored last saved layout.', type: 'success' })
    setTimeout(() => setSaveToast(null), 2500)
  }

  // Reload from database with confirmation
  const handleRefreshData = async () => {
    if (hasUnsavedChanges) {
      const ok = window.confirm('You have unsaved changes. Reloading from database will discard them. Continue?')
      if (!ok) return
    }
    await loadData()
    setAddedGridSlots([])
    setHasUnsavedChanges(false)
  }

  // 6. Inspector Actions
  const handleSelectWorkstation = (ws: WorkstationWithIssues) => {
    if (justDraggedRef.current) return
    setSelectedWs(ws)
    setSelectedLandmark(null)
    setIsDrawerOpen(true)
  }

  const handleSelectLandmark = (el: LabFloorElementRow) => {
    if (justDraggedRef.current) return
    setSelectedLandmark(el)
    setSelectedWs(null)
    setIsDrawerOpen(true)
  }

  const handleDrawerUpdateWorkstation = async (updated: {
    id: string
    label: string
    row_label?: string | null
    position_id?: string | null
    device_type: 'desktop' | 'aio' | 'laptop' | 'server'
    pos_x: number
    pos_y: number
  }): Promise<boolean> => {
    const res = await updateWorkstation({
      id: updated.id,
      label: updated.label,
      row_label: updated.row_label,
      position_id: updated.position_id,
      device_type: updated.device_type,
      pos_x: updated.pos_x,
      pos_y: updated.pos_y,
    })

    if (res.success && res.data) {
      setLocalWorkstations((prev) =>
        prev.map((item) =>
          item.id === updated.id
            ? {
                ...item,
                label: updated.label,
                row_label: updated.row_label || null,
                position_id: updated.position_id || null,
                device_type: updated.device_type,
                pos_x: updated.pos_x,
                pos_y: updated.pos_y,
              }
            : item
        )
      )
      setSelectedWs((prev) =>
        prev && prev.id === updated.id
          ? {
              ...prev,
              label: updated.label,
              row_label: updated.row_label || null,
              position_id: updated.position_id || null,
              device_type: updated.device_type,
              pos_x: updated.pos_x,
              pos_y: updated.pos_y,
            }
          : prev
      )
      triggerLayoutModification()
      return true
    }
    return false
  }

  const handleDrawerDeleteWorkstation = async (id: string) => {
    const res = await deleteWorkstation(id)
    if (res.success) {
      setLocalWorkstations((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== id))
      setSelectedWs(null)
      setIsDrawerOpen(false)
      triggerLayoutModification()
      setSaveToast({ text: `Workstation ${res.deletedLabel || id} deleted successfully.`, type: 'success' })
      setTimeout(() => setSaveToast(null), 3000)
    }
    return res
  }

  const handleDrawerUpdateLandmark = (updated: LabFloorElementRow) => {
    setLocalFloorElements((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) => (item.id === updated.id ? updated : item))
    )
    triggerLayoutModification()
  }

  const handleDrawerDeleteLandmark = async (id: string) => {
    const res = await deleteLabFloorElement(id)
    if (res.success) {
      setLocalFloorElements((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== id))
      setSelectedLandmark(null)
      setIsDrawerOpen(false)
      triggerLayoutModification()
    }
  }

  const handleDrawerRotateLandmark = (landmark: LabFloorElementRow) => {
    setLocalFloorElements((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) =>
        item.id === landmark.id
          ? { ...item, rotation: (((item.rotation || 0) + 90) % 360) as any }
          : item
      )
    )
    triggerLayoutModification()
  }

  // 7. Add Workstation
  const handleCreateWorkstation = async () => {
    if (!newWsLabel.trim() || !isEditModeUnlocked) return
    setIsCreatingWs(true)
    try {
      const res = await createWorkstation({
        lab_id: selectedLabId,
        label: newWsLabel.trim(),
        row_label: newWsRow.trim() || null,
        position_id: newWsPositionId.trim() || null,
        pos_x: newWsPos.x,
        pos_y: newWsPos.y,
        device_type: newWsDeviceType,
      })

      if (res.success && res.data) {
        const newStation: WorkstationWithIssues = {
          ...res.data,
          status: 'operational',
          open_issues_count: 0,
          highest_severity: null,
          active_issues: [],
        }
        setLocalWorkstations((prev) => [...prev, newStation])
        setIsAddWsModalOpen(false)
        setSelectedWs(newStation)
        setIsDrawerOpen(true)
        triggerLayoutModification()
        setSaveToast({
          text: `Workstation ${res.data.label} provisioned at ${res.data.row_label || res.data.position_id || 'selected location'}.`,
          type: 'success',
        })
        setTimeout(() => setSaveToast(null), 2500)
      } else {
        alert(res.error || 'Failed to create workstation.')
      }
    } finally {
      setIsCreatingWs(false)
    }
  }

  // 8. Add Landmark
  const handleCreateLandmark = async () => {
    if (!newLmLabel.trim() || !isEditModeUnlocked) return
    setIsCreatingLm(true)
    try {
      const newLm = {
        lab_id: selectedLabId,
        element_type: newLmType,
        label: newLmLabel.trim(),
        pos_x: 50,
        pos_y: 10,
        width: 16.0,
        height: 4.5,
        rotation: 0 as const,
        is_active: true,
      }
      const res = await saveLabFloorElements(selectedLabId, [newLm])
      if (res.success) {
        setIsAddLmModalOpen(false)
        await loadData()
        triggerLayoutModification()
        setSaveToast({ text: `Landmark "${newLm.label}" added to floor plan.`, type: 'success' })
        setTimeout(() => setSaveToast(null), 2500)
      } else {
        alert(res.error || 'Failed to add floor landmark.')
      }
    } finally {
      setIsCreatingLm(false)
    }
  }

  // 9. Apply Layout Preset (Official Institutional Layout or Saved Custom Presets)
  const handleApplyPreset = (presetKey: string) => {
    if (!isEditModeUnlocked) return

    if (presetKey.startsWith('tpl_')) {
      const tplId = presetKey.replace('tpl_', '')
      const template = savedTemplates.find((t) => t.id === tplId)
      if (template) {
        const calculated = calculateCustomRoomLayout(localWorkstations, template.config, snapGrid, true)
        const posMap = new Map(calculated.map((c) => [c.id, c]))

        setLocalWorkstations((prev) =>
          prev.map((w) => {
            const update = posMap.get(w.id)
            if (update) {
              return {
                ...w,
                pos_x: update.pos_x,
                pos_y: update.pos_y,
                row_label: update.row_label || w.row_label,
                label: update.label || w.label,
                position_id: update.position_id || (w as any).position_id,
              }
            }
            return w
          })
        )
        setAddedGridSlots([])
        setHasUnsavedChanges(true)
        setSaveToast({ text: `Applied custom preset: "${template.name}".`, type: 'success' })
        setTimeout(() => setSaveToast(null), 2500)
      }
      return
    }

    const calculated = calculateAutoArrangement(localWorkstations, presetKey as LayoutPresetType, snapGrid)
    const posMap = new Map(calculated.map((c) => [c.id, c]))

    setLocalWorkstations((prev) =>
      prev.map((w) => {
        const update = posMap.get(w.id)
        if (update) {
          return {
            ...w,
            pos_x: update.pos_x,
            pos_y: update.pos_y,
            row_label: update.row_label || w.row_label,
            position_id: update.position_id || (w as any).position_id,
          }
        }
        return w
      })
    )
    setAddedGridSlots([])
    setHasUnsavedChanges(true)
    setSaveToast({ text: 'Applied Official Institutional Layout (Dual-Wing · 48 PCs).', type: 'success' })
    setTimeout(() => setSaveToast(null), 2500)
  }

  // Restores canonical 48-PC dual-wing institutional standard
  const handleApplyDefaultCanonicalLayout = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isEditModeUnlocked) return
    if (hasUnsavedChanges) {
      const ok = window.confirm(
        'Discard unsaved layout modifications and restore Default Lab Layout (48 PCs)?'
      )
      if (!ok) return
    }
    const calculated = calculateAutoArrangement(localWorkstations, 'official_dual_wing', snapGrid)
    const posMap = new Map(calculated.map((c) => [c.id, c]))

    const updated = localWorkstations.map((w) => {
      const update = posMap.get(w.id)
      if (update) {
        return {
          ...w,
          pos_x: update.pos_x,
          pos_y: update.pos_y,
          row_label: update.row_label || w.row_label,
          position_id: update.position_id || (w as any).position_id,
        }
      }
      return w
    })

    setLocalWorkstations(updated)
    setAddedGridSlots([])
    setSelectedPreset('official_dual_wing')

    const matchesBaseline = boardData ? areWorkstationsMatching(updated, boardData.workstations) : false
    setHasUnsavedChanges(!matchesBaseline)

    setSaveToast({ text: 'Applied Default Lab Layout (Dual-Wing · 48 PCs).', type: 'success' })
    setTimeout(() => setSaveToast(null), 3000)
  }, [isEditModeUnlocked, hasUnsavedChanges, localWorkstations, snapGrid, boardData])

  // Preset Selection Change with Unsaved Changes Guard
  const handlePresetChange = (newKey: string) => {
    if (!isEditModeUnlocked) {
      setSaveToast({
        text: 'Precaution Active: Layout modifications require enabling Edit Mode at top of Admin Console.',
        type: 'error',
      })
      setTimeout(() => setSaveToast(null), 3200)
      return
    }

    if (newKey === 'official_dual_wing') {
      handleApplyDefaultCanonicalLayout()
      return
    }

    if (newKey === 'draft_custom') {
      setSelectedPreset('draft_custom')
      return
    }

    if (hasUnsavedChanges) {
      const ok = window.confirm(
        'You have unsaved layout modifications. Switching layouts will discard your unsaved changes. Continue?'
      )
      if (!ok) return
    }
    setSelectedPreset(newKey)
    handleApplyPreset(newKey)
  }

  // 10. Apply Streamlined Custom Grid Layout
  const handleApplyCustomGrid = async () => {
    if (!isEditModeUnlocked) return
    const config: CustomRoomGridConfig = {
      sides: customSides,
      rows: customRows,
      columns: customCols,
      rowNaming: 'letters',
      terminalNaming: 'preserve',
    }

    // Optional: Save as named custom preset if templateName is provided
    if (templateName.trim()) {
      try {
        const tplRes = await saveCustomLayoutTemplate(
          selectedLabId,
          templateName.trim(),
          config,
          templateDescription.trim() || undefined
        )
        if (tplRes.success && tplRes.template) {
          setSavedTemplates((prev) => [
            ...prev.filter((t) => t.id !== tplRes.template!.id),
            tplRes.template!,
          ])
          setSelectedPreset(`tpl_${tplRes.template.id}`)
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error saving template:', err)
      }
    }

    const calculated = calculateCustomRoomLayout(localWorkstations, config, snapGrid, true)
    const posMap = new Map(calculated.map((c) => [c.id, c]))

    setLocalWorkstations((prev) =>
      prev.map((w) => {
        const update = posMap.get(w.id)
        if (update) {
          return {
            ...w,
            pos_x: update.pos_x,
            pos_y: update.pos_y,
            row_label: update.row_label || w.row_label,
            label: update.label || w.label,
            position_id: update.position_id || (w as any).position_id,
          }
        }
        return w
      })
    )
    setAddedGridSlots([])
    triggerLayoutModification()
    setIsCustomGridModalOpen(false)
    setSaveToast({
      text: `Applied Custom Grid (${customSides} side${customSides > 1 ? 's' : ''} × ${customRows}R × ${customCols}C).`,
      type: 'success',
    })
    setTimeout(() => setSaveToast(null), 3000)
  }

  // Active preset metadata
  const activePresetInfo = LAYOUT_PRESETS.find((p) => p.id === selectedPreset)

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3 font-sans text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 relative">
      {/* ============================================================== */}
      {/* 1. TOP COMMAND & TOOLS BAR                                     */}
      {/* ============================================================== */}
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3 sm:p-4 rounded-2xl border border-indigo-500/30 bg-[#0B0F19] text-white shadow-xl">
        {/* Left Title & Status */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/30 shadow-xs">
            <Monitor className="h-4.5 w-4.5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <h3 className="font-heading font-extrabold text-sm text-white">
                CAD Floor Architect
              </h3>
              {hasUnsavedChanges && (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30 animate-pulse">
                  Unsaved Changes
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
              Spatial CAD design, hardware provisioning &amp; workstation calibration
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Center / Right Command Tools */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          {/* Add PC Button (Rule 1: No literal + in text) */}
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            disabled={!isEditModeUnlocked}
            onClick={handleOpenAddWsModal}
            className="h-8.5 px-3 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white gap-1.5 shadow-xs cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40"
            title="Provision a new workstation node in this lab"
          >
            <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>Add PC</span>
