          <Select
            value={statusFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="h-9 text-xs bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950 w-48 font-medium"
          >
            <option value="all">All Statuses ({users.length})</option>
            {pendingCount > 0 && (
              <option value="pending">⚠️ Pending Approvals ({pendingCount})</option>
            )}
            <option value="active">Active Accounts</option>
            <option value="deactivated">Deactivated</option>
          </Select>
        </div>

        <Button
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => setIsAddUserOpen(true)}
          className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-sans text-xs font-semibold gap-1.5 shadow-xs shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <UserPlus className="h-4 w-4" />
          <span>Add Teacher / Staff</span>
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* ⚠️ Pending Approvals Notice Banner */}
      {pendingCount > 0 && statusFilter !== 'pending' && (
        <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 animate-in fade-in">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
              <Clock className="h-5 w-5 animate-pulse" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="text-sm font-bold text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-200">
                {pendingCount} Staff Registration{pendingCount > 1 ? 's' : ''} Awaiting Your Approval
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs text-amber-800/80 dark:text-amber-300/80">
                New accounts have completed email OTP verification and need authorization before login access is granted.
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setStatusFilter('pending')}
            className="bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white font-sans text-xs font-semibold gap-1.5 shrink-0 cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
          >
            <span>Review Pending ({pendingCount})</span>
            <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 2. Main Users Table */}
      <Card className="border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-2xs overflow-hidden">
        <CardHeader className="p-4 px-5 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:bg-zinc-900/40 flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-950 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <Users className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-500" />
              Teacher & Staff Directory
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription className="text-xs text-subtext font-sans mt-0.5">
              Showing {filteredUsers.length} of {users.length} accounts
            </CardDescription>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={loadUsers}
            className="text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="h-3 w-3" />
            <span>Refresh</span>
          </button>
        </CardHeader>

        <CardContent className="p-0 overflow-x-auto">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="p-12 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 font-sans">
              Loading staff accounts...
            </div>
          ) : filteredUsers.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-12 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 font-sans">
              No staff accounts match the filter criteria.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-sans border-collapse">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/80 dark:bg-zinc-900/80 text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11.5px]">
                  <th className="py-3 px-4">Staff Member & Email</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4">Contact Phone</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4">Institutional Role</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4">Access Status</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800/60">
                {filteredUsers.map((u) => {
                  const initials = u.full_name
                    .split(' ')
                    .map((n) => n[0])
                    .slice(0, 2)
                    .join('')
                    .toUpperCase()

                  const isSuperAdmin = u.role === 'super_admin'
                  const isIncharge = u.role === 'lab_incharge'
                  const isHOD = u.role === 'hod'

                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={u.id}
                      onClick={() => setSelectedDrawerUser(u)}
                      className="hover:bg-zinc-50/80 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40 transition-colors cursor-pointer group"
                    >
                      {/* Name & Email */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-4">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <div
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              if (!isEditModeUnlocked) return
                              e.stopPropagation()
                              setTargetPhotoUser(u)
                              staffPhotoInputRef.current?.click()
                            }}
                            title={isEditModeUnlocked ? 'Click to change profile picture' : undefined}
                            className="relative h-8.5 w-8.5 rounded-xl overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold shrink-0 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-700/80 group/avatar cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            {u.photo_url || u.avatar_url ? (
                              <img
                                src={u.photo_url || u.avatar_url!}
                                alt={u.full_name}
                                className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                              />
                            ) : (
                              initials
                            )}
                            {isEditModeUnlocked && (
                              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 opacity-0 group-hover/avatar:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex items-center justify-center text-white">
                                <Camera className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <div className="admin-type-primary-label text-zinc-950 dark:text-white group-hover:text-indigo-600 dark:group-hover:text-indigo-400 transition-colors">
                              {u.full_name}
                            </div>
                            <span className="admin-type-subtext block mt-0.5">
                              {u.email || 'No email registered'}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      {/* Phone */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-4">
                        {u.phone ? (
                          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-medium text-xs">
                            <Phone className="h-3 w-3 text-zinc-400" />
                            {u.phone}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-zinc-400 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono text-xs">—</span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* Role Badge - Pure Category Semantic (Neutral) */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-4">
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-medium bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-700/80">
                          {isSuperAdmin && (
                            <Shield className="h-3 w-3 mr-1 text-zinc-500 shrink-0" />
                          )}
                          {u.role === 'super_admin'
                            ? 'Super Admin'
                            : u.role === 'lab_incharge'
                            ? 'Lab Incharge'
                            : u.role === 'hod'
                            ? 'HOD'
                            : 'Teacher'}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      {/* Access Status */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-4" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                        {u.approval_status === 'pending' ? (
                          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800">
                            <Clock className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-amber-500 animate-pulse" />
                            <span>Pending Review</span>
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            disabled={!isEditModeUnlocked}
                            onClick={() => handleToggleStatus(u)}
                            className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all border cursor-pointer ${
                              u.is_active
                                ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800'
                                : 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800'
                            }`}
                            title={
                              isEditModeUnlocked
                                ? u.is_active
                                  ? 'Click to deactivate login access'
                                  : 'Click to activate login access'
                                : 'Unlock Admin Edit Mode to toggle'
                            }
                          >
                            {u.is_active ? (
                              <>
                                <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
                                <span>Active</span>
                              </>
                            ) : (
                              <>
                                <AlertCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-rose-500" />
                                <span>Deactivated</span>
                              </>
                            )}
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* Admin Actions */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                          {u.approval_status === 'pending' ? (
                            <>
                              <Button
                                size="sm"
                                disabled={!isEditModeUnlocked}
                                onClick={() => handleApproveUser(u)}
                                className="h-7 px-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-sans text-xs font-bold gap-1 shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
                                title="Approve and activate account"
                              >
                                <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                                <span>Approve</span>
                              </Button>
                              <Button
                                size="sm"
                                variant="outline"
                                disabled={!isEditModeUnlocked}
                                onClick={() => handleRejectUser(u)}
                                className="h-7 px-2 text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/30 text-xs font-semibold gap-1 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 cursor-pointer"
                                title="Reject application"
                              >
                                <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                                <span>Reject</span>
                              </Button>
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <>
                              {/* Edit Credentials */}
                              <Button
                                size="sm"
                                variant="ghost"
                                onClick={() => {
                                  setEditingUser(u)
                                  setEditFullName(u.full_name)
                                  setEditEmail(u.email || '')
                                  setEditPhone(u.phone || '')
                                  setEditRole(u.role)
                                  setEditPhotoUrl(u.photo_url || u.avatar_url || null)
                                  setEditPassword('')
                                }}
                                className="h-7 w-7 p-0 text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 cursor-pointer"
                                title="Edit Credentials & Password"
                              >
                                <Key className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                              </Button>

                              {/* Permissions Matrix */}
                              <Button
                                size="sm"
                                variant="ghost"
                                onClick={() => {
                                  setPermissionUser(u)
                                  setActivePerms(u.custom_permissions || DEFAULT_ROLE_PERMISSIONS[u.role] || {})
                                }}
                                className="h-7 w-7 p-0 text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 cursor-pointer"
                                title="Customize Feature Permissions"
                              >
                                <Sliders className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                              </Button>

                              {/* Delete Account (Native disabled + tooltip wrapping) */}
                              <span
                                title={
                                  !isEditModeUnlocked
                                    ? 'Unlock edit mode to delete accounts'
                                    : u.role === 'super_admin'
                                    ? 'Super Admin accounts cannot be deleted'
                                    : 'Delete staff account'
                                }
                              >
                                <Button
                                  size="sm"
                                  variant="ghost"
                                  disabled={!isEditModeUnlocked || u.role === 'super_admin'}
                                  onClick={() => {
                                    if (!isEditModeUnlocked) return
                                    setUserToDelete(u)
                                  }}
                                  className="h-7 w-7 p-0 text-zinc-400 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed cursor-pointer"
                                >
                                  <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                                </Button>
                              </span>
                            </>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* 📁 SLIDE-OVER ACCOUNT DETAILS DRAWER */}
      {mounted && selectedDrawerUser && createPortal(
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex justify-end animate-in fade-in duration-200 select-none">
          <div className="w-full max-w-md bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 h-full shadow-2xl border-l border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex flex-col animate-in slide-in-from-right duration-300">
            {/* Drawer Header */}
            <div className="p-5 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-zinc-50/70 dark:bg-zinc-950/60">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <User className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-500" />
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-950 dark:text-white">
                  Staff Account Profile
                </h3>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedDrawerUser(null)}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors"
              >
                <X className="h-5 w-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Drawer Body */}
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6 space-y-6 font-sans">
              {/* Profile Card */}
              <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800 text-center space-y-2.5">
                <div className="relative group/drawer-avatar mx-auto w-16 h-16">
                  <div className="h-16 w-16 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-tr from-indigo-500 to-purple-600 text-white font-bold text-xl flex items-center justify-center shadow-md border-2 border-white/20 dark:border-zinc-700">
                    {selectedDrawerUser.photo_url || selectedDrawerUser.avatar_url ? (
                      <img
                        src={selectedDrawerUser.photo_url || selectedDrawerUser.avatar_url!}
                        alt={selectedDrawerUser.full_name}
                        className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                      />
                    ) : (
                      selectedDrawerUser.full_name.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()
                    )}
                  </div>
                  {isEditModeUnlocked && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={isUploadingPhoto}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setTargetPhotoUser(selectedDrawerUser)
                        staffPhotoInputRef.current?.click()
                      }}
                      title="Upload or Change Profile Photo"
                      className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 p-1.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-md hover:bg-indigo-700 transition-transform hover:scale-110 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      {isUploadingPhoto && targetPhotoUser?.id === selectedDrawerUser.id ? (
                        <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" />
                      ) : (
                        <Camera className="h-3 w-3" />
                      )}
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>

                {isEditModeUnlocked && (selectedDrawerUser.photo_url || selectedDrawerUser.avatar_url) && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleRemoveStaffPhoto(selectedDrawerUser)}
                    className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 hover:text-rose-500 transition-colors font-mono cursor-pointer block mx-auto"
                  >
                    Remove Photo
                  </button>
                )}

                <div>
                  <h4 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-950 dark:text-white">
                    {selectedDrawerUser.full_name}
                  </h4>
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/20 inline-block mt-1 uppercase">
                    {selectedDrawerUser.role.replace('_', ' ')}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Contact & Identity Details */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <h5 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400 font-mono">
                  Account Credentials & Contact
                </h5>
                <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800 space-y-2.5 text-xs">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-zinc-500 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <Mail className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-zinc-400" />
                      Email Address
                    </span>
                    <strong className="text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                      {selectedDrawerUser.email}
                    </strong>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-zinc-500 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <Phone className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-zinc-400" />
                      Phone Number
                    </span>
                    <strong className="text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 font-mono">
                      {selectedDrawerUser.phone || 'Not Assigned'}
                    </strong>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-zinc-500 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <Calendar className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-zinc-400" />
                      Account Status
                    </span>
                    <span
                      className={`px-2 py-0.2 rounded-md text-[11px] font-bold ${
                        selectedDrawerUser.is_active
                          ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-600'
                          : 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 text-rose-600'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {selectedDrawerUser.is_active ? 'Active' : 'Deactivated'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Permissions Checklist */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <h5 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400 font-mono">
                    Privileges & Access Checklist
                  </h5>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={!isEditModeUnlocked}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setPermissionUser(selectedDrawerUser)
                      setActivePerms(
                        selectedDrawerUser.custom_permissions ||
                          DEFAULT_ROLE_PERMISSIONS[selectedDrawerUser.role] ||
                          {}
                      )
                    }}
                    className="text-xs text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-semibold hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Adjust
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800 space-y-2 text-xs">
                  {Object.entries({
                    can_view_logs: 'View Practical Logs Register',
                    can_create_logs: 'Create & Endorse Practical Logs',
                    can_delete_logs: 'Delete Certified Logs',
                    can_view_incidents: 'View Incident & Damage Registry',
                    can_report_incidents: 'Report Incident & Equipment Damage',
                    can_manage_incidents: 'Manage Repairs & Resolutions',
                    can_manage_schedules: 'Edit Master Timetable Schedules',
                    can_manage_maintenance: 'Manage Lab Maintenance & PC Servicing',
                    can_access_admin: 'Access Super Admin Control Center',
                  }).map(([key, label]) => {
                    const effective = getEffectivePermissions(selectedDrawerUser)
                    const allowed = !!effective[key]

                    return (
                      <div key={key} className="flex items-center justify-between py-1">
                        <span className="text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">{label}</span>
                        {allowed ? (
                          <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                            <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                            Allowed
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-400">
                            <XCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-zinc-400" />
                            Restricted
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Drawer Footer Actions */}
            <div className="p-4 px-6 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/70 dark:bg-zinc-950/60 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                disabled={!isEditModeUnlocked}
                onClick={() => {
                  setEditingUser(selectedDrawerUser)
                  setEditFullName(selectedDrawerUser.full_name)
                  setEditEmail(selectedDrawerUser.email || '')
                  setEditPhone(selectedDrawerUser.phone || '')
                  setEditPassword('')
                  setEditRole(selectedDrawerUser.role)
                  setEditPhotoUrl(selectedDrawerUser.photo_url || selectedDrawerUser.avatar_url || null)
                }}
                className="text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                <Key className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1" />
                Change Password / Role
              </Button>

              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                disabled={!isEditModeUnlocked || selectedDrawerUser.role === 'super_admin'}
                onClick={() => handleToggleStatus(selectedDrawerUser)}
                className="text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                {selectedDrawerUser.is_active ? 'Deactivate' : 'Activate'}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>,
        document.body
      )}

      {/* MODAL 1: Add User Account */}
      {isAddUserOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-150 select-none">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl max-w-md w-full p-6 space-y-4 font-sans animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 pb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <UserPlus className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-500" />
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-950 dark:text-white">
                  Add Faculty / Teacher Account
                </h3>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsAddUserOpen(false)}
                className="text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 text-xs cursor-pointer"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleCreateUser} className="space-y-3 text-xs">
              {/* Optional Photo Attachment */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/40 border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800">
                <div className="h-12 w-12 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700 flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-500 shrink-0 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600">
                  {newPhotoUrl ? (
                    <img src={newPhotoUrl} alt="Preview" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
                  ) : (
                    <User className="h-6 w-6 text-zinc-400" />
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1 space-y-1">
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 block">
                    Profile Picture (Optional)
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"
                      onClick={() => newStaffPhotoInputRef.current?.click()}
                      className="h-7 text-[11px] font-medium"
                    >
                      <Camera className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                      {newPhotoUrl ? 'Change Photo' : 'Upload Photo'}
                    </Button>

export function FacultyActivityTab() {

    totalSessionsLogged > 0

'use client'

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import {
  Users,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Download,
  Printer,
  Search,
  Loader2,
  FileSpreadsheet,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { Select } from '@/components/ui/select'
import {
  getStudentBoardComplianceReport,
  exportStudentBoardComplianceAction,
} from '@/app/actions/institutional-reports'
import type { StudentComplianceReport } from '@/lib/types/institutional-reports'

interface StudentComplianceTabProps {
  classes: Array<{ id: string; name: string }>
  academicYears: Array<{ id: string; name: string }>
}

export function StudentComplianceTab({ classes, academicYears }: StudentComplianceTabProps) {
  const [selectedClassId, setSelectedClassId] = useState<string>(classes[0]?.id || '12eng')
  const [selectedYearId, setSelectedYearId] = useState<string>(academicYears[0]?.id || '2083')
  const [report, setReport] = useState<StudentComplianceReport | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('')
  const [filterEligible, setFilterEligible] = useState<'all' | 'eligible' | 'barred'>('all')
  const [exportingExcel, setExportingExcel] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    setLoading(true)
    getStudentBoardComplianceReport({
      academicYearId: selectedYearId,
      classId: selectedClassId,
    })
      .then((res) => {
        if (res.success && res.data) setReport(res.data)
      })
      .finally(() => setLoading(false))
  }, [selectedClassId, selectedYearId])

  // Filter records
  const filteredRecords = (report?.records || []).filter((r) => {
    const matchesSearch =
      r.full_name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      r.roll_number.toString().includes(searchQuery) ||
      (r.registration_no && r.registration_no.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()))

    if (!matchesSearch) return false

    if (filterEligible === 'eligible') return r.is_eligible
    if (filterEligible === 'barred') return !r.is_eligible
    return true
  })

  // Export to CSV
  const handleExportCSV = () => {
    if (!report) return
    const headers = [
      'Roll No',
      'Registration No',
      'Student Name',
      'Sessions Held',
      'Sessions Attended',
      'Absent Count',
      'Attendance Rate (%)',
      'NEB Exam Eligibility',
    ]
    const rows = filteredRecords.map((r) => [
      r.roll_number,
      r.registration_no || '—',
      `"${r.full_name}"`,
      r.sessions_held,
      r.sessions_attended,
      r.absent_count,
      `${r.attendance_rate_pct}%`,
      r.is_eligible ? 'Eligible' : 'Barred (Below 75%)',
    ])

    const csvContent = [headers.join(','), ...rows.map((row) => row.join(','))].join('\n')
    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' })
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
    const link = document.createElement('a')
    link.href = url
    link.setAttribute('download', `NEB_Compliance_${report.class_name}_${report.academic_year_name}.csv`)
    document.body.appendChild(link)
    link.click()
    document.body.removeChild(link)
  }

  // Export to Excel (.xlsx)
  const handleExportExcel = async () => {
    if (!report) return
    setExportingExcel(true)
    try {
      const res = await exportStudentBoardComplianceAction({
        academicYearId: selectedYearId,
        classId: selectedClassId,
      })
      if (res.success && res.base64) {
        const byteCharacters = atob(res.base64)
        const byteNumbers = new Array(byteCharacters.length)
        for (let i = 0; i < byteCharacters.length; i++) {
          byteNumbers[i] = byteCharacters.charCodeAt(i)
        }
        const byteArray = new Uint8Array(byteNumbers)
        const blob = new Blob([byteArray], {
          type: res.contentType || 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
        })
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
        const a = document.createElement('a')
        a.href = url
        a.download = res.filename || `NEB_Compliance_${report.class_name}.xlsx`
        document.body.appendChild(a)
        a.click()
        document.body.removeChild(a)
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to export Excel:', err)
    } finally {
      setExportingExcel(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 font-sans text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
      {/* Filter Strip */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#101726] border border-white/[0.08] shadow-sm">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300">
            <Users className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-400" />
            <span>Class:</span>
          </div>
          <Select
            value={selectedClassId}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedClassId(e.target.value)}
            className="h-8.5 text-xs bg-[#151E32] border-white/10 text-white rounded-xl min-w-[160px]"
          >
            {classes.map((c) => (
              <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                {c.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </Select>

          {academicYears.length > 0 && (
            <Select
              value={selectedYearId}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedYearId(e.target.value)}
              className="h-8.5 text-xs bg-[#151E32] border-white/10 text-white rounded-xl min-w-[120px]"
            >
              {academicYears.map((y) => (
                <option key={y.id} value={y.id}>
                  {y.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </Select>
          )}

          {/* Eligibility Filter Pills */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 p-0.5 rounded-lg bg-[#151E32] border border-white/5 text-[11px]">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFilterEligible('all')}
              className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md transition-colors ${
                filterEligible === 'all' ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              All ({report?.total_students || 0})
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFilterEligible('eligible')}
              className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md transition-colors ${
                filterEligible === 'eligible'
                  ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white font-bold'
                  : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-emerald-400'
              }`}
            >
              Eligible ({report?.eligible_students || 0})
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFilterEligible('barred')}
              className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md transition-colors ${
                filterEligible === 'barred'
                  ? 'bg-rose-600 text-white font-bold'
                  : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-400'
              }`}
            >
              Barred ({report?.barred_students || 0})
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Search & Export Actions */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-2.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search student or roll..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              className="h-8.5 pl-8 pr-3 text-xs rounded-xl bg-[#151E32] border border-white/10 text-white placeholder:text-slate-500 w-44 sm:w-52"
            />
          </div>

          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleExportCSV}
            disabled={!report || report.records.length === 0}
            className="h-8.5 px-3 text-xs rounded-xl border-white/10 text-slate-200 hover:bg-white/5 gap-1.5"
          >
            <Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-400" />
            <span>CSV</span>
          </Button>

          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleExportExcel}

            className="h-8.5 px-3 text-xs rounded-xl border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-500/10 gap-1.5"

function AcademicCalendarModalContent({
  onClose,
  initialDate,
}: {
  onClose: () => void
  initialDate: Date
}) {
  const { holidays: customHolidays } = useInfrastructureState()
  const { sundayWeekend, saturdayWeekend } = useCalendarSettings()
  const allHolidays = useMemo(() => {
    const list = [...DEFAULT_HOLIDAYS]
    if (Array.isArray(customHolidays)) {
      customHolidays.forEach((ch) => {
        if (!list.some((h) => h.id === ch.id || h.dateStr === ch.dateStr)) {
          list.push(ch)
        }
      })
    }
    return list
  }, [customHolidays])

  const todayInfo = useMemo(() => getNepaliDate(new Date()), [])
  const [currentBsYear, setCurrentBsYear] = useState<number>(todayInfo.bsYear || 2083)
  const [currentBsMonth, setCurrentBsMonth] = useState<number>(todayInfo.bsMonth || 5)
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'calendar' | 'directory'>('calendar')

  // Selected Day State
  const [selectedDay, setSelectedDay] = useState<BsCalendarDay | null>(null)

  // Current Month Data
  const monthData = useMemo(() => {
    return getBsMonthCalendar(currentBsYear, currentBsMonth)
  }, [currentBsYear, currentBsMonth])

  // Filter holidays for the selected BS Year (Deduplicated by ID)
  const yearHolidays = useMemo(() => {
    const npYearDigits = toNepaliDigits(currentBsYear)
    const enYearStr = currentBsYear.toString()
    const seenIds = new Set<string>()

    return allHolidays
      .filter((h) => {
        if (!h || !h.id || seenIds.has(h.id)) return false
        seenIds.add(h.id)

        if (h.bsDateStr) {
          if (h.bsDateStr.includes(npYearDigits) || h.bsDateStr.includes(enYearStr)) {
            return true
          }
        }
        try {
          const np = getNepaliDate(new Date(h.dateStr))
          return np.bsYear === currentBsYear
        } catch (e) {
          return false
        }
      })
      .sort((a, b) => a.dateStr.localeCompare(b.dateStr))
  }, [allHolidays, currentBsYear])

  // Navigation handlers
  const handlePrevMonth = () => {
    if (currentBsMonth === 1) {
      setCurrentBsYear((y) => y - 1)
      setCurrentBsMonth(12)
    } else {
      setCurrentBsMonth((m) => m - 1)
    }
    setSelectedDay(null)
  }

  const handleNextMonth = () => {
    if (currentBsMonth === 12) {
      setCurrentBsYear((y) => y + 1)
      setCurrentBsMonth(1)
    } else {
      setCurrentBsMonth((m) => m + 1)
    }
    setSelectedDay(null)
  }

  const handleResetToday = () => {
    setCurrentBsYear(todayInfo.bsYear || 2083)
    setCurrentBsMonth(todayInfo.bsMonth || 5)
    setSelectedDay(null)
  }

  const jumpToHolidayMonth = (h: HolidayItem) => {
    const parts = h.dateStr.split('-')
    const adYear = parseInt(parts[0], 10)
    const adMonth = parseInt(parts[1], 10) - 1
    const adDay = parseInt(parts[2], 10)
    const d = new Date(Date.UTC(adYear, adMonth, adDay))
    const np = getNepaliDate(d)
    setCurrentBsYear(np.bsYear)
    setCurrentBsMonth(np.bsMonth)
    setActiveTab('calendar')

    const targetDay = monthData.days.find((d) => d.dateStr === h.dateStr)
    if (targetDay) {
      setSelectedDay(targetDay)
    }
  }

  const selectedHoliday = selectedDay
    ? allHolidays.find((h) => isDateWithinHoliday(selectedDay.dateStr, h))
    : null

  const isTodaySelected = selectedDay && selectedDay.dateStr === getNepalDateStr(new Date())

  const isSelectedSaturday = Boolean(selectedDay && selectedDay.dayOfWeek === 6 && saturdayWeekend)
  const isSelectedSunday = Boolean(selectedDay && selectedDay.dayOfWeek === 0 && sundayWeekend)
  const isSelectedWeekend = isSelectedSaturday || isSelectedSunday

  const WEEK_DAYS = useMemo(
    () => [
      { id: 0, labelNp: 'आइत', labelEn: 'Sun', isWeekend: sundayWeekend },
      { id: 1, labelNp: 'सोम', labelEn: 'Mon' },

      { id: 3, labelNp: 'बुध', labelEn: 'Wed' },
      { id: 4, labelNp: 'बिही', labelEn: 'Thu' },
      { id: 5, labelNp: 'शुक्र', labelEn: 'Fri' },
      { id: 6, labelNp: 'शनि', labelEn: 'Sat', isWeekend: saturdayWeekend },
    ],
    [sundayWeekend, saturdayWeekend]
  )

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-5 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div
        className="bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-200"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-zinc-50/50 dark:bg-zinc-950/40">

            <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">
              <CalendarIcon className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black tracking-tight text-zinc-950 dark:text-white">
                  Academic & National Holidays Calendar
                </h2>

'use client'

import React, { useRef, useCallback } from 'react'
import { X, Compass } from 'lucide-react'
import type { WorkstationWithIssues } from '@/types/workstations'

interface CanvasMinimapRadarProps {
  workstations: Array<WorkstationWithIssues & { isPresent?: boolean | null }>
  zoom: number
  pan: { x: number; y: number }
  containerWidth: number
  containerHeight: number
  onPanChange: (newPan: { x: number; y: number }) => void
  onClose: () => void
}

export function CanvasMinimapRadar({
  workstations,
  zoom,
  pan,
  containerWidth,
  containerHeight,
  onPanChange,
  onClose,
}: CanvasMinimapRadarProps) {
  const radarRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)

  // Minimap dimensions: 176px x 99px (16:9 ratio)
  const mapW = 176
  const mapH = 99

  // In the main canvas:
  // Visible viewport in canvas coordinates:
  // X range: -pan.x / zoom to (-pan.x + containerWidth) / zoom
  // Y range: -pan.y / zoom to (-pan.y + containerHeight) / zoom
  // The full canvas has width `containerWidth` and height `containerHeight`
  const boxW = Math.min(mapW, Math.max(16, (containerWidth / (containerWidth * zoom)) * mapW))
  const boxH = Math.min(mapH, Math.max(12, (containerHeight / (containerHeight * zoom)) * mapH))

  // Box position in minimap coordinates:
  const boxX = Math.max(0, Math.min(mapW - boxW, ((-pan.x / (containerWidth * zoom)) * mapW)))
  const boxY = Math.max(0, Math.min(mapH - boxH, ((-pan.y / (containerHeight * zoom)) * mapH)))

  // Click on minimap to jump pan
  const handleMinimapClick = useCallback(
    (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
      const rect = radarRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
      if (!rect) return
      const clickX = e.clientX - rect.left
      const clickY = e.clientY - rect.top

      // Map click ratio (0 to 1)
      const ratioX = clickX / mapW
      const ratioY = clickY / mapH

      // Center the viewport on this ratio
      // Target point in canvas: ratioX * containerWidth, ratioY * containerHeight
      // pan.x = containerWidth / 2 - (ratioX * containerWidth) * zoom
      const newPanX = containerWidth / 2 - ratioX * containerWidth * zoom
      const newPanY = containerHeight / 2 - ratioY * containerHeight * zoom

      onPanChange({
        x: Math.round(newPanX),
        y: Math.round(newPanY),
      })
    },
    [containerWidth, containerHeight, zoom, onPanChange]
  )

  return (
    <div className="absolute bottom-3 right-3 z-30 flex flex-col rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#101726]/95 backdrop-blur-md shadow-2xl p-2 select-none">
      {/* Header bar */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pb-1.5 mb-1.5 border-b border-white/[0.06] text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-300">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-indigo-400">
          <Compass className="h-3 w-3" />
          <span>Floor Radar</span>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onClose}
          className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white p-0.5 rounded transition-colors"
        >
          <X className="h-3 w-3" />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Radar Map Viewport */}
      <div
        ref={radarRef}
        onClick={handleMinimapClick}
        style={{ width: `${mapW}px`, height: `${mapH}px` }}
        className="relative rounded-lg bg-[#0B0F19] border border-white/10 overflow-hidden cursor-crosshair shadow-inner"
      >
        {/* Architectural grid micro-lines */}
        <div
          className="absolute inset-0 opacity-15"
          style={{
            backgroundImage:
              'linear-gradient(to right, rgba(255,255,255,0.2) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255,255,255,0.2) 1px, transparent 1px)',
            backgroundSize: '16px 16px',
          }}
        />

        {/* Workstation Micro-dots */}
        {workstations.map((ws) => {
          let dotColor = 'bg-emerald-400'
          if (ws.status === 'flagged' || (ws.active_issues?.length || 0) > 0) {
            dotColor = 'bg-rose-500'
          } else if (ws.status === 'under_repair') {
            dotColor = 'bg-amber-400'
          } else if (ws.isPresent === false) {
            dotColor = 'bg-rose-400'
          }

          return (
            <div
              key={ws.id}
              style={{
                left: `${ws.pos_x}%`,
                top: `${ws.pos_y}%`,
                transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
              }}
              title={ws.label}
              className={`absolute h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${dotColor} pointer-events-none shadow-xs`}
            />
          )
        })}

        {/* Viewport Focus Bounding Box */}
        <div
          style={{
            left: `${boxX}px`,
            top: `${boxY}px`,
            width: `${boxW}px`,
            height: `${boxH}px`,
          }}
          className="absolute border border-indigo-400 bg-indigo-500/20 rounded-xs shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(99,102,241,0.4)] pointer-events-none"
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

export function ComputerLabWorkspace({
  initialBoardData,
  initialLabFacility,
  scheduledSessions,
  authorizedClasses,
  authorizedSubjects,
  classSubjects,
  isPrivileged,
  isTeacher,
}: ComputerLabWorkspaceProps) {
  // 1. Primary Unified Mode Switcher (Zero duplicate tab strips)
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<WorkspaceMode>('live')

  // Live Facility Infrastructure State & Calendar Policy
  const { labs, holidays } = useInfrastructureState()
  const calendarSettings = useCalendarSettings()
  const currentLab =
    labs?.find((l) => l.id === 'comp' || l.type === 'computer_lab') ||
    initialLabFacility || {
      id: 'comp',
      name: 'Computer Lab 01',
      code: 'COM-LAB',
      capacity: 40,
      type: 'computer_lab',
      status: 'Operational',
      is_active: true,
    }

  // Board Data & Landmarks
  const [boardData, setBoardData] = useState<WorkstationBoardData>(initialBoardData)
  const [floorElements, setFloorElements] = useState<LabFloorElementRow[]>([])
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // SIMULATED / LIVE TIME ENGINE INTEGRATION
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const [isMounted, setIsMounted] = useState(false)
  const [effectiveDate, setEffectiveDate] = useState<Date>(() => new Date())
  const [isSimulating, setIsSimulating] = useState<boolean>(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsMounted(true)
    const syncTime = () => {
      setEffectiveDate(getEffectiveDate())
      setIsSimulating(isSimulatingTime())
    }

    syncTime()
    const timer = setInterval(syncTime, 1000)
    window.addEventListener(TIME_TRAVEL_EVENT, syncTime)
    window.addEventListener('storage', syncTime)

    return () => {
      clearInterval(timer)
      window.removeEventListener(TIME_TRAVEL_EVENT, syncTime)
      window.removeEventListener('storage', syncTime)
    }
  }, [])

  // Derived calendar & time info in Nepal Standard Time (UTC+5:45)
  const { currentDayKey, effectiveDateStr, currentMinutes, timeDisplayStr, nepaliDateInfo } = React.useMemo(() => {
    const dateStr = getNepalDateStr(effectiveDate)
    const nptMs = effectiveDate.getTime() + 5.75 * 3600000
    const nptDate = new Date(nptMs)
    const dayIndex = nptDate.getUTCDay() // 0 = Sun, 1 = Mon, ..., 6 = Sat
    const DAY_KEYS = ['sun', 'mon', 'tue', 'wed', 'thu', 'fri', 'sat'] as const
    const dayKey = DAY_KEYS[dayIndex]
    const minsFromMidnight = nptDate.getUTCHours() * 60 + nptDate.getUTCMinutes()
    const timeStr = effectiveDate.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      second: '2-digit',

    })
    const nepaliInfo = getNepaliDate(effectiveDate)

    return {
      currentDayKey: dayKey,
      effectiveDateStr: dateStr,
      currentMinutes: minsFromMidnight,
      timeDisplayStr: timeStr,
      nepaliDateInfo: nepaliInfo,
    }
  }, [effectiveDate])

  const parseTimeToMinutes = useCallback((timeStr: string): number => {
    if (!timeStr) return 0
    const parts = timeStr.trim().split(':')
    let hours = parseInt(parts[0], 10) || 0
    const mins = parseInt(parts[1], 10) || 0
    if (hours >= 1 && hours <= 6) {
      hours += 12
    }
    return hours * 60 + mins
  }, [])

  // Institutional Calendar & Recess Policy Evaluator
  const dateSuspension = React.useMemo(() => {

  }, [effectiveDateStr, holidays, calendarSettings])

  const { liveOngoingSession, todaySessions } = React.useMemo(() => {

    if (dateSuspension.isSuspended) {

    const today = sortSessionsChronologically(

      if (currentMinutes >= startMin && currentMinutes < endMin) {
        ongoing = s
        break
      }
    }

    return {

  const [sessionToast, setSessionToast] = useState<{ text: string; type: 'success' | 'error' } | null>(null)

  // Derived Timing Status for Selected Live/Upcoming Session
  const sessionTimingStatus = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!sessionContext) return null
    const startMin = parseTimeToMinutes(sessionContext.startTime)
    const endMin = parseTimeToMinutes(sessionContext.endTime)
    if (currentMinutes < startMin) {
      return {
        status: 'upcoming' as const,
        startsInMins: Math.max(1, startMin - currentMinutes),
      }
    }
    if (currentMinutes >= startMin && currentMinutes < endMin) {
      return {
        status: 'live' as const,
        minsRemaining: endMin - currentMinutes,
      }
    }
    return {
      status: 'past' as const,
    }
  }, [sessionContext, currentMinutes, parseTimeToMinutes])

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // UNIFIED SCHEDULE ROUTINE & SESSION ACTION MODAL INTEGRATION
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const {
    routines,
    deleteSession,
    extendSession,
    mergeSession,
    unmergeSession,
    skipSession,
    unskipSession,
  } = useRoutineState()

  const [isSessionActionModalOpen, setIsSessionActionModalOpen] = useState(false)
  const [sessionActionModalMode, setSessionActionModalMode] = useState<ModalMode>('log')

  // Synthetic MasterRoutineItem mapping for the unified SessionActionModal
  const modalSessionItem = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!sessionContext) return null
    const matched = routines.find((r) => r.id === sessionContext.scheduleId)
    if (matched) return matched

    return {

      dayKey: (sessionContext.dayKey || currentDayKey) as any,
      slotId: 't2',

      subjectTitle: sessionContext.subjectName,
      grade: sessionContext.className,
      gradeKey: ('class-' + (sessionContext.grade || 12)) as any,
      teacher: sessionContext.sessionTeacherName,
      lab: sessionContext.labName,
      labKey: 'comp' as const,
      defaultStudents: sessionContext.expectedRoster.length,
      category: 'Computer',
      status: 'confirmed' as const,
    }
  }, [sessionContext, routines, currentDayKey])

    return {
      id: sessionContext.existingLog.id,
      sessionId: sessionContext.scheduleId,
      date: sessionContext.date,
      dayKey: sessionContext.dayKey || currentDayKey,

      remarks: sessionContext.existingLog.skipReason || '',
      skipReason: sessionContext.existingLog.skipReason || '',
      createdAt: sessionContext.existingLog.createdAt,
    }
  }, [sessionContext, currentDayKey])

  // Live CAD attendance roll tally for pre-filling newly initiated practical records
  const liveAbsentRolls = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!sessionContext) return []
    return sessionContext.expectedRoster
      .filter((s) => sessionAttendance[s.rollNumber] === false)
      .map((s) => s.rollNumber)
  }, [sessionContext, sessionAttendance])

  // Build live 48-station seating snapshot from board workstations
  const currentSeatingSnapshot = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!sessionContext) return null
    return boardData.workstations.map((ws: any) => {
      const student = ws.session_override || ws.assignment
      const rollNumber = student?.roll_number ?? null
      const isAbsent = rollNumber !== null ? sessionAttendance[rollNumber] === false : false
      return {
        workstation_id: ws.id,
        workstation_label: ws.label,
        row_label: ws.row_label || null,
        student_id: student?.student_id || student?.studentId || null,
        enrollment_id: student?.enrollment_id || student?.enrollmentId || null,
        student_name: student?.student_name || student?.studentName || null,
        roll_number: rollNumber,
        is_present: student ? !isAbsent : false,
        is_override: Boolean(ws.session_override),
        original_workstation_label: ws.session_override?.original_workstation_label || null,
        notes: ws.session_override ? 'Session relocation override' : null,
      }
    })
  }, [sessionContext, boardData.workstations, sessionAttendance])

  // Save practical log with topic learned and universal 48-station seating snapshot
  const handleSaveLogFromModal = async (logData: any) => {
    if (!sessionContext) return
    setIsSavingSession(true)
    try {
      const sanitizedAbsent = Array.isArray(logData.absentRolls) ? logData.absentRolls : []
      const seatingSnapshotToSave = boardData.workstations.map((ws: any) => {
        const student = ws.session_override || ws.assignment
        const rollNumber = student?.roll_number ?? null
        const isAbsent = rollNumber !== null ? sanitizedAbsent.includes(rollNumber) : false
        return {
          workstation_id: ws.id,
          workstation_label: ws.label,
          row_label: ws.row_label || null,
          student_id: student?.student_id || student?.studentId || null,
          enrollment_id: student?.enrollment_id || student?.enrollmentId || null,
          student_name: student?.student_name || student?.studentName || null,
          roll_number: rollNumber,
          is_present: student ? !isAbsent : false,
          is_override: Boolean(ws.session_override),
          original_workstation_label: ws.session_override?.original_workstation_label || null,
          notes: ws.session_override ? 'Session relocation override' : null,
        }
      })

      const res = await createPracticalLog({
        id: logData.id || sessionContext.existingLog?.id,
        schedule_id: sessionContext.scheduleId,
        class_subject_id: sessionContext.classSubjectId,
        lab_id: 'comp',
        date: logData.date || sessionContext.date,
        period_label: logData.timeSlot || `${sessionContext.startTime} – ${sessionContext.endTime}`,
        subject_name: logData.subjectTitle?.toLowerCase().startsWith(logData.subjectCode.toLowerCase())
          ? logData.subjectTitle
          : `${logData.subjectCode} - ${logData.subjectTitle}`,
        batch_group: logData.grade || sessionContext.className,
        practical_title: logData.topicLearned || `${sessionContext.subjectName} Practical Session`,
        total_students: logData.totalStudents,
        present_students: logData.presentStudents,
        absent_students: logData.absentStudents,
        absent_rolls: sanitizedAbsent,
        remarks: logData.remarks || null,
        status: logData.status || 'conducted',
        skip_reason: logData.skipReason || null,
        topic_learned: logData.topicLearned,
        seating_snapshot: seatingSnapshotToSave,
      })

      if (res.success) {
        setSessionToast({
          text: 'Practical session log & workstation seating recorded successfully!',
          type: 'success',
        })
        setIsSessionActionModalOpen(false)
        await fetchLiveSession(sessionContext.scheduleId, effectiveDateStr)
      } else {
        setSessionToast({ text: res.error || 'Failed to record practical session log.', type: 'error' })
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setSessionToast({ text: err.message || 'Error recording log.', type: 'error' })
    } finally {
      setIsSavingSession(false)
    }
  }

  // Record skipped session through the unified modal
  const handleSkipFromModal = async (sessionId: string, reason: string) => {
    if (!sessionContext) return
    setIsSavingSession(true)
    try {
      const res = await createPracticalLog({
        schedule_id: sessionContext.scheduleId,
        class_subject_id: sessionContext.classSubjectId,
        lab_id: 'comp',
        date: sessionContext.date,
        period_label: `${sessionContext.startTime} – ${sessionContext.endTime}`,
        subject_name: `${sessionContext.subjectCode} - ${sessionContext.subjectName}`,
        batch_group: sessionContext.className,
        practical_title: `${sessionContext.subjectName} (Skipped)`,
        total_students: sessionContext.expectedRoster.length,
        present_students: 0,
        absent_students: sessionContext.expectedRoster.length,
        status: 'skipped',
        skip_reason: reason,
        remarks: `Practical session skipped: ${reason}`,
      })

      if (res.success) {
        skipSession(sessionId, reason)
        setSessionToast({ text: 'Session successfully marked as skipped.', type: 'success' })
        setIsSessionActionModalOpen(false)
        await fetchLiveSession(sessionContext.scheduleId, effectiveDateStr)
      } else {
        setSessionToast({ text: res.error || 'Failed to record skipped session.', type: 'error' })
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setSessionToast({ text: err.message || 'Error skipping session.', type: 'error' })
    } finally {
      setIsSavingSession(false)
    }
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // MODE B: BASELINE SEATING STATE (TIER 1)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const [academicYears, setAcademicYears] = useState<Array<{ id: string; name: string }>>([])
  const [selectedYearId, setSelectedYearId] = useState<string>('2083')
  const [selectedClassId, setSelectedClassId] = useState<string>(() => {
    const priorityClass = authorizedClasses.find(
      (c) => c.id === '11sci' || c.id === '12eng' || c.name.toLowerCase().includes('11') || c.name.toLowerCase().includes('12')
    )
    return priorityClass?.id || authorizedClasses[0]?.id || '11sci'
  })
  const [baselinePlanData, setBaselinePlanData] = useState<CohortSeatPlanData | null>(null)
  const [isSlideDrawerOpen, setIsSlideDrawerOpen] = useState(false)
  const [selectedStudentForAssign, setSelectedStudentForAssign] = useState<StudentWithEnrollment | null>(null)
  const [dragOverWsId, setDragOverWsId] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // MODE C: HARDWARE DIAGNOSTICS & UNIFIED WORKSTATION DRAWER
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const [selectedWorkstationId, setSelectedWorkstationId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [selectedWorkstationForIssue, setSelectedWorkstationForIssue] = useState<
    (WorkstationWithIssues & {
      assignment?: any
      session_override?: any
      isPresent?: boolean | null
    }) | null
  >(null)
  const [isIssueDrawerOpen, setIsIssueDrawerOpen] = useState(false)

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // CAD VIEWPORT & MINIMAP RADAR STATE
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const viewport = useCanvasViewport({
    minZoom: 0.5,
    maxZoom: 1.6,
    zoomStep: 0.15,
  })
  const [isMinimapVisible, setIsMinimapVisible] = useState(false)

  // Active Workstation Click Popover / Modal
  const [activeWsModal, setActiveWsModal] = useState<WorkstationWithAssignment | null>(null)
  const [activeBaselineModalWs, setActiveBaselineModalWs] = useState<any | null>(null)
  const [selectedAssignModalEnrollmentId, setSelectedAssignModalEnrollmentId] = useState<string>('')
  const [isOverrideModalOpen, setIsOverrideModalOpen] = useState(false)
  const [overrideStudentEnrollmentId, setOverrideStudentEnrollmentId] = useState<string>('')
  const [liveAssistanceRequests, setLiveAssistanceRequests] = useState<LiveAssistanceItem[]>([])

  // Terminal Display Scale
  const [terminalScale, setTerminalScale] = useState<number>(1.0)

  // 1. Load Initial Landmarks and Meta
  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadMeta() {
      try {
        const [elRes, yearsRes] = await Promise.all([
          getLabFloorElements(currentLab.id || 'comp'),
          getAcademicYears(),
        ])
        if (elRes.success && elRes.data) setFloorElements(elRes.data)
        if (yearsRes.success && yearsRes.data) {
          setAcademicYears(yearsRes.data)
          const curr = yearsRes.data.find((y: any) => y.is_current)
          if (curr) setSelectedYearId(curr.id)
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to load initial workspace meta:', err)
      }
    }
    loadMeta()
  }, [currentLab.id])

  // Auto-dismiss floating toast notifications after 3.5 seconds
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!sessionToast) return
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setSessionToast(null)
    }, 3500)
    return () => clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [sessionToast])

  // 2. Fetch Live Session Context when selectedScheduleId changes or simulated date changes
  const fetchLiveSession = useCallback(async (schedId: string, customDate?: string) => {
    if (!schedId) return
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      const dateToUse = customDate || effectiveDateStr
      const res = await getLiveSessionContext(schedId, dateToUse)
      if (res.success && res.data) {
        setSessionContext(res.data)

        // Initialize attendance map: default all enrolled to Present (true) unless existingLog attendance is found
        const initialAttendance: Record<number, boolean> = {}
        res.data.expectedRoster.forEach((s) => {
          if (res.data?.existingAttendance && res.data.existingAttendance[s.rollNumber] !== undefined) {
            initialAttendance[s.rollNumber] = res.data.existingAttendance[s.rollNumber]
          } else if (res.data?.existingLog?.absentRolls) {
            initialAttendance[s.rollNumber] = !res.data.existingLog.absentRolls.includes(s.rollNumber)
          } else {
            initialAttendance[s.rollNumber] = true
          }
        })
        setSessionAttendance(initialAttendance)
      } else {
        setSessionToast({ text: res.error || 'Failed to load session context.', type: 'error' })
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setSessionToast({ text: err.message || 'Error loading live session.', type: 'error' })
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }, [effectiveDateStr])

  // Centralized Live Session, Workstation Board & Distress Queue Synchronizer
  const refreshLiveSessionAndBoard = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const [freshBoard, sessionRes, assistanceRes] = await Promise.all([
        getWorkstationBoardData(currentLab.id || 'comp'),
        (selectedScheduleId || liveOngoingSession?.id)
          ? getLiveSessionContext(selectedScheduleId || liveOngoingSession!.id, effectiveDateStr)
          : null,
        getLiveAssistanceRequests(currentLab.id || 'comp'),
      ])
      if (freshBoard) setBoardData(freshBoard)
      if (assistanceRes?.success && assistanceRes.requests) {
        setLiveAssistanceRequests(assistanceRes.requests)
      }
      if (sessionRes?.success && sessionRes.data) {
        const liveData = sessionRes.data
        setSessionContext(liveData)
        setSessionAttendance((prev) => {
          const next = { ...prev }
          liveData.expectedRoster.forEach((s) => {
            if (next[s.rollNumber] === undefined) {
              next[s.rollNumber] = true
            }
          })
          return next
        })
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error synchronizing workstation board and live session:', err)
    }
  }, [currentLab.id, selectedScheduleId, liveOngoingSession?.id, effectiveDateStr])

  // Continuous real-time auto-synchronization for Live Cockpit & CAD Floor Telemetry
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true
    let inFlight = false

    const autoSync = async (force: boolean = false) => {
      if (!isMounted || inFlight) return
      if (!force && typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.hidden) return
      inFlight = true
      try {
        await refreshLiveSessionAndBoard()
      } catch {
        // Silently ignore transient network blips
      } finally {
        inFlight = false
      }
    }

    // 1. Initial sync
    autoSync(true)

    // 2. Continuous 10-second adaptive polling (checks visibility)
    const timer = setInterval(() => autoSync(false), 10000)

    // 3. Instant sync on focus / visibility return (forced)
    const handleVisibility = () => {
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && !document.hidden) {
        autoSync(true)
      }
    }
    const handleFocus = () => autoSync(true)
    window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus)
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility)

    // 4. Instant real-time bus subscription across tabs/devices (forced, updates background tabs too!)
    const unsubWs = subscribeToSync('workstations', () => autoSync(true))
    const unsubAssist = subscribeToSync('assistance', () => autoSync(true))

    return () => {
      isMounted = false
      clearInterval(timer)
      window.removeEventListener('focus', handleFocus)
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility)
      unsubWs()
      unsubAssist()
    }
  }, [refreshLiveSessionAndBoard])

  // Auto-switch to ongoing scheduled session when time travels or period changes
  const prevPeriodKeyRef = React.useRef<string>('')
  const prevModeRef = React.useRef<string>(mode)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode !== 'live') {
      prevModeRef.current = mode
      return
    }

    const modeJustSwitchedToLive = prevModeRef.current !== 'live'
    prevModeRef.current = mode

    // If day is suspended (holiday/recess), clear any live session state immediately
    if (dateSuspension.isSuspended) {
      if (selectedScheduleId) setSelectedScheduleId('')
      if (sessionContext) setSessionContext(null)
      prevPeriodKeyRef.current = `${effectiveDateStr}_suspended`
      return
    }

    const periodKey = `${effectiveDateStr}_${liveOngoingSession?.id || 'none'}`
    if (prevPeriodKeyRef.current !== periodKey || modeJustSwitchedToLive) {
      prevPeriodKeyRef.current = periodKey

      if (liveOngoingSession) {
        setSelectedScheduleId(liveOngoingSession.id)
        fetchLiveSession(liveOngoingSession.id, effectiveDateStr)
        broadcastSync('schedules', { labId: currentLab.id, scheduleId: liveOngoingSession.id })
      } else if (!selectedScheduleId) {
        // Fallback only to today's sessions, NEVER load rogue sessions from other days!
        const fallback = todaySessions[0]
        if (fallback) {
          setSelectedScheduleId(fallback.id)
          fetchLiveSession(fallback.id, effectiveDateStr)
          broadcastSync('schedules', { labId: currentLab.id, scheduleId: fallback.id })
        } else {
          setSessionContext(null)
          broadcastSync('schedules', { labId: currentLab.id, scheduleId: null })
        }
      } else {
        // Re-fetch existing selected session with new simulated date
        fetchLiveSession(selectedScheduleId, effectiveDateStr)
      }
    }
  }, [mode, effectiveDateStr, liveOngoingSession, selectedScheduleId, todaySessions, dateSuspension.isSuspended, fetchLiveSession])

  // 3. Fetch Baseline Seating Plan when year/class changes in Mode B
  const fetchBaselineSeating = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!selectedClassId || !selectedYearId) return
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      const res = await getLabSeatPlan({
        labId: 'comp',
        classId: selectedClassId,
        academicYearId: selectedYearId,
      })
      if (res.success && res.data) {
        setBaselinePlanData(res.data)
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load baseline seating plan:', err)
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }, [selectedClassId, selectedYearId])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode === 'baseline') {
      fetchBaselineSeating()
    }
  }, [mode, fetchBaselineSeating])

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // INTERACTIVE ROLL-CALL HANDLERS (MODE A)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleToggleRollPresence = (rollNumber: number) => {
    if (sessionContext?.existingLog?.isLocked) {
      setSessionToast({ text: 'Session is locked. Edit window has expired.', type: 'error' })
      return
    }
    setSessionAttendance((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [rollNumber]: !prev[rollNumber],
    }))
  }

  const handleMarkAllPresent = () => {
    if (sessionContext?.existingLog?.isLocked) return
    if (!sessionContext) return
    const allPres: Record<number, boolean> = {}
    sessionContext.expectedRoster.forEach((s) => {
      allPres[s.rollNumber] = true
    })
    setSessionAttendance(allPres)
    setSessionToast({ text: 'All enrolled students marked present.', type: 'success' })
  }

  const handleInvertAttendance = () => {
    if (sessionContext?.existingLog?.isLocked || !sessionContext) return
    setSessionAttendance((prev) => {
      const next: Record<number, boolean> = {}
      sessionContext.expectedRoster.forEach((s) => {
        next[s.rollNumber] = !prev[s.rollNumber]
      })
      return next
    })
    setSessionToast({ text: 'Attendance marks inverted.', type: 'success' })
  }

  const handleFocusRoll = (roll: number) => {
    let targetWs: any = null
    if (mode === 'live' && sessionContext) {
      for (const [wsId, student] of Object.entries(sessionContext.seatPlan)) {
        if (student.rollNumber === roll) {
          targetWs = boardData.workstations.find((w) => w.id === wsId)
          break
        }
      }
    } else if (mode === 'baseline' && baselinePlanData) {
      const found = baselinePlanData.workstations.find((w) => w.assignment?.roll_number === roll)
      if (found) targetWs = found
    }

    if (targetWs) {
      viewport.focusWorkstation(targetWs.id, targetWs.pos_x, targetWs.pos_y)
      setSessionToast({ text: `Focused on Roll ${roll} at ${targetWs.label}`, type: 'success' })
    } else {
      setSessionToast({ text: `Roll ${roll} is not currently seated at a workstation.`, type: 'error' })
    }
  }

  const handleSubmitSession = async () => {
    if (!sessionContext) return
    setIsSavingSession(true)
    setSessionToast(null)

    try {
      const attendancePayload = sessionContext.expectedRoster.map((s) => ({
        studentId: s.studentId,
        enrollmentId: s.enrollmentId,
        rollNumber: s.rollNumber,
        isPresent: sessionAttendance[s.rollNumber] !== false,
      }))

      const res = await submitLiveSession({
        scheduleId: sessionContext.scheduleId,
        practicalTitle: sessionContext.existingLog?.practicalTitle || `${sessionContext.subjectCode} Practical Session`,
        date: sessionContext.date,
        attendance: attendancePayload,
      })

      if (!res.success) {
        setSessionToast({ text: res.error || 'Failed to submit session log.', type: 'error' })
      } else {
        setSessionToast({ text: 'Practical session attendance saved & submitted successfully!', type: 'success' })
        fetchLiveSession(sessionContext.scheduleId)
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setSessionToast({ text: err.message || 'Error submitting session log.', type: 'error' })
    } finally {
      setIsSavingSession(false)
    }
  }

  // Baseline Manual Seat Assignment Handlers (Mode B)
  const handleAssignStudentToStation = async (
    enrollmentId: string,
    workstationId: string,
    studentName: string,
    rollNumber: number,
    wsLabel: string
  ) => {
    if (!isPrivileged) return
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      const res = await assignStudentToSeat({
        lab_id: 'comp',
        class_id: selectedClassId,
        academic_year_id: selectedYearId,
        workstation_id: workstationId,
        enrollment_id: enrollmentId,
      })
      if (res.success) {
        setSessionToast({
          text: `Assigned Roll ${rollNumber} (${studentName}) to ${wsLabel}.`,
          type: 'success',
        })
        await fetchBaselineSeating()
        refreshLiveSessionAndBoard()
      } else {
        setSessionToast({ text: res.error || 'Failed to assign seat.', type: 'error' })
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setSessionToast({ text: err.message || 'Error assigning seat.', type: 'error' })
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const handleDropStudentOnStation = async (e: React.DragEvent, targetWs: any) => {
    if (!isPrivileged) return
    e.preventDefault()
    e.stopPropagation()
    setDragOverWsId(null)

    try {
      const raw = e.dataTransfer.getData('application/json')
      if (!raw) return
      const payload = JSON.parse(raw)
      if (payload.type === 'student' && payload.enrollment_id) {
        await handleAssignStudentToStation(
          payload.enrollment_id,
          targetWs.id,
          payload.student_name,
          payload.roll_number,
          targetWs.label
        )
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Error handling student drop:', err)
      setSessionToast({ text: 'Failed to process student assignment.', type: 'error' })
    }
  }

  // Handle Workstation Node Click depending on Mode
  const handleWorkstationClick = (ws: any) => {
    if (mode === 'live') {
      const fullWs = boardData.workstations.find((w) => w.id === ws.id) || ws
      setSelectedWorkstationId(ws.id)
      setSelectedWorkstationForIssue({
        ...fullWs,
        assignment: ws.assignment,
        session_override: ws.session_override,
        isPresent: ws.isPresent,
      })
      setIsIssueDrawerOpen(true)
    } else if (mode === 'baseline') {
      if (selectedStudentForAssign) {
        if (!isPrivileged) {
          setSessionToast({
            text: 'View only: Administrative role required to modify seating allocations.',
            type: 'error',
          })
          return
        }
        handleAssignStudentToStation(
          selectedStudentForAssign.enrollment_id,
          ws.id,
          selectedStudentForAssign.full_name,
          selectedStudentForAssign.roll_number,
          ws.label
        )
        setSelectedStudentForAssign(null)
        return
      }
      // If no student is pre-selected: open the Baseline Workstation Modal
      setActiveBaselineModalWs(ws)
    }
  }



  // Workstation Telemetry Counts
  const totalWorkstations = boardData.workstations.length
  const operationalCount = boardData.workstations.filter((w) => w.status === 'operational').length
  const faultCount = boardData.workstations.filter((w) => w.status === 'flagged' || ((w.active_issues?.length || 0) > 0)).length
  const repairCount = boardData.workstations.filter((w) => w.status === 'under_repair').length

  // Live Attendance Present Count
  const livePresentCount = sessionContext
    ? sessionContext.expectedRoster.filter((s) => sessionAttendance[s.rollNumber] !== false).length
    : 0

  // 4. Compute Displaced & Unseated Students in Live Session Mode
  const displacedStudents = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!sessionContext || mode !== 'live') return []

    const wsStatusMap = new Map<string, WorkstationWithIssues>()
    boardData.workstations.forEach((w) => wsStatusMap.set(w.id, w))

    const displaced: DisplacedStudent[] = []
    const seatedEnrollmentIds = new Set<string>()

    // Case 1: Workstations with assigned students that are faulted, under repair, or hardware-flagged
    for (const [wsId, student] of Object.entries(sessionContext.seatPlan)) {
