import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Select } from '@/components/ui/select'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import {
  LAYOUT_PRESETS,
  type LayoutPresetType,
  type CustomRoomGridConfig,
  type LabLayoutTemplate,
} from '@/lib/workstations/layout-engine'

interface LayoutEditorBarProps {
  isSaving: boolean
  hasUnsavedChanges: boolean
  snapGrid: number
  totalWorkstations: number
  terminalScale?: number
  savedTemplates?: LabLayoutTemplate[]
  onApplyPreset: (preset: LayoutPresetType) => void
  onApplyCustomConfig?: (config: CustomRoomGridConfig, provisionMissing?: boolean) => void
  onSaveTemplate?: (name: string, config: CustomRoomGridConfig, description?: string) => Promise<boolean>
  onDeleteTemplate?: (templateId: string) => Promise<boolean>
  onToggleSnapGrid: (grid: number) => void
  onTerminalScaleChange?: (scale: number) => void
  onSave: () => Promise<void>
  onCancel: () => void
}

export function LayoutEditorBar({
  isSaving,
  hasUnsavedChanges,
  snapGrid,
  totalWorkstations,
  terminalScale = 1,
  savedTemplates = [],
  onApplyPreset,
  onApplyCustomConfig,
  onSaveTemplate,
  onDeleteTemplate,
  onToggleSnapGrid,
  onTerminalScaleChange,
  onSave,
  onCancel,
}: LayoutEditorBarProps) {
  const [selectedPreset, setSelectedPreset] = useState<string>('rows_4x8')
  const [isCustomModalOpen, setIsCustomModalOpen] = useState(false)
  const [showSnapHelp, setShowSnapHelp] = useState(false)

  // Custom Grid Builder State (flexible 1 to 4 sides, any rows and columns)
  const [customSides, setCustomSides] = useState<1 | 2 | 3 | 4>(2)
  const [customRows, setCustomRows] = useState<number>(6)
  const [customCols, setCustomCols] = useState<number>(4)
  const [customRowNaming, setCustomRowNaming] = useState<'letters' | 'numbers'>('letters')
  const [customTerminalNaming, setCustomTerminalNaming] = useState<
    'alphanumeric' | 'side_prefix' | 'sequential_pc' | 'preserve'
  >('alphanumeric')
  const [customRowNames, setCustomRowNames] = useState<Record<number, string>>({
    0: 'Row A',
    1: 'Row B',
    2: 'Row C',
    3: 'Row D',
    4: 'Row E',
    5: 'Row F',
  })
  const [isEditingRowNames, setIsEditingRowNames] = useState(false)

  // Template Saving & Loading State
  const [templateName, setTemplateName] = useState<string>('')
  const [templateDescription, setTemplateDescription] = useState<string>('')
  const [isSavingTemplate, setIsSavingTemplate] = useState<boolean>(false)
  const [selectedTemplateId, setSelectedTemplateId] = useState<string>('')

  const handleLoadTemplate = (tpl: LabLayoutTemplate) => {
    if (!tpl.config) return
    setCustomSides(tpl.config.sides || 2)
    setCustomRows(tpl.config.rows || 6)
    setCustomCols(tpl.config.columns || 4)
    setCustomRowNaming(tpl.config.rowNaming || 'letters')
    setCustomTerminalNaming(tpl.config.terminalNaming || 'alphanumeric')
    if (tpl.config.customRowNames) {
      setCustomRowNames(tpl.config.customRowNames)
    }
    setTemplateName(tpl.name)
    setTemplateDescription(tpl.description || '')
    setSelectedTemplateId(tpl.id)
  }

  const handleSaveCurrentAsTemplate = async () => {
    if (!onSaveTemplate || !templateName.trim()) return
    setIsSavingTemplate(true)
    try {
      const config: CustomRoomGridConfig = {
        sides: customSides,
        rows: customRows,
        columns: customCols,
        rowNaming: customRowNaming,
        terminalNaming: customTerminalNaming,
        customRowNames,
      }
      await onSaveTemplate(templateName.trim(), config, templateDescription.trim())
    } finally {
      setIsSavingTemplate(false)
    }
  }

  const activePresetInfo = LAYOUT_PRESETS.find((p) => p.id === selectedPreset)
  const computedTotalSlots = customSides * customRows * customCols

  const handleCustomRowChange = (index: number, val: string) => {
    setCustomRowNames((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [index]: val,
    }))
  }

  const handleAddRow = () => {
    if (customRows >= 16) return
    const nextIdx = customRows
    const nextChar = String.fromCharCode(65 + (nextIdx % 26))
    const defaultName = customRowNaming === 'letters' ? `Row ${nextChar}` : `Row ${nextIdx + 1}`
    setCustomRowNames((prev) => ({ ...prev, [nextIdx]: defaultName }))
    setCustomRows((prev) => prev + 1)
  }

  const handleRemoveRow = () => {
    if (customRows <= 1) return
    setCustomRows((prev) => prev - 1)
  }

  const handleApplyCustom = (provisionMissing: boolean = false) => {
    if (!onApplyCustomConfig) return
    const config: CustomRoomGridConfig = {
      sides: customSides,
      rows: customRows,
      columns: customCols,
      rowNaming: customRowNaming,
      terminalNaming: customTerminalNaming,
      customRowNames,
    }
    onApplyCustomConfig(config, provisionMissing)
    setIsCustomModalOpen(false)
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-indigo-500/30 bg-[#0B0F19] p-3 sm:p-4 shadow-xl space-y-3 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="flex flex-col xl:flex-row xl:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        {/* Left: Mode Title & Info */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
          <span className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/30 shadow-xs">
            <LayoutGrid className="h-4 w-4" />
          </span>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <h3 className="font-heading font-extrabold text-sm text-white">
                Floor Plan Layout Editor
              </h3>
              <Badge className="bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-400 border-indigo-500/20 text-[10px] font-bold">
                {totalWorkstations} Terminals
              </Badge>
              {hasUnsavedChanges && (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30 animate-pulse">
                  Unsaved Changes
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
              Drag workstations on canvas, build custom room grids (e.g. Left/Right 48 PCs), or apply presets.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Center/Right: Custom Builder, Presets, Scale, Snap, Save */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          {/* Custom Grid Builder Trigger */}
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setIsCustomModalOpen(true)}
            className="h-8.5 px-3 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white shadow-xs gap-1.5"
            title="Configure custom rows, columns, sides, and seat ID patterns"
          >
            <SlidersHorizontal className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>Custom Grid</span>
          </Button>

          {/* Preset Selector */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Select
              value={selectedPreset}
              onChange={(e) => {
                const val = e.target.value
                setSelectedPreset(val)
                if (val.startsWith('tpl_')) {
                  const tplId = val.replace('tpl_', '')
                  const found = savedTemplates.find((t) => t.id === tplId)
                  if (found) {
                    handleLoadTemplate(found)
                  }
                }
              }}
              className="h-8.5 text-xs bg-[#151E32] border-white/10 text-white rounded-xl min-w-[170px]"
            >
              <optgroup label="Standard Math Presets">
                {LAYOUT_PRESETS.map((p) => (
                  <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                    {p.title}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </optgroup>
              {savedTemplates.length > 0 && (
                <optgroup label="Saved Custom Layouts">
                  {savedTemplates.map((t) => (
                    <option key={t.id} value={`tpl_${t.id}`}>
                      ★ {t.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </optgroup>
              )}
            </Select>

            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => {
                if (selectedPreset.startsWith('tpl_')) {
                  const tplId = selectedPreset.replace('tpl_', '')
                  const found = savedTemplates.find((t) => t.id === tplId)
                  if (found) {
                    handleLoadTemplate(found)
                    onApplyCustomConfig?.(found.config, false)
                    return
                  }
                }
                onApplyPreset(selectedPreset as LayoutPresetType)
              }}
              className="h-8.5 px-2.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl border-white/10 text-slate-200 hover:bg-white/5 gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
              title="Apply selected preset"
            >
              <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-400" />
              <span>Apply Preset</span>
            </Button>
          </div>

          {/* Terminal Size Scale Control */}
          {onTerminalScaleChange && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#151E32] p-0.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10 text-xs text-slate-300">
              <span className="px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                <Monitor className="h-3 w-3 text-indigo-400" />
                <span>Size:</span>
              </span>
              {[
                { label: '80%', val: 0.8 },
                { label: '100%', val: 1.0 },
                { label: '120%', val: 1.2 },
              ].map((s) => (
                <button
                  key={s.label}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onTerminalScaleChange(s.val)}
                  className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-mono font-bold cursor-pointer transition-colors ${
                    terminalScale === s.val
                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-2xs'
                      : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
                  }`}
                  title={`Set terminal display size to ${s.label}`}
                >
                  {s.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Grid Snap Control with Explanatory Hint */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#151E32] p-0.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10 text-xs text-slate-300 relative">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowSnapHelp(!showSnapHelp)}
              className="px-1.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-300 flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
              title="What is Snap to Grid?"
            >
              <Grid className="h-3 w-3" />
              <span>Snap:</span>
              <HelpCircle className="h-2.5 w-2.5 text-slate-500" />
            </button>
            {[0, 2, 4].map((g) => (
              <button
                key={g}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onToggleSnapGrid(g)}
                className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-mono font-bold cursor-pointer transition-colors ${
                  snapGrid === g
                    ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-2xs'
                    : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
                }`}
                title={g === 0 ? 'Disable snap (smooth free drag)' : `Snap positions to ${g}% grid lines while dragging`}
              >
                {g === 0 ? 'Off' : `${g}%`}
              </button>
            ))}

            {showSnapHelp && (
              <div className="absolute top-full mt-2 left-0 w-64 p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#101726] border border-indigo-500/30 shadow-2xl z-50 text-[11px] text-slate-300 leading-relaxed animate-in fade-in">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-bold text-white mb-1">
                  <span>Snap to Grid</span>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowSnapHelp(false)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white">
                    <X className="h-3 w-3" />
                  </button>
                </div>
                Aligns workstation coordinates to 2% or 4% grid intervals when dragging on the canvas so rows and columns stay neat and straight.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Cancel & Save Buttons */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 ml-auto xl:ml-0">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              disabled={isSaving}
              onClick={onCancel}
              className="h-8.5 px-3 text-xs rounded-xl border-white/10 text-slate-300 hover:bg-white/5 gap-1.5"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="h-3 w-3" />
              <span>Cancel</span>
            </Button>

            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              disabled={isSaving || !hasUnsavedChanges}
              onClick={onSave}
              className="h-8.5 px-3 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white shadow-xs gap-1.5 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {isSaving ? (
                <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              )}
              <span>Save Layout</span>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Preset Details Hint */}
      {activePresetInfo && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/[0.06] bg-white/[0.02] p-2.5 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-400">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Info className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-400 shrink-0" />
            <span>
              <strong className="text-slate-200">{activePresetInfo.title}</strong>: {activePresetInfo.description}
            </span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-indigo-400 bg-indigo-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shrink-0 hidden sm:inline-block">
            {activePresetInfo.capacityHint}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ============================================================= */}
      {/* CUSTOM ROOM GRID BUILDER MODAL                                */}
      {/* ============================================================= */}
      {isCustomModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-150">
          <div className="relative w-full max-w-lg rounded-2xl border border-indigo-500/30 bg-[#101726] p-5 shadow-2xl space-y-4 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-white/[0.08]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <span className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/30">
                  <SlidersHorizontal className="h-4 w-4" />
                </span>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-heading font-extrabold text-sm text-white">
                    Custom Room Grid Builder
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                    Define custom sides, rows, columns, and systematic terminal naming (e.g. A1..A4, C4, G3).
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsCustomModalOpen(false)}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Grid Configuration Controls */}
            <div className="space-y-4 text-xs">
              {/* Saved Custom Layout Templates (Load / Delete) */}
              {savedTemplates.length > 0 && (
                <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-indigo-500/20 bg-indigo-500/5 space-y-1.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <Bookmark className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-400" />
                      <span>Saved Custom Layouts ({savedTemplates.length})</span>
                    </span>
                    {selectedTemplateId && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setSelectedTemplateId('')
                          setTemplateName('')
                        }}
                        className="text-[10px] text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-300 cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        Clear Loaded
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                    {savedTemplates.map((tpl) => (
                      <div
                        key={tpl.id}
                        className={`group flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border text-[11px] font-semibold transition-all ${
                          selectedTemplateId === tpl.id
                            ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-500 shadow-xs'
                            : 'bg-[#151E32] text-slate-300 border-white/10 hover:border-indigo-500/50 hover:text-white'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleLoadTemplate(tpl)}
                          className="cursor-pointer text-left"
                          title={tpl.description || tpl.name}
                        >
                          {tpl.name}
                        </button>
                        {onDeleteTemplate && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              e.stopPropagation()
                              if (confirm(`Delete saved layout template "${tpl.name}"?`)) {
                                onDeleteTemplate(tpl.id)
                              }
                            }}
                            className="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-400 p-0.5 rounded transition-colors opacity-60 group-hover:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"
                            title={`Delete template "${tpl.name}"`}
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Room Structure: Sides / Corridor Layout */}
              <div>
                <label className="block font-semibold text-slate-300 mb-1.5">
                  Room Corridor Layout (Sides &amp; Aisles)
                </label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  {[
                    {
                      s: 2 as const,
                      title: '2 Sides (Left & Right)',
                      desc: 'Divided by a central instructor aisle corridor',
                    },
                    {
                      s: 1 as const,
                      title: '1 Single Hall Block',
                      desc: 'Uniform continuous rows across entire room',
                    },
                    {
                      s: 3 as const,
                      title: '3 Sections (Triple Pods)',
                      desc: 'Left, Center, and Right pods with 2 walking aisles',
                    },
                    {
                      s: 4 as const,
                      title: '4 Island Pods (Quads)',
                      desc: 'Four separated modular blocks for team work',
                    },
                  ].map((opt) => (
                    <button
                      key={opt.s}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setCustomSides(opt.s)}
                      className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-left cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                        customSides === opt.s
                          ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-500/10 text-white ring-1 ring-indigo-500'
                          : 'border-white/10 bg-[#151E32] text-slate-300 hover:border-white/20'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="font-bold flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span>{opt.title}</span>
                        {customSides === opt.s && (
                          <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-indigo-400" />
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block mt-0.5 leading-tight">
                        {opt.desc}
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Rows (Front to Back) */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="block font-semibold text-slate-300">
                    Number of Rows (Front to Back)
                  </label>
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-indigo-400">
                    {customRows} Rows
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Quick Row Selection Chips */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                  {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8].map((r) => (
                    <button
                      key={r}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setCustomRows(r)}
                      className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                        customRows === r
                          ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs'
                          : 'bg-[#151E32] text-slate-400 border border-white/5 hover:text-white hover:border-white/20'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {r} {r === 1 ? 'Row' : 'Rows'}
                    </button>
                  ))}

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 ml-auto">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={customRows <= 1}
                      onClick={handleRemoveRow}
                      className="h-7 w-7 rounded-lg bg-[#151E32] border border-white/10 text-slate-300 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer"
                      title="Decrease rows"
                    >
                      <Minus className="h-3 w-3" />
                    </button>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min={1}
                      max={16}
                      value={customRows}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setCustomRows(Math.max(1, Math.min(16, parseInt(e.target.value) || 1)))
                      }
                      className="w-12 h-7 rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-[#0B0F19] text-center font-mono font-bold text-white focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none text-xs"
                    />
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={customRows >= 16}
                      onClick={handleAddRow}
                      className="h-7 w-7 rounded-lg bg-[#151E32] border border-white/10 text-slate-300 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer"
                      title="Increase rows"
                    >
                      <Plus className="h-3 w-3" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Columns per Side / Section */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="block font-semibold text-slate-300">
                    Columns per Side / Section
                  </label>
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-indigo-400">
                    {customCols} PCs per row
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Quick Column Selection Chips */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                  {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8].map((c) => (
                    <button
                      key={c}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setCustomCols(c)}
                      className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                        customCols === c
                          ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs'
                          : 'bg-[#151E32] text-slate-400 border border-white/5 hover:text-white hover:border-white/20'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {c} {c === 1 ? 'Col' : 'Cols'}
                    </button>
                  ))}

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 ml-auto">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={customCols <= 1}
                      onClick={() => setCustomCols((prev) => Math.max(1, prev - 1))}
                      className="h-7 w-7 rounded-lg bg-[#151E32] border border-white/10 text-slate-300 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer"
                      title="Decrease columns"
                    >
                      <Minus className="h-3 w-3" />
                    </button>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min={1}
                      max={12}
                      value={customCols}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setCustomCols(Math.max(1, Math.min(12, parseInt(e.target.value) || 1)))
                      }
                      className="w-12 h-7 rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-[#0B0F19] text-center font-mono font-bold text-white focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none text-xs"
                    />
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={customCols >= 12}
                      onClick={() => setCustomCols((prev) => Math.min(12, prev + 1))}
                      className="h-7 w-7 rounded-lg bg-[#151E32] border border-white/10 text-slate-300 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer"
                      title="Increase columns"
                    >
                      <Plus className="h-3 w-3" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Grid Calculation Pill */}
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl border border-indigo-500/25 bg-indigo-500/10 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs text-indigo-300">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-400 shrink-0" />
                  <span>

  labCode?: string

export function ProjectorView({
  initialBoardData,
  floorElements,
  initialSessionContext,
  scheduleId,
  labName = 'Computer Lab 01',
  labCode = 'COM-LAB',
}: ProjectorViewProps) {
  const [boardData, setBoardData] = useState<WorkstationBoardData>(initialBoardData)
  const [sessionContext, setSessionContext] = useState<LiveSessionContext | null>(
    initialSessionContext
  )
  const [isFullscreen, setIsFullscreen] = useState(false)
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState<boolean>(false)
  const [lastSyncedText, setLastSyncedText] = useState<string>('')
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState<string>('')
  const [currentDateString, setCurrentDateString] = useState<string>('')

  // 1. Digital Clock & Mounted Hydration Sync
  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true)
    const initialNow = new Date()
    setLastSyncedText(
      initialNow.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        second: '2-digit',
        hour12: true,
      })
    )

    function updateClock() {
      const now = new Date()
      setCurrentTime(
        now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {
          hour: '2-digit',
          minute: '2-digit',
          second: '2-digit',
          hour12: true,
        })
      )
      setCurrentDateString(
        now.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
          weekday: 'long',
          month: 'short',
          day: 'numeric',
          year: 'numeric',
        })
      )
    }
    updateClock()
    const timer = setInterval(updateClock, 1000)
    return () => clearInterval(timer)
  }, [])

  // 2. Fullscreen Toggle
  const toggleFullscreen = () => {
    if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
      document.documentElement.requestFullscreen().catch((err) => {
        console.error('Error attempting to enable fullscreen:', err)
      })
      setIsFullscreen(true)
    } else {
      if (document.exitFullscreen) {
        document.exitFullscreen()
      }
      setIsFullscreen(false)
    }
  }

  // 3. Auto-Refresh every 10 seconds
  const refreshLiveState = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!scheduleId && !sessionContext?.scheduleId) return
    const targetSchedId = scheduleId || sessionContext?.scheduleId
    if (!targetSchedId) return

    try {
      const res = await getLiveSessionContext(targetSchedId)
      if (res.success && res.data) {
        setSessionContext(res.data)
        setLastSyncedText(
          new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {
            hour: '2-digit',
            minute: '2-digit',
            second: '2-digit',
            hour12: true,
          })
        )
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error auto-refreshing projector state:', err)
    }
  }, [scheduleId, sessionContext?.scheduleId])

  useEffect(() => {
    const pollInterval = setInterval(refreshLiveState, 10000)
    return () => clearInterval(pollInterval)
  }, [refreshLiveState])

  // Counts
  const totalWorkstations = boardData.workstations.length
  const seatedStudents = sessionContext ? Object.keys(sessionContext.seatPlan).length : 0
  const outOfServiceCount = boardData.workstations.filter(
    (w) => w.status === 'under_repair' || (w.status === 'flagged' && w.highest_severity === 'critical')
  ).length
  const availableCount = Math.max(0, totalWorkstations - seatedStudents - outOfServiceCount)

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#070A12] text-white flex flex-col justify-between selection:bg-indigo-500/30">
      {/* ------------------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* 1. PROJECTOR HEADER (High-Contrast Wall Display)              */}
      {/* ------------------------------------------------------------- */}
      <header className="p-4 sm:p-6 bg-[#0B0F19]/90 border-b border-white/[0.08] backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-50">
        <div className="max-w-[1920px] mx-auto flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          {/* Left: Facility & Active Session */}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
              <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs">
                <Monitor className="h-4 w-4" />
              </span>
              <span className="font-heading font-extrabold text-base sm:text-lg text-white tracking-tight">
                {labName} ({labCode})
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/20">
                Wall Seating Chart
              </span>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20">
                <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                Live Sync (10s)
              </span>
            </div>

            {sessionContext ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300 flex-wrap">
                <span className="font-heading font-extrabold text-white text-base sm:text-lg text-indigo-300">
                  {sessionContext.className} &bull; {sessionContext.subjectName}
                </span>
                <span className="text-slate-400">&bull;</span>
                <span className="text-slate-300 font-medium">
                  Faculty: <strong className="text-white">{sessionContext.sessionTeacherName}</strong>
                </span>
                <span className="text-slate-400">&bull;</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-slate-300">
                  {sessionContext.startTime} – {sessionContext.endTime}

        setError(res.error || 'Failed to start unscheduled session.')

import React, { useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import {
  X,

  Wrench,
  Monitor,
  User,
  ShieldAlert,
  Loader2,
  ChevronDown,
  ExternalLink,
  Check,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { reportWorkstationIssue } from '@/app/actions/workstations'
import { broadcastSync } from '@/lib/sync-bus'
import type { WorkstationWithIssues } from '@/types/workstations'
import type { WorkstationSeatAssignment } from '@/lib/types/seat-plans'

interface StationQuickPopoverProps {
  workstation: WorkstationWithIssues & {
    assignment?: WorkstationSeatAssignment | null
    session_override?: {
      override_id: string
      student_name: string
      roll_number: number
      reason?: string | null
    } | null
    isPresent?: boolean | null
  }
  availableWorkstations?: Array<{ id: string; label: string; description?: string }>
  isLocked?: boolean
  assistanceRequest?: {
    id: string
    title: string
    description?: string | null
    severity?: string
    studentName?: string | null
    studentRoll?: string | null
  } | null
  onAcknowledgeAssistance?: (reqId: string) => Promise<void> | void
  onTogglePresence?: (rollNumber: number) => void
  onAssignOverride?: (targetWsId: string, enrollmentId: string) => Promise<void>
  onIssueReported?: () => void
  onOpenIssueDrawer?: (ws: any) => void
  onClose: () => void
}

const FAULT_PRESETS = [
  { title: 'Mouse / Keyboard unresponsive', severity: 'medium' as const },
  { title: 'No display / Monitor won\'t turn on', severity: 'high' as const },
  { title: 'OS Crash / Blue Screen', severity: 'high' as const },
  { title: 'Loose Network Cable / No Internet', severity: 'medium' as const },
  { title: 'Power supply failure / Won\'t boot', severity: 'critical' as const },
  { title: 'Hardware peripheral damaged', severity: 'medium' as const },
]

export function StationQuickPopover({
  workstation,
  availableWorkstations = [],
  isLocked = false,
  assistanceRequest = null,
  onAcknowledgeAssistance,
  onTogglePresence,
  onAssignOverride,
  onIssueReported,
  onOpenIssueDrawer,
  onClose,
}: StationQuickPopoverProps) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'attendance' | 'reassign' | 'fault'>('attendance')
  const destinationStations = availableWorkstations.filter((w) => w.id !== workstation.id)
  const [selectedTargetWsId, setSelectedTargetWsId] = useState<string>(destinationStations[0]?.id || '')
  const [selectedPresetFault, setSelectedPresetFault] = useState<string>(FAULT_PRESETS[0].title)
  const [customFaultTitle, setCustomFaultTitle] = useState('')
  const [faultSeverity, setFaultSeverity] = useState<'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical'>('medium')
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<{ text: string; type: 'success' | 'error' } | null>(null)
  const [localPresence, setLocalPresence] = useState<boolean>(workstation.isPresent !== false)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const validStations = availableWorkstations.filter((w) => w.id !== workstation.id)
    if (!selectedTargetWsId || !validStations.some((w) => w.id === selectedTargetWsId)) {
      setSelectedTargetWsId(validStations[0]?.id || '')
    }
  }, [availableWorkstations, workstation.id, selectedTargetWsId])

  React.useEffect(() => {
    setLocalPresence(workstation.isPresent !== false)
  }, [workstation.isPresent])

  const student = workstation.session_override || workstation.assignment
  const hasStudent = !!student
  const rollNumber = student?.roll_number
  const enrollmentId = workstation.assignment?.enrollment_id

  // 1. Toggle attendance
  const handleToggle = (setPresent: boolean) => {
    if (isLocked || !rollNumber || !onTogglePresence) return
    setLocalPresence(setPresent)
    onTogglePresence(rollNumber)
    setFeedback({
      text: setPresent ? 'Marked Present' : 'Marked Absent',
      type: 'success',
    })
    // Auto-close dialog after 260ms so teachers don't have to unnecessarily click the 'X' button
    setTimeout(() => {
      onClose()
    }, 260)
  }

  // 2. Quick Reassign
  const handleReassign = async () => {
    if (!selectedTargetWsId || !enrollmentId || !onAssignOverride) return
    setIsSubmitting(true)
    setFeedback(null)
    try {
      await onAssignOverride(selectedTargetWsId, enrollmentId)
      setFeedback({ text: 'Student reassigned for this session!', type: 'success' })
      setTimeout(() => {
        onClose()
      }, 350)
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFeedback({ text: err.message || 'Failed to reassign seat.', type: 'error' })
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false)
    }
  }

  // 3. Fast 1-Tap Fault Report
  const handleReportFault = async () => {
    const title = customFaultTitle.trim() || selectedPresetFault
    if (!title) return
    setIsSubmitting(true)
    setFeedback(null)
    try {
      const res = await reportWorkstationIssue({
        workstation_id: workstation.id,
        title,
        severity: faultSeverity,
      })
      if (res.success) {
        setFeedback({ text: `Fault logged on ${workstation.label}. Sent to Maintenance!`, type: 'success' })
        broadcastSync('workstations', { stationCode: workstation.label })
        onIssueReported?.()
        setTimeout(() => {
          onClose()
        }, 1200)
      } else {
        setFeedback({ text: res.error || 'Failed to report fault.', type: 'error' })
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFeedback({ text: err.message || 'Error submitting fault.', type: 'error' })
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs select-none">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#101726] shadow-2xl p-4 font-sans text-white animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150 space-y-3.5">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/[0.08] pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            {hasStudent ? (
              <div className="h-9 w-9 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-white/20 bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-sm">
                {(student as any).photo_url ? (
                  <img
                    src={(student as any).photo_url}
                    alt={student.student_name}
                    className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                  />
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-300 font-heading">
                    {student.student_name.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <span className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-indigo-600/30 border border-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-400">
                <Monitor className="h-4 w-4" />
              </span>
            )}
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <h3 className="font-heading font-extrabold text-sm text-white">
                  {workstation.label}
                </h3>
                <Badge
                  className={`text-[9px] font-bold ${
                    workstation.status === 'operational'
                      ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/20'
                      : workstation.status === 'under_repair'
                      ? 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/20'
                      : 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 border-rose-500/20'
                  }`}
                >
                  {workstation.status}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                {hasStudent ? (
                  <>
                    <strong className="text-slate-200">{student.student_name}</strong> &bull; Roll {student.roll_number}
                  </>
                ) : (
                  'Station Available / Unassigned'
                )}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="h-4 w-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* ACTIVE HELP REQUEST & FAULT DETAILS SECTION                     */}

export interface LiveAssistanceItem {
  id: string
  workstationId: string
  stationLabel: string
  title: string
  description: string | null
  severity: string
  studentName: string | null
  studentRoll: string | null
  createdAt: string
}

interface TerminalAssistanceQueueProps {
  requests: LiveAssistanceItem[]
  onFocusStation?: (stationLabel: string) => void
  onDismissRequest?: (id: string) => void
}

export function TerminalAssistanceQueue({
  requests,
  onFocusStation,
  onDismissRequest,
}: TerminalAssistanceQueueProps) {
  const [acknowledgingId, setAcknowledgingId] = useState<string | null>(null)

  if (!requests || requests.length === 0) return null

  const handleAcknowledge = async (item: LiveAssistanceItem) => {
    setAcknowledgingId(item.id)
    const res = await acknowledgeAssistanceRequest(item.id)
    setAcknowledgingId(null)
    if (res.success) {
      onDismissRequest?.(item.id)
      broadcastSync('assistance', { stationCode: item.stationLabel })
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-950/20 p-3 sm:p-4 shadow-lg space-y-2.5 font-sans animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-1 duration-300">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-amber-500/20 pb-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="h-6 w-6 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
            <BellRing className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-bounce" />
          </div>
          <span className="font-heading font-extrabold text-xs sm:text-sm text-white">
            Incoming Student Terminal Help Requests ({requests.length})
          </span>
        </div>
        <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-300/80 font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">
          Live Help Beacon
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="divide-y divide-amber-500/10 space-y-2 pt-1">
        {requests.map((item) => (
          <div
            key={item.id}
            className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-2 text-xs"
          >
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <Badge className="bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-200 border-amber-500/30 font-mono font-bold text-xs">
                  {item.stationLabel}
                </Badge>
                <span className="font-bold text-white">{item.title}</span>
                {item.studentName && (
                  <span className="text-zinc-400 text-xs">
                    from <strong className="text-zinc-200">{item.studentName}</strong>
                    {item.studentRoll && (
                      <span className="text-indigo-400 font-mono ml-1">(Roll {item.studentRoll})</span>
                    )}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              {item.description && (
                <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 italic line-clamp-1">
                  &ldquo;{item.description}&rdquo;
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 self-end sm:self-auto">
              {onFocusStation && (
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => onFocusStation(item.stationLabel)}
                  className="h-7 px-2.5 text-xs rounded-lg border-amber-500/30 text-amber-200 hover:bg-amber-500/20 gap-1"
                >
                  <Monitor className="h-3 w-3" />
                  <span>Locate Node</span>
                </Button>
              )}

              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => handleAcknowledge(item)}
                disabled={acknowledgingId === item.id}
                className="h-7 px-2.5 text-xs rounded-lg bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 text-white font-medium gap-1"
              >
                {acknowledgingId === item.id ? (
                  <RefreshCw className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" />
                ) : (
                  <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3" />
                )}
                <span>Acknowledge</span>
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

    type: 'chemistry_lab',
    capacity: 40,
    status: 'Operational',
  },
]

function getLabIcon(type?: string, name?: string) {
  const t = (type || '').toLowerCase()
  const n = (name || '').toLowerCase()
  if (t === 'physics_lab' || n.includes('phys')) return Atom
  if (t === 'chemistry_lab' || n.includes('chem')) return FlaskRound
  if (t === 'biology_lab' || n.includes('bio') || n.includes('life')) return Dna
  if (t === 'electronics_lab' || n.includes('elec') || n.includes('hardware')) return Cpu
  return Terminal
}

  AlertTriangle,

import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'

interface IncidentDrawerProps {
  incident: LabIncidentRecord | null
  isOpen: boolean
  onClose: () => void
  userRole?: 'super_admin' | 'lab_incharge' | 'hod' | 'teacher' | 'faculty'
}

export default function IncidentDrawer({
  incident,
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  userRole = 'lab_incharge',
}: IncidentDrawerProps) {
  const { resolveIncident, escalateToHOD } = useIncidentState()

  const [isEscalating, setIsEscalating] = useState(false)
  const [escalationReason, setEscalationReason] = useState('')
  const [resolutionNotes, setResolutionNotes] = useState('')
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)
  const [lightboxUrl, setLightboxUrl] = useState<string | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true)
  }, [])

  if (!isOpen || !incident || !mounted) return null

  const isCritical = incident.severity === 'major_critical'
  const isModerate = incident.severity === 'moderate'
  const isEscalated = incident.status === 'escalated_to_hod' || incident.escalated_to_hod
  const isResolved = incident.status === 'resolved'

  const canManage = userRole === 'super_admin' || userRole === 'lab_incharge' || userRole === 'hod'

  const handleStatusChange = async (newStatus: 'under_repair' | 'replaced' | 'resolved') => {
    if (!canManage) return
    setIsSubmitting(true)
    try {
      const resolverTitle =
        userRole === 'hod'
          ? 'Head of Department'
          : userRole === 'super_admin'
          ? 'Super Admin'
          : 'Lab In-Charge'

      await resolveIncident(incident.id, {
        status: newStatus,
        resolution_notes: resolutionNotes || `Marked as ${newStatus.replace('_', ' ')} by ${resolverTitle}`,
        resolved_by: resolverTitle,
      })
      onClose()
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false)
    }
  }

  const handleEscalate = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!escalationReason.trim() || !canManage) return
    setIsSubmitting(true)
    try {
      await escalateToHOD(incident.id, escalationReason.trim())
      setIsEscalating(false)
      onClose()
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false)
    }
  }

  return createPortal(
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-6 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in duration-200 select-none overflow-y-auto">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-2xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[85vh] my-auto">
        {/* Header */}
        <div
          className={`p-5 px-6 border-b flex items-center justify-between ${
            isCritical
              ? 'bg-rose-50/80 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/60'
              : isModerate
              ? 'bg-amber-50/80 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/60'
              : 'bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950/50 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div
              className={`p-2 rounded-xl ${
                isCritical
                  ? 'bg-rose-500 text-white shadow-rose-500/30'
                  : isModerate
                  ? 'bg-amber-500 text-white shadow-amber-500/30'
                  : 'bg-indigo-500 text-white shadow-indigo-500/30'
              } shadow-sm`}
            >
              <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                  Case #{incident.id}
                </span>
                <Badge
                  variant={isCritical ? 'destructive' : isModerate ? 'warning' : 'indigo'}
                  className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold"
                >
                  {incident.severity.replace('_', ' ')}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-950 dark:text-white mt-0.5">
                {incident.title}
              </h2>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-200/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="h-5 w-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content Body */}
        <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-4 font-sans text-xs">
          {/* Status Progression Banner */}
          <div className="p-3 px-4 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:bg-zinc-950/40 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Clock className="h-4 w-4 text-zinc-400" />
              <span className="text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">Current Status:</span>
              <Badge
                variant={
                  isResolved

                    : isEscalated

                    : incident.status === 'under_repair'

'use client'

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import {
  Timer,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  ChevronRight,
  Calendar,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { MasterRoutineItem } from '@/lib/master-data'
import { useInfrastructureState } from '@/hooks/use-infrastructure-state'

interface LiveSessionCockpitProps {
  ongoingSessions: MasterRoutineItem[]
  upcomingSessions: MasterRoutineItem[]
  passedUnloggedSessions: MasterRoutineItem[]
  loggedSessionsCount: number
  effectiveSessionsCount: number
  activeSlotId: string | null
  activePeriodName: string
  minutesRemaining: number
  currentUserRole?: string
  currentUserId?: string
  currentTeacherName?: string
  onOpenAction: (session: MasterRoutineItem, mode: 'log' | 'skip') => void
  onOpenTimetable?: () => void
  todayHolidayName?: string | null
}

export default function LiveSessionCockpit({
  ongoingSessions,
  upcomingSessions,
  passedUnloggedSessions,
  loggedSessionsCount,
  effectiveSessionsCount,
  activeSlotId,
  activePeriodName,
  minutesRemaining,
  currentUserRole,
  currentUserId,
  currentTeacherName,
  onOpenAction,
  onOpenTimetable,
  todayHolidayName,
}: LiveSessionCockpitProps) {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)
  const { faculty } = useInfrastructureState()
  const [selectedLabIndex, setSelectedLabIndex] = useState(0)

  // Guardrail 1: Hydration guard
  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true)
  }, [])

  // SKELETON / STATIC FALLBACK DURING SSR HYDRATION
  if (!mounted) {
    return (
      <div className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-3.5 sm:p-4 animate-pulse min-h-[100px] flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="h-4 w-40 bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 rounded-md" />
          <div className="h-5 w-64 bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 rounded-md" />
          <div className="h-3 w-48 bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 rounded-md" />
        </div>
        <div className="h-8.5 w-32 bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 rounded-xl" />
      </div>
    )
  }

  // Guardrail 3: Concurrent Multi-Lab Session Resolution
  const isTeacher = currentUserRole === 'teacher'
  let activeSession: MasterRoutineItem | null = null

  if (ongoingSessions.length > 0) {
    if (isTeacher) {
      // Teachers: Filter strictly by assigned class
      const teacherSession = ongoingSessions.find(
        (s) =>
          (currentTeacherName && s.teacher?.toLowerCase().includes(currentTeacherName.toLowerCase())) ||
          (currentUserId && (s as any).teacher_id === currentUserId)
      )
      activeSession = teacherSession || null
    } else {
      // Admins, Coordinators, Lab In-Charges: Allow switching across active rooms
      activeSession = ongoingSessions[selectedLabIndex] || ongoingSessions[0]
    }
  }

  // ==========================================
  // STATE A: ACTIVE PRACTICAL SESSION RUNNING
  // ==========================================
  if (activeSession) {
    const activeTeacher = activeSession.teacher
      ? faculty.find(
          (f) =>
            f.name.toLowerCase().includes(activeSession.teacher.toLowerCase()) ||
            activeSession.teacher.toLowerCase().includes(f.name.toLowerCase())
        )
      : null

    return (
      <div className="glass-card relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-emerald-500/35 dark:border-emerald-500/40 p-3.5 sm:p-4 shadow-[0_1px_3px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.06),0_1px_2px_-1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] bg-white dark:bg-surface-1 transition-all duration-200">
        {/* Milled Top Specular Sheen */}
        <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-[1px] bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-emerald-400/30 to-transparent pointer-events-none" />

        {/* Multi-Lab Horizontal Switcher for Admins/Coordinators */}
        {!isTeacher && ongoingSessions.length > 1 && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-2 mb-2.5 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-white/[0.06]">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 mr-1 shrink-0">
              Active Rooms ({ongoingSessions.length}):
            </span>
            {ongoingSessions.map((s, idx) => (
              <button
                key={s.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedLabIndex(idx)}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 active:scale-[0.97] motion-reduce:active:scale-100 ${
                  selectedLabIndex === idx
                    ? 'bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-white border border-zinc-700 dark:border-slate-600 shadow-xs'
                    : 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-surface-2 text-zinc-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-surface-3 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.06]'
                }`}
              >
                <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 shrink-0" />
                <span>{s.lab}</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] opacity-70">({s.grade})</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-3 sm:gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-1 min-w-0">
            {/* Live Period Beacon & Countdown (Sole Animated Micro-Accent) */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-sans font-bold bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30">
                <span className="relative flex h-2 w-2 shrink-0">
                  <span className="animate-radar-ripple absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-emerald-400 opacity-75" />
                  <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 bg-emerald-500 shadow-sm" />
                </span>
                <span>LIVE IN-SESSION • {activePeriodName.toUpperCase()}</span>
              </span>

              <span className="text-xs font-mono font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                {activeSession.timeSlot} • {activeSession.lab}
              </span>

              {minutesRemaining > 0 ? (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-mono font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-300 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-slate-800/80 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 dark:border-slate-700/60 tabular-nums">
                  <Timer className="h-3 w-3 text-zinc-400 dark:text-slate-400" />
                  {minutesRemaining}m remaining
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-xs font-mono text-zinc-400 italic">Period Concluding</span>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Experiment Subject Title */}
            <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold font-heading tracking-tight text-zinc-950 dark:text-white truncate">
              {activeSession.subjectCode} — {activeSession.subjectTitle}
            </h3>

            {/* Class Grade, Faculty, Strength Details */}
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-400 font-sans flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
              <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200">{activeSession.grade}</span> •{' '}
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                {activeTeacher?.photo_url && (
                  <img
                    src={activeTeacher.photo_url}
                    alt={activeSession.teacher}
                    className="h-4.5 w-4.5 rounded-full object-cover border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 inline-block"
                  />
                )}
                Faculty Supervisor: <strong className="text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 font-semibold">{activeSession.teacher}</strong>
              </span> • Strength:{' '}
              <span className="font-mono font-bold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{activeSession.defaultStudents} Students</span>
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Action Station CTAs: Log = Primary (Indigo), Skip = Secondary (Neutral Outline) */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 self-start lg:self-center">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              className="h-8.5 px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 cursor-pointer active:scale-[0.97] transition-transform motion-reduce:active:scale-100 rounded-xl"
              onClick={() => onOpenAction(activeSession!, 'skip')}
            >
              Skip Session
            </Button>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              className="h-8.5 px-3.5 text-xs font-bold bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white shadow-xs rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer active:scale-[0.97] transition-transform motion-reduce:active:scale-100"
              onClick={() => onOpenAction(activeSession!, 'log')}
            >
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Log Practical Session</span>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // STATE B: OFF-HOURS / BREAK / NEXT UP (NO ACTIVE SESSION)
  // ==========================================================
  const nextSession = upcomingSessions.length > 0 ? upcomingSessions[0] : null
  const allCompleted = upcomingSessions.length === 0 && effectiveSessionsCount > 0

  return (
    <div className="glass-card relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl p-3.5 sm:p-4 transition-all duration-300">
      {/* Milled Top Specular Sheen */}
      <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-[1px] bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/15 to-transparent pointer-events-none" />

      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 sm:gap-4">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
          <div className="h-9 w-9 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-surface-2 flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 shrink-0 border border-zinc-200/60 dark:border-border-subtle shadow-2xs">
            {todayHolidayName ? (
              <Calendar className="h-4.5 w-4.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400" />
            ) : allCompleted ? (
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-4.5 w-4.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400" />
            ) : (
              <Clock className="h-4.5 w-4.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400" />
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold font-sans uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                {todayHolidayName
                  ? 'Official Holiday Active'
                  : allCompleted
                  ? 'Daily Timetable Concluded'
                  : 'Break / Between Periods'}
              </span>

              {allCompleted && (
                <span className="px-2 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[11px] font-sans font-semibold bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-surface-2 text-zinc-700 dark:text-slate-300 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-border-subtle">
                  {loggedSessionsCount}/{effectiveSessionsCount} Logged
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            {todayHolidayName ? (
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold font-heading text-zinc-950 dark:text-white">
                  {todayHolidayName}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-sans">
                  Laboratory practical operations suspended today. Regular sessions resume tomorrow.
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : nextSession ? (
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold font-heading text-zinc-950 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span>Next Practical:</span>
                  <span className="text-zinc-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-bold">
                    {nextSession.subjectTitle} ({nextSession.grade})
                  </span>
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-sans">
                  Scheduled for <strong>{nextSession.timeSlot}</strong> in {nextSession.lab} • Faculty:{' '}
                  {nextSession.teacher}
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : allCompleted ? (
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold font-heading text-zinc-950 dark:text-white">
                  All sessions concluded for today
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-sans">
                  {passedUnloggedSessions.length > 0
                    ? `${passedUnloggedSessions.length} past session log${passedUnloggedSessions.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} awaiting completion.`
                    : 'All session logs verified.'}
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold font-heading text-zinc-950 dark:text-white">
                  No sessions scheduled today
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-sans">
                  Check timetable or schedule new slots.
                </p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Timetable Quick Action */}
        <div className="shrink-0 self-start sm:self-center">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            className="h-8 px-3 text-xs font-sans gap-1.5 text-zinc-700 dark:text-slate-300 border-zinc-200 dark:border-border-card hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-surface-2 shadow-2xs font-semibold cursor-pointer rounded-xl"
            onClick={onOpenTimetable}
          >
            <span>View Timetable</span>
            <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-zinc-400" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import React, { useState } from 'react'
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  X,
  Plus,
  Building2,
  Send,
  ShieldAlert,
  Clock,
  UserCheck,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { useIncidentState } from '@/hooks/use-incident-state'
import { useInfrastructureState } from '@/hooks/use-infrastructure-state'
import { getNepalDateStr } from '@/lib/nepali-date'
import { MASTER_TIME_SLOTS } from '@/lib/master-data'
import { useUserScope } from '@/hooks/use-user-scope'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { Select } from '@/components/ui/select'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { IncidentPhotoUploader, UploadedPhoto } from '@/components/incidents/incident-photo-uploader'

interface ReportIncidentModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean
  onClose: () => void
  onSuccess?: (msg: string) => void
  defaultLabId?: string
}

export default function ReportIncidentModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
  defaultLabId = 'chem',
}: ReportIncidentModalProps) {
  const { logIncident } = useIncidentState()
  const { faculty, classes, incidentCategories } = useInfrastructureState()
  const { scope, isTeacher } = useUserScope()

  // Primary focus on Physics, Chemistry, and Computer labs
  const TARGET_LABS = [
    { id: 'phys', name: 'Physics Laboratory' },
    { id: 'chem', name: 'Chemistry Laboratory' },
    { id: 'comp', name: 'Computer Laboratory' },
    { id: 'elec', name: 'Electronics & Hardware Lab' },
    { id: 'bio', name: 'Biology & Life Sciences Lab' },
  ]

  const availableClasses =
    isTeacher && scope?.assignedClasses && scope.assignedClasses.length > 0
      ? classes.filter((c) => scope.assignedClasses.includes(c.name))
      : classes

  const [labId, setLabId] = useState<string>(defaultLabId)
  const [periodSlot, setPeriodSlot] = useState<string>('Period 2 (11:00 - 11:45)')
  const [batchName, setBatchName] = useState<string>(availableClasses[0]?.name || '12 Eng')
  const [teacherName, setTeacherName] = useState<string>(
    isTeacher && scope?.fullName ? scope.fullName : faculty[0]?.name || 'Dr. Prakash Adhikari'
  )
  const [incidentType, setIncidentType] = useState<string>(incidentCategories[0]?.code || 'breakage')
  const [severity, setSeverity] = useState<any>('minor')
  const [equipmentName, setEquipmentName] = useState<string>('')
  const [incidentTitle, setIncidentTitle] = useState<string>('')
  const [circumstances, setCircumstances] = useState<string>('')
  const [studentRolls, setStudentRolls] = useState<string>('')
  const [photos, setPhotos] = useState<UploadedPhoto[]>([])
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState<boolean>(false)

  // Reactively sync teacherName when scope loads
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (isTeacher && scope?.fullName) {
      setTeacherName(scope.fullName)
    }
  }, [isTeacher, scope?.fullName])

  if (!isOpen) return null

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!incidentTitle.trim() && !circumstances.trim()) return

    setIsSubmitting(true)
    try {
      const displayTitle =
        incidentTitle.trim() ||
        `${incidentType.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase()} in ${labId.toUpperCase()} Lab (${periodSlot})`

      const primaryPhotoUrl = photos.length > 0 ? (photos[0].dataUrl || photos[0].previewUrl) : undefined

      await logIncident({
        lab_id: labId,
        date: getNepalDateStr(),
        session_label: periodSlot,
        subject_name: `${labId.toUpperCase()} Practical Session`,
        subject_teacher_name: teacherName,
        batch_name: batchName,
        title: displayTitle,
        circumstances: circumstances.trim() || undefined,
        photo_url: primaryPhotoUrl,
        incident_type: incidentType as any,
        severity: severity,
        equipment_name: equipmentName.trim() || 'Lab Equipment / Workstation',
        quantity: 1,
        student_rolls: studentRolls.trim() || undefined,
        resolution_notes: undefined,
        reported_by: teacherName,
        reported_by_id: scope?.userId || undefined,
      })

      if (onSuccess) {
        onSuccess(
          severity === 'major_critical'
            ? 'Major damage reported. High-priority alert routed to HOD and Admin.'
            : 'Incident reported. Notified Lab In-Charge and Admin.'
        )
      }
      onClose()
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-150 select-none">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-2xl sm:max-w-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)] sm:max-h-[88vh] my-auto">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="p-4 px-6 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950/50 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-200/60 dark:border-indigo-800/60 shadow-xs shrink-0">
              <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-heading font-bold text-zinc-950 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
                Report Laboratory Incident & Equipment Damage
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 font-sans mt-0.5">
                Log equipment damage or malfunction
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-200/50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="h-4 w-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Form Container with Flex and Min-H-0 for Safari-Safe Docking */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex flex-col flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-hidden">
          {/* Scrollable Form Body */}
          <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-4.5 text-sm font-sans flex-1 min-h-0">
            {/* Target Facility Lab & Period Slot */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3.5">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-sans">
                  Target Laboratory <span className="text-rose-500 font-bold">*</span>
                </label>
                <Select value={labId} onChange={(e) => setLabId(e.target.value)}>
                  {TARGET_LABS.map((lab) => (
                    <option key={lab.id} value={lab.id}>
                      {lab.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </Select>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-sans">
                  Period / Time Slot <span className="text-rose-500 font-bold">*</span>
                </label>
                <Select value={periodSlot} onChange={(e) => setPeriodSlot(e.target.value)}>
                  {MASTER_TIME_SLOTS.map((s) => (
                    <option key={s.id} value={`${s.name} (${s.label})`}>
                      {s.name} ({s.label})
                    </option>
                  ))}
                  <option value="Preparation / Non-Session Hours">
                    Preparation / Non-Session Hours
                  </option>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Incident Category & Severity */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3.5">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-sans">
                  Incident Category <span className="text-rose-500 font-bold">*</span>
                </label>
                <Select
                  value={incidentType}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const val = e.target.value
                    setIncidentType(val)
                    const found = incidentCategories.find((c) => c.code === val)
                    if (found) setSeverity(found.severity)
                  }}
                >
                  {incidentCategories.map((cat) => (
                    <option key={cat.id} value={cat.code}>
                      {cat.name.replace(/Apparatus/g, 'Equipment')}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </Select>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-sans">
                  Severity Level <span className="text-rose-500 font-bold">*</span>
                </label>
                <Select value={severity} onChange={(e) => setSeverity(e.target.value as any)}>
                  <option value="minor">Minor (Low Impact / Internal Fix)</option>
                  <option value="moderate">Moderate (Store Replacement Needed)</option>
                  <option value="major_critical">Major / Critical (Direct HOD Attention)</option>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Summary Title & Equipment Name */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3.5">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-sans">
                  Equipment / Item Affected <span className="text-rose-500 font-bold">*</span>
                </label>
                <Input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="e.g. PC-04, Multimeter, 50ml Burette"
                  value={equipmentName}
                  onChange={(e) => setEquipmentName(e.target.value)}
                  className="bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 text-sm font-sans"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-sans">
                  Incident Summary Headline <span className="text-rose-500 font-bold">*</span>
                </label>
                <Input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  placeholder="e.g. Cracked beaker or screen flicker"
                  value={incidentTitle}
                  onChange={(e) => setIncidentTitle(e.target.value)}
                  className="bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 text-sm font-sans"
                />

            </div>

            {/* What Happened (Detailed Circumstances & Equipment Details) */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-sans">
                What Happened & Details <span className="text-rose-500 font-bold">*</span>

              <textarea

                onChange={(e) => setCircumstances(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Describe what happened and any action taken..."
