'use client'

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react'
import {
  Check,
  AlertTriangle,
  RotateCcw,
  CheckCheck,
  Monitor,
  Plus,
  Minus,
  Trash2,
  Sliders,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'

export type WorkstationState = 'pending' | 'serviced' | 'flagged'

interface WorkstationMatrixSelectorProps {
  initialServiced?: string[]
  initialFlagged?: string[]
  totalWorkstations?: number
  labName?: string
  onChange: (data: {
    serviced: string[]
    flagged: string[]
    summaryText: string
  }) => void
}

export default function WorkstationMatrixSelector({
  initialServiced = [],
  initialFlagged = [],
  totalWorkstations = 40,
  labName = 'Computer Lab 01',
  onChange,
}: WorkstationMatrixSelectorProps) {
  // Generate initial list of PCs based on capacity
  const generateDefaultIds = (count: number) => {
    return Array.from({ length: Math.max(1, count) }, (_, i) => {
      const num = i + 1
      return `PC-${num < 10 ? '0' : ''}${num}`
    })
  }

  // Workstation IDs state (allows dynamic additions / removals)
  const [workstationIds, setWorkstationIds] = useState<string[]>(() =>
    generateDefaultIds(totalWorkstations)
  )

  // Track if user is in "Configure Stations" mode
  const [isConfiguring, setIsConfiguring] = useState(false)
  const [newStationInput, setNewStationInput] = useState('')
  const [customError, setCustomError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // Sync with prop when totalWorkstations changes and not actively configured
  useEffect(() => {
    setWorkstationIds((prev) => {
      // If the length already matches or stations were customized, don't clobber unless empty
      if (prev.length === totalWorkstations) return prev
      return generateDefaultIds(totalWorkstations)
    })
  }, [totalWorkstations])

  // Station status tracking (pending | serviced | flagged)
  const [states, setStates] = useState<Record<string, WorkstationState>>(() => {
    const initial: Record<string, WorkstationState> = {}
    workstationIds.forEach((id) => {
      if (initialFlagged.includes(id)) {
        initial[id] = 'flagged'
      } else if (initialServiced.includes(id)) {
        initial[id] = 'serviced'
      } else {
        initial[id] = 'pending'
      }
    })
    return initial
  })

  // Group into Rows of 10 Desks (Rows A, B, C, D, E, etc.)
  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    const rowLetters = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H']
    const result: { letter: string; items: string[] }[] = []
    const perRow = 10
    const totalRows = Math.ceil(workstationIds.length / perRow)

    for (let r = 0; r < totalRows; r++) {
      result.push({
        letter: rowLetters[r] || `R${r + 1}`,
        items: workstationIds.slice(r * perRow, (r + 1) * perRow),
      })
    }
    return result
  }, [workstationIds])

  // Count metrics
  const servicedList = useMemo(
    () => workstationIds.filter((id) => states[id] === 'serviced'),
    [workstationIds, states]
  )
  const flaggedList = useMemo(
    () => workstationIds.filter((id) => states[id] === 'flagged'),
    [workstationIds, states]
  )
  const pendingCount = workstationIds.length - servicedList.length - flaggedList.length

  // Synchronize upstream on state change
  useEffect(() => {
    let summaryText = ''
    if (servicedList.length === workstationIds.length && workstationIds.length > 0) {
      summaryText = `All ${workstationIds.length} Workstations Serviced (${workstationIds[0]} to ${workstationIds[workstationIds.length - 1]})`
    } else if (servicedList.length > 0 && flaggedList.length > 0) {
      summaryText = `${servicedList.length} Workstations Serviced, ${flaggedList.length} Flagged (${flaggedList.join(', ')})`
    } else if (servicedList.length > 0) {
      summaryText = `${servicedList.length} of ${workstationIds.length} Workstations Serviced (${servicedList.slice(0, 4).join(', ')}${servicedList.length > 4 ? `... +${servicedList.length - 4}` : ''})`
    } else if (flaggedList.length > 0) {
      summaryText = `${flaggedList.length} Workstations Flagged for Repair (${flaggedList.join(', ')})`
    } else {
      summaryText = `${labName} (${workstationIds.length} Workstations - Pending Selection)`
    }

    onChange({
      serviced: servicedList,
      flagged: flaggedList,
      summaryText,
    })
  }, [servicedList, flaggedList, workstationIds, labName, onChange])

  // 0ms Optimistic 3-State Cycle: Pending -> Serviced -> Flagged -> Pending
  const toggleWorkstation = (id: string) => {
    if (isConfiguring) return // Disable normal cycle when editing station layout
    setStates((prev) => {
      const current = prev[id] || 'pending'
      let next: WorkstationState = 'serviced'
      if (current === 'serviced') next = 'flagged'
      else if (current === 'flagged') next = 'pending'
      else next = 'serviced'

      return {
        ...prev,
        [id]: next,
      }
    })
  }

  // --- Dynamic Station Management Handlers ---

  // 1. Add single PC (appends next sequential number)
  const handleAddSequentialPC = () => {
    setWorkstationIds((prev) => {
      const numbers = prev
        .map((id) => {
          const match = id.match(/PC-(\d+)/)
          return match ? parseInt(match[1], 10) : 0
        })
        .filter((n) => !isNaN(n))
      const nextNum = (numbers.length > 0 ? Math.max(...numbers) : prev.length) + 1
      const newId = `PC-${nextNum < 10 ? '0' : ''}${nextNum}`
      if (prev.includes(newId)) {
        return [...prev, `PC-${nextNum + 1}`]
      }
      return [...prev, newId]
    })
    setCustomError(null)
  }

  // 2. Remove last PC
  const handleRemoveLastPC = () => {
    if (workstationIds.length <= 1) return
    const idToRemove = workstationIds[workstationIds.length - 1]
    setWorkstationIds((prev) => prev.slice(0, -1))
    setStates((prev) => {
      const copy = { ...prev }
      delete copy[idToRemove]
      return copy
    })
    setCustomError(null)
  }

  // 3. Remove specific PC number (e.g. PC-15 was decommissioned or sent for repair)
  const handleRemoveSpecificStation = (idToRemove: string) => {
    if (workstationIds.length <= 1) {
      setCustomError('At least 1 workstation must remain in the grid.')
      return
    }
    setWorkstationIds((prev) => prev.filter((id) => id !== idToRemove))
    setStates((prev) => {
      const copy = { ...prev }
      delete copy[idToRemove]
      return copy
    })
    setCustomError(null)
  }

  // 4. Add custom workstation identifier (e.g. "PC-41", "SRV-01", "INSTRUCTOR-PC")
  const handleAddCustomStation = (e?: React.SyntheticEvent) => {
    if (e) {
      e.preventDefault()
      e.stopPropagation()
    }
    const trimmed = newStationInput.trim().toUpperCase()
    if (!trimmed) return

    if (workstationIds.includes(trimmed)) {
      setCustomError(`Station "${trimmed}" already exists in the grid.`)
      return
    }

    setWorkstationIds((prev) => [...prev, trimmed])
    setNewStationInput('')
    setCustomError(null)
  }

  // 5. Jump to preset count (30, 36, 40, 48)
  const handleSetPresetCount = (count: number) => {
    setWorkstationIds(generateDefaultIds(count))
    setStates({})
    setCustomError(null)
  }

  // 6. Reset to default capacity
  const handleResetToDefault = () => {
    setWorkstationIds(generateDefaultIds(totalWorkstations))
    setStates({})
    setCustomError(null)
  }

  // Batch actions
  const selectAll = () => {
    const updated: Record<string, WorkstationState> = {}
    workstationIds.forEach((id) => {
      updated[id] = 'serviced'
    })
    setStates(updated)
  }

  const invertSelection = () => {
    setStates((prev) => {
      const updated: Record<string, WorkstationState> = {}
      workstationIds.forEach((id) => {
        const current = prev[id] || 'pending'
        if (current === 'pending') updated[id] = 'serviced'
        else if (current === 'serviced') updated[id] = 'pending'
        else updated[id] = current
      })
      return updated
    })
  }

  const selectProblematicOnly = () => {
    setStates((prev) => {
      const updated: Record<string, WorkstationState> = {}
      workstationIds.forEach((id) => {
        if (prev[id] === 'flagged') {
          updated[id] = 'flagged'
        } else {
          updated[id] = 'pending'
        }
      })
      if (Object.values(updated).filter((s) => s === 'flagged').length === 0) {
        if (workstationIds[13]) updated[workstationIds[13]] = 'flagged'
        if (workstationIds[27]) updated[workstationIds[27]] = 'flagged'
      }
      return updated
    })
  }

  const clearAll = () => {
    const updated: Record<string, WorkstationState> = {}
    workstationIds.forEach((id) => {
      updated[id] = 'pending'
    })
    setStates(updated)
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3 p-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/50 dark:bg-zinc-950/40 select-none">
      {/* Header & Status Indicator */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2.5 pb-2.5 border-b border-zinc-200/60 dark:border-zinc-800/80">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="h-7 w-7 rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 flex items-center justify-center border border-indigo-200/60 dark:border-indigo-800/60 shrink-0">
            <Monitor className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h4 className="text-xs font-bold font-heading text-zinc-950 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span>Interactive Workstation Grid</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-bold">
                {workstationIds.length} PCs
              </span>
            </h4>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 font-sans">
              {isConfiguring ? (
                <span className="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-semibold">
                  Layout Mode: Click any red [×] to remove a PC, or use the controls below to add stations.
                </span>
              ) : (
                <>
                  Click desk to cycle:{' '}
                  <strong className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-semibold">1-Click (Cleaned)</strong> •{' '}
                  <strong className="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-semibold">2-Clicks (Flagged)</strong> •{' '}
                  <span className="text-zinc-400">3-Clicks (Reset)</span>
                </>
              )}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Action / Mode Toggle & Metrics */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => {
              setIsConfiguring(!isConfiguring)
              setCustomError(null)
            }}
            className={`h-7 px-2.5 text-[11px] font-sans font-semibold rounded-lg cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors ${
              isConfiguring
                ? 'bg-amber-500 text-white border-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-600 dark:hover:bg-amber-700'
                : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800'
            }`}
          >
            <Sliders className="h-3 w-3" />
            <span>{isConfiguring ? 'Done Editing' : 'Add / Remove PCs'}</span>
          </Button>

          {/* Live Counter Badges (only when not configuring) */}
          {!isConfiguring && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-[10px]">
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300/60 dark:border-emerald-800/60 flex items-center gap-1">
                <Check className="h-3 w-3" />
                <span>{servicedList.length}</span>
              </span>

              {flaggedList.length > 0 && (
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/50 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-300/60 dark:border-rose-800/60 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3" />
                  <span>{flaggedList.length}</span>
                </span>
              )}

              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700">
                {pendingCount}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* --- WORKSTATION CONFIGURATION DRAWER (Add / Remove PC Toolbar) --- */}
      {isConfiguring && (
        <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-50/70 dark:bg-amber-950/20 border border-amber-200/80 dark:border-amber-800/40 space-y-2.5 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
            {/* Stepper Controls */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                Station Count:
              </span>
              <div className="flex items-center border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-2xs">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleRemoveLastPC}
                  disabled={workstationIds.length <= 1}
                  title="Remove highest PC"
                  className="h-7 w-7 flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Minus className="h-3 w-3" />
                </button>
                <span className="px-2.5 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
                  {workstationIds.length}
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleAddSequentialPC}
                  title="Add next PC"
                  className="h-7 w-7 flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Plus className="h-3 w-3" />
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Quick Presets */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 pl-1">
                {[30, 36, 40, 48].map((preset) => (
                  <button
                    key={preset}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleSetPresetCount(preset)}
                    className={`h-7 px-2 text-[10px] font-mono font-bold rounded-md border cursor-pointer transition-colors ${
                      workstationIds.length === preset
                        ? 'bg-amber-600 text-white border-amber-700 shadow-2xs'
                        : 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {preset}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Custom Identifier Input */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Custom ID (e.g. PC-41)"
                value={newStationInput}
                onChange={(e) => setNewStationInput(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                    e.preventDefault()
                    e.stopPropagation()
                    handleAddCustomStation(e)
                  }
                }}
                className="h-7 px-2.5 text-xs font-mono rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500 w-44"
              />
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                onClick={handleAddCustomStation}
                className="h-7 px-2 text-xs font-semibold bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1"
              >
                <Plus className="h-3 w-3" />
                <span>Add Station</span>
              </Button>
            </div>

            {/* Reset to Lab Default */}
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleResetToDefault}
              className="h-7 px-2 text-[11px] font-sans text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="h-3 w-3" />
              <span>Reset to {totalWorkstations}</span>
            </Button>
          </div>

          {customError && (
            <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-medium">
              {customError}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Batch Action Toolbar (only in logging mode) */}
      {!isConfiguring && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-1.5 pt-0.5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 font-mono">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={selectAll}
              className="h-7 px-2.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-300/70 dark:border-emerald-800/60 hover:bg-emerald-50 dark:hover:bg-emerald-950/40 cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1"
            >
              <CheckCheck className="h-3 w-3" />
              <span>Select All ({workstationIds.length})</span>
            </Button>

            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={invertSelection}
              className="h-7 px-2 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <span>Invert</span>
            </Button>

            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={selectProblematicOnly}
              className="h-7 px-2 text-[11px] font-semibold text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-300/70 dark:border-rose-800/60 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1"
            >
              <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3" />
              <span>Flag Faults</span>
            </Button>
          </div>

          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={clearAll}
            className="h-7 px-2 text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="h-3 w-3" />
            <span>Reset</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Dynamic Workstation Matrix Grid (Rows A to N, 10 desks per row) */}
      <div className="space-y-2 pt-1 font-mono">
        {rows.map((row) => (
          <div key={row.letter} className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="w-5 text-[10px] font-black text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 text-center shrink-0">
              {row.letter}
            </span>

            <div className="flex-1 grid grid-cols-5 sm:grid-cols-10 gap-1.5">
              {row.items.map((id) => {
                const state = states[id] || 'pending'
                const isServiced = state === 'serviced'
                const isFlagged = state === 'flagged'

                return (
                  <div key={id} className="relative group">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => toggleWorkstation(id)}
                      disabled={isConfiguring}
                      title={
                        isConfiguring
                          ? `Click the red [×] above to remove ${id}`
                          : `${id}: ${isServiced ? 'Cleaned & Tested (click to flag)' : isFlagged ? 'Fault / Damaged (click to reset)' : 'Pending (click to mark cleaned)'}`
                      }
                      className={`w-full h-8 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1 shadow-2xs select-none ${
                        isConfiguring
                          ? 'border-2 border-dashed border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 bg-amber-50/40 dark:bg-amber-950/20 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 cursor-default'
                          : 'cursor-pointer active:scale-95'
                      } ${
                        !isConfiguring && isServiced
                          ? 'bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white border border-emerald-500 shadow-xs'
                          : !isConfiguring && isFlagged
                          ? 'bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white border border-rose-500 shadow-xs animate-pulse'
                          : !isConfiguring
                          ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200/90 dark:border-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/80 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-700'
                          : ''
                      }`}
                    >
                      {!isConfiguring && isServiced ? (
                        <Check className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0 stroke-[2.5]" />
                      ) : !isConfiguring && isFlagged ? (
                        <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" />
                      ) : null}
                      <span className="text-[11px] tracking-tight">
                        {id.startsWith('PC-') ? id.replace('PC-', '') : id}
                      </span>

interface CategoryAdminModalProps {
  categories: IssueCategoryRow[]
  isOpen: boolean
  onClose: () => void
  onSuccess: () => void

const COLOR_PRESETS = [
  '#EF4444', // Red
  '#F59E0B', // Amber
  '#10B981', // Emerald
  '#3B82F6', // Blue
  '#6366F1', // Indigo
  '#8B5CF6', // Purple
  '#EC4899', // Pink
  '#06B6D4', // Cyan
  '#64748B', // Slate

export function CategoryAdminModal({
  categories,
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
}: CategoryAdminModalProps) {
  const [editingCat, setEditingCat] = useState<IssueCategoryRow | null>(null)
  const [isCreatingNew, setIsCreatingNew] = useState(false)
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // Form State
  const [name, setName] = useState('')
  const [type, setType] = useState<'hardware' | 'software' | 'network' | 'peripheral' | 'other'>('hardware')
  const [color, setColor] = useState('#6366F1')
  const [defaultSeverity, setDefaultSeverity] = useState<'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical'>('medium')
  const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState(0)

  if (!isOpen) return null

  const startCreate = () => {
    setEditingCat(null)
    setName('')
    setType('hardware')
    setColor('#6366F1')
    setDefaultSeverity('medium')
    setSortOrder(categories.length + 1)
    setIsCreatingNew(true)
    setErrorMessage(null)
  }

  const startEdit = (cat: IssueCategoryRow) => {
    setIsCreatingNew(false)
    setEditingCat(cat)
    setName(cat.name)
    setType(cat.type)
    setColor(cat.color)
    setDefaultSeverity(cat.default_severity)
    setSortOrder(cat.sort_order)
    setErrorMessage(null)
  }

  const cancelEdit = () => {
    setEditingCat(null)
    setIsCreatingNew(false)
    setErrorMessage(null)
  }

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!name.trim()) {
      setErrorMessage('Category name is required.')
      return
    }

    setSubmitting(true)
    setErrorMessage(null)

    try {
      const payload: IssueCategoryInput = {
        name: name.trim(),
        type,
        color,
        icon: 'AlertTriangle',
        default_severity: defaultSeverity,
        sort_order: sortOrder,
      }

      if (isCreatingNew) {
        const res = await manageIssueCategory('create', payload)
        if (!res.success) throw new Error(res.error || 'Failed to create category.')
      } else if (editingCat) {
        payload.id = editingCat.id
        const res = await manageIssueCategory('update', payload)
        if (!res.success) throw new Error(res.error || 'Failed to update category.')
      }

      cancelEdit()
      onSuccess()
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Save failed'
      setErrorMessage(msg)
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false)
    }
  }

  const handleDelete = async (cat: IssueCategoryRow) => {
    if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to retire category "${cat.name}"? If historical issues exist, it will be safely archived.`)) {
      return
    }

    setSubmitting(true)
    setErrorMessage(null)

    try {
      const res = await manageIssueCategory('delete', {
        id: cat.id,
        name: cat.name,
        type: cat.type,
        color: cat.color,
        icon: cat.icon,
        default_severity: cat.default_severity,
      })
      if (!res.success) throw new Error(res.error || 'Failed to delete category.')
      onSuccess()
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Delete failed'
      setErrorMessage(msg)
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm">
      <div className="relative flex max-h-[90vh] w-full max-w-2xl flex-col rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#101726] shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32]/70 px-6 py-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-400">
              <Layers className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-heading font-extrabold text-base text-white">
                Workstation Issue Taxonomy
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                Manage hardware, software, network, and peripheral diagnostic classifications
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] p-2 text-slate-400 hover:bg-white/[0.06] hover:text-white"
          >
            <X className="h-5 w-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6 space-y-4">
          {errorMessage && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-rose-500/40 bg-rose-500/10 p-3 text-xs text-rose-300">
              {errorMessage}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Form for Create / Edit */}
          {(isCreatingNew || editingCat) && (
            <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-500/30 bg-[#151E32] p-4 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/[0.06] pb-2">
                <h4 className="font-heading font-semibold text-xs text-indigo-300">
                  {isCreatingNew ? 'Create New Category' : `Edit: ${editingCat?.name}`}
                </h4>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={cancelEdit}
                  className="text-xs text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
                >
                  Cancel

'use client'

import React from 'react'
import {
  Presentation,
  Tv,
  DoorOpen,
  Maximize2,
  Box,
  Archive,
  Server,
  Flame,
  Tag,
  RotateCw,
  Trash2,
} from 'lucide-react'
import type { LabFloorElementRow } from '@/types/database'
import { FLOOR_ELEMENT_CATALOG } from '@/lib/floor-elements'

interface FloorLandmarkNodeProps {
  element: LabFloorElementRow
  isLayoutMode?: boolean
  isSelected?: boolean
  onDragStart?: (e: React.PointerEvent, el: LabFloorElementRow) => void
  onRotate?: (el: LabFloorElementRow) => void
  onDelete?: (el: LabFloorElementRow) => void
  onClick?: () => void
}

function getLandmarkIcon(type: string) {
  switch (type) {
    case 'teacher_desk':
      return Presentation
    case 'whiteboard':
    case 'projector_screen':
      return Tv
    case 'door':
      return DoorOpen
    case 'window':
      return Maximize2
    case 'pillar':
      return Box
    case 'storage_rack':
      return Archive
    case 'network_rack':
      return Server
    case 'fire_extinguisher':
      return Flame
    default:
      return Tag
  }
}

export function FloorLandmarkNode({
  element,
  isLayoutMode = false,
  isSelected = false,
  onDragStart,
  onRotate,
  onDelete,
  onClick,
}: FloorLandmarkNodeProps) {
  const Icon = getLandmarkIcon(element.element_type)
  const meta = FLOOR_ELEMENT_CATALOG[element.element_type] || {
    color: '#6366F1',
    category: 'teaching',
  }

  // Visual styling variants based on landmark category & type
  const isTeaching = element.element_type === 'teacher_desk' || element.element_type === 'whiteboard' || element.element_type === 'projector_screen'
  const isDoor = element.element_type === 'door'
  const isSafety = element.element_type === 'fire_extinguisher'

  let containerStyle = 'border-slate-700/60 bg-[#151E32]/70 text-slate-300'
  let accentColor = meta.color

  if (element.element_type === 'whiteboard') {
    containerStyle = 'border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-950/20 text-emerald-200'
  } else if (element.element_type === 'teacher_desk') {
    containerStyle = 'border-indigo-500/40 bg-indigo-950/30 text-indigo-200 shadow-md'
  } else if (isDoor) {
    containerStyle = 'border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-950/20 text-amber-200'
  } else if (isSafety) {
    containerStyle = 'border-rose-500/40 bg-rose-950/30 text-rose-200'
  }

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        left: `${element.pos_x}%`,
        top: `${element.pos_y}%`,
        width: isTeaching ? 'auto' : undefined,
        transform: `translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(${element.rotation || 0}deg)`,
      }}
      onPointerDown={isLayoutMode ? (e) => onDragStart?.(e, element) : undefined}
      onClick={onClick}
      className={`group absolute select-none transition-shadow ${
        isLayoutMode
          ? 'cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing hover:scale-105 z-20 ring-1 ring-amber-400/40'
          : 'cursor-default z-0'
      }`}
    >
      <div
        className={`relative flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border px-3 py-1.5 backdrop-blur-md shadow-xs transition-all ${containerStyle} ${
          isSelected ? 'ring-2 ring-indigo-400 border-indigo-400' : ''
        }`}
      >
        <div
          className="flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-lg"
          style={{ backgroundColor: `${accentColor}20`, color: accentColor }}
        >
          <Icon className="h-3 w-3" />
        </div>

        <span className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-bold tracking-tight whitespace-nowrap">
          {element.label}
        </span>

        {/* Layout Mode Controls: Rotate & Delete */}
        {isLayoutMode && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 ml-1.5 pl-1.5 border-l border-white/10">
            {onRotate && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation()
                  onRotate(element)
                }}
                className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-300 hover:text-white"
                title="Rotate 90°"
              >
                <RotateCw className="h-3 w-3" />
              </button>
            )}
            {onDelete && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation()
                  onDelete(element)
                }}
                className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-300"
                title="Remove landmark"
              >
                <Trash2 className="h-3 w-3" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Coordinate pip in layout mode */}
      {isLayoutMode && (
        <div className="absolute -bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 font-mono text-[8px] text-slate-400 bg-slate-900/90 px-1 rounded whitespace-nowrap">
          {Math.round(element.pos_x)}%, {Math.round(element.pos_y)}% ({element.rotation || 0}°)
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

  // Seat Plan State

  const [floorElements, setFloorElements] = useState<LabFloorElementRow[]>([])
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)

  const [actionMessage, setActionMessage] = useState<{ text: string; type: 'success' | 'error' } | null>(null)

  const [isMobileTrayOpen, setIsMobileTrayOpen] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadMeta() {
      try {
        const [yearsRes, classesRes] = await Promise.all([
          getAcademicYears(),
          getAuthorizedClasses(),
        ])

        if (yearsRes.success && yearsRes.data) {
          setAcademicYears(yearsRes.data)
          const current = yearsRes.data.find((y: any) => y.is_current)
          if (current) setSelectedYearId(current.id)
        }

        if (classesRes.success && classesRes.data && classesRes.data.length > 0) {
          setClasses(classesRes.data)
          const defaultClass = classesRes.data.find((c: any) => c.id === '12eng') || classesRes.data[0]
          setSelectedClassId(defaultClass.id)

      ])

        setError(seatRes.error || 'Failed to load seat plan.')
        setPlanData(null)
      } else {
        setPlanData(seatRes.data)
      }

      if (floorRes.success && floorRes.data) {

      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {

      setError(msg)
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }, [labId, selectedClassId, selectedYearId])

  }, [fetchSeatPlan])

  }

  // 4. Click Handler for Workstation Node
  const handleWorkstationClick = (ws: WorkstationWithAssignment) => {
    // If a student is currently selected in tray -> assign to this workstation!
    if (selectedStudent) {
      if (!isPrivileged) {
        notify('Read-Only View: Seat assignments can only be modified by Super Admin or Lab In-Charge.', 'error')
        setSelectedStudent(null)
        return
      }
      handleAssignToWorkstation(ws, selectedStudent.enrollment_id)
      return
    }

    // Otherwise, open node action modal
    setActiveWsModal(ws)
  }

  // 5. Drag & Drop Handlers
  const handleDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent, wsId: string) => {
    if (!isPrivileged) return
    e.preventDefault()
    e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'copy'
    setDragOverWsId(wsId)
  }

  const handleDragLeave = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    if (!isPrivileged) return
    e.preventDefault()
    setDragOverWsId(null)
  }

  const handleDrop = async (e: React.DragEvent, ws: WorkstationWithAssignment) => {
    if (!isPrivileged) {
      notify('Read-Only View: Seat assignments can only be modified by Super Admin or Lab In-Charge.', 'error')
      return
    }
    e.preventDefault()
    setDragOverWsId(null)

    const rawData = e.dataTransfer.getData('application/json')
    if (!rawData) return

    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(rawData)
      if (parsed.type === 'student' && parsed.enrollment_id) {
        handleAssignToWorkstation(ws, parsed.enrollment_id)
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Invalid drag payload:', err)
    }
  }

  // 6. Student Swap Execution
  const handleExecuteSwap = async () => {
    if (!activeWsModal || !swapTargetWsId) return

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await swapStudents({
          lab_id: labId,
          academic_year_id: selectedYearId,
          class_id: selectedClassId,
          workstation_id_a: activeWsModal.id,
          workstation_id_b: swapTargetWsId,
        })

        if (!res.success) {
          notify(res.error || 'Swap failed', 'error')
        } else {
          notify('Students swapped successfully', 'success')
          setIsSwapDialogOpen(false)
          setActiveWsModal(null)
          setSwapTargetWsId('')
          fetchSeatPlan()
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Swap execution error'
        notify(msg, 'error')
      }
    })
  }

  // 7. Clear Assignment
  const handleClearAssignment = async () => {
    if (!activeWsModal?.assignment) return

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await clearSeatAssignment(activeWsModal.assignment!.seat_plan_id)
        if (!res.success) {
          notify(res.error || 'Failed to remove assignment', 'error')
        } else {
          notify(`Assignment removed from ${activeWsModal.label}`, 'success')
          setActiveWsModal(null)
          fetchSeatPlan()
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Error clearing seat'
        notify(msg, 'error')
      }
    })
  }

  // 8. Auto-Assign Execution
  const handleAutoAssign = async () => {
    setIsAutoAssigning(true)
    try {
      const res = await autoAssignRemainingSeats({
        lab_id: labId,
        academic_year_id: selectedYearId,
        class_id: selectedClassId,
      })

      if (!res.success) {
        notify(res.error || 'Auto-assignment failed', 'error')
      } else {
        notify(`Auto-assigned ${res.data?.assigned_count || 0} students to workstations.`, 'success')
        setIsAutoAssignDialogOpen(false)
        fetchSeatPlan()
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Auto-assign error'
      notify(msg, 'error')
    } finally {
      setIsAutoAssigning(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* 1. TOP COHORT SELECTOR & TELEMETRY STRIP */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#101726] p-3.5 shadow-sm">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-3">
          {/* Cohort Selectors: Year + Class */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
            {/* Academic Year */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs">
              <Calendar className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-400" />
              <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400">Year:</span>
              <select
                value={selectedYearId}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedYearId(e.target.value)}
                className="bg-transparent font-bold text-white focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
              >
                {academicYears.map((yr) => (
                  <option key={yr.id} value={yr.id} className="bg-[#101726] text-white">
                    {yr.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Class / Cohort */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs">
              <GraduationCap className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
              <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400">Class:</span>
              <select
                value={selectedClassId}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedClassId(e.target.value)}
                className="bg-transparent font-bold text-white focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
              >
                {classes.map((cls) => (
                  <option key={cls.id} value={cls.id} className="bg-[#101726] text-white">
                    {cls.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Sync Button */}
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={loading}
              onClick={fetchSeatPlan}
              className="rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Refresh seat plan"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            </button>

            {!isPrivileged && (
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-indigo-500/20 bg-indigo-500/10 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-300">
                <Eye className="h-3 w-3" />
                <span>Read-Only View</span>
              </span>
            )}

            {isPrivileged && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsImportModalOpen(true)}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-indigo-500/30 bg-indigo-600/20 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-indigo-300 hover:bg-indigo-600/30 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Upload className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                <span>Import Roster</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Realtime Cohort Metrics */}
          {planData && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-xs flex-wrap">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Total Enrolled:</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-extrabold text-white tabular-nums">
                  {planData.total_students}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="h-3 w-px bg-white/10 hidden sm:block" />
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Seated:</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-extrabold text-emerald-400 tabular-nums">
                  {planData.assigned_count}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="h-3 w-px bg-white/10 hidden sm:block" />
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Unassigned:</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-extrabold text-amber-400 tabular-nums">
                  {planData.unassigned_count}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Floating Action / Status Toast Banner */}
      {actionMessage && (
        <div
          className={`flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs font-semibold shadow-lg animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-2 ${
            actionMessage.type === 'success'
              ? 'border-emerald-500/50 bg-emerald-950/80 text-emerald-200'
              : 'border-rose-500/50 bg-rose-950/80 text-rose-200'
          }`}
        >
          <span>{actionMessage.text}</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActionMessage(null)}
            className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-white/10"
          >
            <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Selected Student Active Notice */}
      {selectedStudent && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-indigo-500/50 bg-indigo-950/80 px-4 py-2 text-xs text-indigo-200 shadow-md">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="font-extrabold font-mono bg-indigo-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
              Roll {selectedStudent.roll_number}
            </span>
            <span>
              Assigning <strong className="text-white">{selectedStudent.full_name}</strong> &mdash; Click any PC workstation node to place.
            </span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setSelectedStudent(null)}
            className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-300 hover:text-white underline cursor-pointer"
          >
            Cancel
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 2. MAIN WORKBENCH: VISUAL FLOOR + STUDENT TRAY */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 items-start">
        {/* Floor Canvas Area (Primary Hero - 8 or 9 cols on desktop) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-8 xl:col-span-9 space-y-3">
          {error ? (
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-rose-500/30 bg-[#101726] p-8 text-center">
              <ShieldAlert className="h-10 w-10 text-rose-500 mx-auto mb-2" />
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white">Seat Plan Unavailable</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">{error}</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div
              className="relative w-full aspect-[16/9] min-h-[380px] sm:min-h-[500px] rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#0B0F19] overflow-hidden select-none shadow-2xl"
              style={{
                backgroundImage: `
                  radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.03) 0%, transparent 80%),
                  linear-gradient(to right, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
                  linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px)
                `,
                backgroundSize: '100% 100%, 32px 32px, 32px 32px',
              }}
            >
              {/* Database-backed Floor Landmarks */}
              {floorElements.map((el) => (
                <FloorLandmarkNode key={el.id} element={el} />
              ))}

              {/* Workstation Nodes with Student Badges */}
              {(planData?.workstations || []).map((ws) => (
                <WorkstationNode
                  key={ws.id}
                  workstation={ws as any}
                  isSeatPlanMode={true}
                  isSelected={activeWsModal?.id === ws.id}
                  isDropTarget={dragOverWsId === ws.id}
                  onClick={() => handleWorkstationClick(ws)}
                  onDragOver={(e) => handleDragOver(e, ws.id)}
                  onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
                  onDrop={(e) => handleDrop(e, ws)}
                />
              ))}

              {/* Loading Overlay */}
              {loading && (
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[#0B0F19]/60 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center z-40">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#151E32] px-4 py-2 border border-white/10 text-xs font-semibold text-white">
                    <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-indigo-400" />
                    <span>Loading cohort seating...</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Visual Floor Status Legend Bar */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#101726] p-3 text-xs text-slate-300 flex-wrap">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4 flex-wrap">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 shadow-[0_0_8px_#34d399]" />
                <span>Operational (Ready)</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-400" />
                <span>Student Assigned</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400" />
                <span>Session Override</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500 animate-pulse" />
                <span>Hardware Issue</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Mobile Drawer Trigger Button */}
            <div className="block lg:hidden">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsMobileTrayOpen(true)}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-xs"
              >
                <Users className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                <span>Unassigned Tray ({planData?.unassigned_count || 0})</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Unassigned Students Dock (Right column on desktop) */}
        <div className="hidden lg:block lg:col-span-4 xl:col-span-3">
          <StudentTray
            unassignedStudents={planData?.unassigned_students || []}
            selectedStudent={selectedStudent}
            onSelectStudent={setSelectedStudent}
            onAutoAssign={() => setIsAutoAssignDialogOpen(true)}
            isAutoAssigning={isAutoAssigning}
            isPrivileged={isPrivileged}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. MOBILE BOTTOM SHEET FOR UNASSIGNED TRAY */}
      {isMobileTrayOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm lg:hidden">
          <div className="w-full max-h-[80vh] rounded-t-3xl border-t border-white/10 bg-[#101726] p-4 flex flex-col">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-white/10">
              <h3 className="font-heading font-bold text-sm text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <Users className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-400" />
                <span>Unassigned Students ({planData?.unassigned_count || 0})</span>
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsMobileTrayOpen(false)}
                className="p-1 rounded-full text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto mt-3">
              <StudentTray
                unassignedStudents={planData?.unassigned_students || []}
                selectedStudent={selectedStudent}
                onSelectStudent={(st) => {
                  setSelectedStudent(st)
                  setIsMobileTrayOpen(false)
                }}
                onAutoAssign={() => {
                  setIsMobileTrayOpen(false)
                  setIsAutoAssignDialogOpen(true)
                }}
                isAutoAssigning={isAutoAssigning}
                isPrivileged={isPrivileged}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 4. WORKSTATION ACTION POPOVER / MODAL */}
      {activeWsModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#101726] p-5 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-white/[0.08]">
              <div>
                <h4 className="font-heading font-extrabold text-base text-white">
                  {activeWsModal.label}
                </h4>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                  {activeWsModal.row_label || 'Workstation'} &bull; {activeWsModal.device_type}
                </span>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveWsModal(null)}
                className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="py-4 space-y-3">
              {/* Assignment Info */}
              {activeWsModal.assignment ? (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-500/20 bg-indigo-500/10 p-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-indigo-400">
                    Default Assigned Student
                  </span>
                  <div className="mt-1 flex items-baseline justify-between">
                    <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white">
                      {activeWsModal.assignment.student_name}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-xs font-extrabold text-indigo-300">
                      Roll {activeWsModal.assignment.roll_number}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-white/10 bg-[#151E32]/50 p-3 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">
                  No default student assigned to this workstation.
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Active Issue Info if any */}
              {activeWsModal.active_issue && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-rose-500/20 bg-rose-500/10 p-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-rose-400 text-xs font-bold">
                    <ShieldAlert className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    <span>Active Hardware Fault</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-rose-200 mt-1">
                    {activeWsModal.active_issue.title || 'Maintenance ticket reported.'}
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Actions */}
              <div className="space-y-2 pt-2">
                {isPrivileged && activeWsModal.assignment && (
                  <>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setIsSwapDialogOpen(true)}
                      className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-200 hover:text-white hover:border-indigo-500/50 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <ArrowRightLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-400" />
                      <span>Swap Seat with Another PC</span>
                    </button>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleClearAssignment}
                      className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-rose-500/20 bg-rose-500/10 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-300 hover:bg-rose-500/20 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <span>Remove Student Assignment</span>
                    </button>
                  </>
                )}

                {!isPrivileged && activeWsModal.assignment && (
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/5 bg-[#151E32]/40 p-2.5 text-center text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                    Read-only session view. Seat allocations can only be modified by Super Admin or Lab In-Charge.
                  </div>
                )}

                {onInspectWorkstation && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      onInspectWorkstation(activeWsModal.id)
                      setActiveWsModal(null)
                    }}
                    className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                  >
                    <span>Inspect Hardware &amp; Tickets</span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 5. ATOMIC STUDENT SWAP DIALOG */}
      {isSwapDialogOpen && activeWsModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#101726] p-5 shadow-2xl">
            <h4 className="font-heading font-extrabold text-sm text-white mb-2">
              Swap Seats &mdash; {activeWsModal.label}
            </h4>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-4">
              Select another workstation to swap positions atomically without data loss.
            </p>

            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-400">Target Workstation</label>
                <select
                  value={swapTargetWsId}
                  onChange={(e) => setSwapTargetWsId(e.target.value)}
                  className="mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] px-3 py-2 text-xs text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
                >
                  <option value="">-- Choose workstation --</option>
                  {(planData?.workstations || [])
                    .filter((w) => w.id !== activeWsModal.id)
                    .map((w) => (
                      <option key={w.id} value={w.id}>
                        {w.label} {w.assignment ? `(${w.assignment.student_name} - Roll ${w.assignment.roll_number})` : '(Available)'}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-3">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsSwapDialogOpen(false)}
                  className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  disabled={!swapTargetWsId || isPending}
                  onClick={handleExecuteSwap}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-md transition-all disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {isPending && <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" />}
                  <span>Confirm Swap</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 6. AUTO-ASSIGN CONFIRMATION MODAL */}
      {isAutoAssignDialogOpen && planData && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#101726] p-5 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
              <span className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-400">
                <Wand2 className="h-4 w-4" />
              </span>
              <h4 className="font-heading font-extrabold text-base text-white">
                Auto Assign Remaining Students
              </h4>
            </div>

            <p className="text-xs text-slate-300 leading-relaxed mb-4">
              This will automatically match remaining unassigned students to available workstations in ascending roll number order.
            </p>

            <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/[0.06] bg-[#151E32]/60 p-3 space-y-2 text-xs mb-4">
              <div className="flex justify-between text-slate-300">
                <span>Unassigned Students:</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-amber-400">{planData.unassigned_count}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-slate-300">
                <span>Existing Manual Seats:</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-emerald-400">Preserved (Untouched)</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-slate-300">
                <span>Severe Faulty PCs:</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-rose-400">Excluded</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsAutoAssignDialogOpen(false)}
                className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={isAutoAssigning}
                onClick={handleAutoAssign}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-md transition-all disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {isAutoAssigning ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                    <span>Allocating...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Wand2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />

  unassignedStudents,

  onSelectStudent,
  onAutoAssign,

  isPrivileged = false,
  className = '',

  // Filter students by roll number or name
  const filteredStudents = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return unassignedStudents
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim()
    return unassignedStudents.filter((s) => {
      const matchRoll = String(s.roll_number).includes(q)
      const matchName = s.full_name.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      const matchAdm = s.admission_no?.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      return matchRoll || matchName || matchAdm
    })
  }, [unassignedStudents, searchQuery])

    <div
      className={`flex flex-col rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#101726] shadow-xl overflow-hidden ${className}`}

              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">

            className={`font-mono text-xs font-extrabold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${

            }`}
          >
            {unassignedStudents.length}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Search Input */}
        <div className="relative">
          <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-500" />
          <input

            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search roll or student name..."

          />
          {searchQuery && (

      </div>

      {/* Student List Bay */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto max-h-[380px] sm:max-h-[440px] p-2 space-y-1.5 divide-y divide-white/[0.04]">
        {unassignedStudents.length === 0 ? (

          <div className="py-8 px-4 text-center">

                onClick={isPrivileged ? () => onSelectStudent(isSelected ? null : student) : undefined}
                className={`group flex items-center justify-between gap-2 p-2 rounded-xl border transition-all select-none ${
                  isPrivileged ? 'cursor-pointer' : 'cursor-default'

                  isSelected

                )}
              </div>

          })
        )}
      </div>

      {unassignedStudents.length > 0 && isPrivileged && (
        <div className="p-3 border-t border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32]/80">

          >

                <span>Auto-Assigning...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>

              </>
            )}

  const [selectedLandmarkType, setSelectedLandmarkType] = useState('whiteboard')
  const [newLandmarkLabel, setNewLandmarkLabel] = useState('Interactive Whiteboard')

  // Sync when parent workstations or floor elements change (if not currently editing layout)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasUnsavedChanges) {
      setLocalWorkstations(workstations)
    }
  }, [workstations, hasUnsavedChanges])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasUnsavedChanges) {
      setLocalFloorElements(floorElements)
    }
  }, [floorElements, hasUnsavedChanges])

  // Workstation Drag Handler
  const handleDragStart = useCallback(
    (e: React.PointerEvent, ws: WorkstationWithIssues) => {
      if (!isLayoutMode || !isPrivileged) return
      e.preventDefault()
      e.stopPropagation()

      draggingIdRef.current = ws.id

      const handlePointerMove = (moveEvent: PointerEvent) => {
        if (!canvasRef.current || !draggingIdRef.current) return

        const rect = canvasRef.current.getBoundingClientRect()
        const rawX = ((moveEvent.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100
        const rawY = ((moveEvent.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100

        // Snap to 2% grid increments and clamp inside walls (4% to 96%)
        const snappedX = Math.round(rawX / 2) * 2
        const snappedY = Math.round(rawY / 2) * 2
        const clampedX = Math.max(4, Math.min(96, snappedX))
        const clampedY = Math.max(6, Math.min(94, snappedY))

        setLocalWorkstations((prev) =>
          prev.map((item) =>
            item.id === draggingIdRef.current
              ? { ...item, pos_x: clampedX, pos_y: clampedY }
              : item
          )
        )
        setHasUnsavedChanges(true)
      }

      const handlePointerUp = () => {
        draggingIdRef.current = null
        window.removeEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove)
        window.removeEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp)
      }

      window.addEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove)
      window.addEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp)
    },
    [isLayoutMode, isPrivileged]
  )

  // Landmark Drag Handler
  const handleDragLandmarkStart = useCallback(
    (e: React.PointerEvent, el: LabFloorElementRow) => {
      if (!isLayoutMode || !isPrivileged) return
      e.preventDefault()
      e.stopPropagation()

      const targetId = el.id

      const handlePointerMove = (moveEvent: PointerEvent) => {
        if (!canvasRef.current) return

        const rect = canvasRef.current.getBoundingClientRect()
        const rawX = ((moveEvent.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100
        const rawY = ((moveEvent.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100

        const snappedX = Math.round(rawX / 2) * 2
        const snappedY = Math.round(rawY / 2) * 2
        const clampedX = Math.max(2, Math.min(98, snappedX))
        const clampedY = Math.max(2, Math.min(98, snappedY))

        setLocalFloorElements((prev) =>
          prev.map((item) =>
            item.id === targetId ? { ...item, pos_x: clampedX, pos_y: clampedY } : item
          )
        )
        setHasUnsavedChanges(true)
      }

      const handlePointerUp = () => {
        window.removeEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove)
        window.removeEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp)
      }

      window.addEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove)
      window.addEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp)
    },
    [isLayoutMode, isPrivileged]
  )

  // Landmark Rotate Handler (90 deg)
  const handleRotateLandmark = (el: LabFloorElementRow) => {
    setLocalFloorElements((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) =>
        item.id === el.id
          ? { ...item, rotation: (((item.rotation || 0) + 90) % 360) as any }
          : item
      )
    )
    setHasUnsavedChanges(true)
  }

  // Landmark Delete Handler
  const handleDeleteLandmark = (el: LabFloorElementRow) => {
    setLocalFloorElements((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== el.id))
    setHasUnsavedChanges(true)
  }

  // Save Layout Positions (Workstations + Landmarks)
  const handleSavePositions = async () => {
    setSavingPositions(true)
    setSaveMessage(null)

    const wsPayload: UpdateWorkstationPositionInput[] = localWorkstations.map((ws) => ({
      id: ws.id,
      pos_x: ws.pos_x,
      pos_y: ws.pos_y,
    }))

    const landmarkPayload = localFloorElements.map((el) => ({
      id: el.id,
      lab_id: labId,
      element_type: el.element_type,
      label: el.label,
      pos_x: el.pos_x,
      pos_y: el.pos_y,
      width: el.width || 12.0,
      height: el.height || 4.0,
      rotation: (el.rotation || 0) as 0 | 90 | 180 | 270,
      is_active: el.is_active,
    }))

    try {
      const [wsRes, elRes] = await Promise.all([
        updateWorkstationPositions(wsPayload),
        saveLabFloorElements(labId, landmarkPayload),
      ])

      if (!wsRes.success) throw new Error(wsRes.error || 'Failed to save workstation positions.')
      if (!elRes.success) throw new Error(elRes.error || 'Failed to save floor landmarks.')

      setHasUnsavedChanges(false)
      setSaveMessage('Physical room layout saved successfully.')
      setTimeout(() => setSaveMessage(null), 2500)
      onRefreshData()
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Save failed'
      setSaveMessage(`Error: ${msg}`)
    } finally {
      setSavingPositions(false)
    }
  }

  // Reset to Prop Positions
  const handleDiscardChanges = () => {
    setLocalWorkstations(workstations)
    setLocalFloorElements(floorElements)
    setHasUnsavedChanges(false)
    setSaveMessage(null)
  }

  // Create New Workstation
  const handleCreateWorkstation = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!newLabel.trim()) return

    setAddingStation(true)
    try {
      const res = await createWorkstation({
        lab_id: labId,
        label: newLabel.trim(),
        row_label: newRow.trim() || null,
        pos_x: 50.0,
        pos_y: 50.0,
        device_type: newDeviceType,
      })

      if (!res.success) {
        throw new Error(res.error || 'Failed to create workstation.')
      }

      setIsAddModalOpen(false)
      setNewLabel('')
      onRefreshData()
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      alert(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Error adding workstation')
    } finally {
      setAddingStation(false)
    }
  }

  // Add Landmark from Catalog
  const handleAddLandmark = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    const def = FLOOR_ELEMENT_CATALOG[selectedLandmarkType] || {
      defaultWidth: 12.0,
      defaultHeight: 4.0,
    }

    const newElement: LabFloorElementRow = {
      id: `temp-${Date.now()}`,
      lab_id: labId,
      element_type: selectedLandmarkType,
      label: newLandmarkLabel.trim() || 'Room Landmark',
      pos_x: 50.0,
      pos_y: 12.0,
      width: def.defaultWidth,
      height: def.defaultHeight,
      rotation: 0,
      metadata: {},
      is_active: true,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    }

    setLocalFloorElements((prev) => [...prev, newElement])
    setHasUnsavedChanges(true)
    setIsAddLandmarkOpen(false)
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      {/* Floor Plan Canvas Toolbar & Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#101726] p-3 text-xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <span className="font-heading font-extrabold text-sm text-white">
            {labName} Floor Canvas
          </span>

          <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-400">
            ({localWorkstations.length} Active Workstations &bull; {localFloorElements.length} Landmarks)
          </span>

          {saveMessage && (
            <span
              className={`rounded-lg px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold ${
                saveMessage.startsWith('Error')
                  ? 'bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300'
                  : 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300'
              }`}
            >
              {saveMessage}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Action Controls & Layout Mode Toggle */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          {isPrivileged && (
            <>
              {isLayoutMode ? (
                <>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setIsAddModalOpen(true)}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-indigo-500/40 bg-indigo-500/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-300 hover:bg-indigo-500/20 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    <span>Add PC</span>
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setIsAddLandmarkOpen(true)}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-500/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-500/20 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <MapPin className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    <span>Add Landmark</span>
                  </button>

                  {hasUnsavedChanges && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleDiscardChanges}
                      className="rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/80 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-700"
                    >
                      Discard
                    </button>
                  )}

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={!hasUnsavedChanges || savingPositions}
                    onClick={handleSavePositions}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-emerald-500 shadow-md transition-all disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {savingPositions ? (
                      <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                    ) : (
                      <Save className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    )}
                    <span>Save Layout</span>
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (hasUnsavedChanges) {
                        if (confirm('Discard unsaved layout changes?')) {
                          handleDiscardChanges()
                          setIsLayoutMode(false)
                        }
                      } else {
                        setIsLayoutMode(false)
                      }
                    }}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 hover:text-white"
                  >
                    <Lock className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    <span>Exit Layout Mode</span>
                  </button>
                </>
              ) : (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsLayoutMode(true)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 hover:border-indigo-500/40 hover:text-indigo-300 transition-colors"
                >
                  <Unlock className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  <span>Arrange Physical Layout</span>
                </button>

            </>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onRefreshData}
            className="rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"

            <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />

      <div

        className="relative w-full aspect-[16/9] min-h-[380px] sm:min-h-[480px] rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#0B0F19] overflow-hidden select-none shadow-2xl"

          backgroundSize: '100% 100%, 32px 32px, 32px 32px',

        {/* Real-Life Architectural Desk Tables & Corridor Structures */}
        <LabDeskStructureOverlay />

            element={el}
            isLayoutMode={isLayoutMode}
            onDragStart={handleDragLandmarkStart}

            onDelete={handleDeleteLandmark}
          />

        {isLayoutMode && (

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
