  const [issueTitle, setIssueTitle] = useState('')
  const [issueDescription, setIssueDescription] = useState('')
  const [issueSeverity, setIssueSeverity] = useState<'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical'>('medium')
  const [issuePhotos, setIssuePhotos] = useState<WorkstationPhoto[]>([])

  // Reassignment state
  const destinationStations = availableWorkstations.filter((w) => w.id !== workstation?.id)
  const [selectedTargetWsId, setSelectedTargetWsId] = useState<string>('')
  const [isSubmittingOverride, setIsSubmittingOverride] = useState(false)
  const [localPresence, setLocalPresence] = useState<boolean>(true)

  // Displaced student assignment state
  const [selectedDisplacedEnrollmentId, setSelectedDisplacedEnrollmentId] = useState<string>('')
  const [isSubmittingDisplaced, setIsSubmittingDisplaced] = useState(false)
  const [isResettingLock, setIsResettingLock] = useState(false)
  const [confirmResetLock, setConfirmResetLock] = useState(false)
  const [copiedSetupCmd, setCopiedSetupCmd] = useState(false)

  // Close on Escape key
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        onClose()
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)
  }, [isOpen, onClose])

  const prevWorkstationIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null)
  const prevIsOpenRef = useRef<boolean>(false)

  // Smart-default tab and reset optimistic state ONLY on initial drawer open or when switching workstations
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen || !workstation) {
      prevIsOpenRef.current = isOpen
      return
    }

    const isNewlyOpened = !prevIsOpenRef.current && isOpen
    const isWorkstationChanged = prevWorkstationIdRef.current !== workstation.id

    if (isNewlyOpened || isWorkstationChanged) {
      setResolvedIssueIds([])
      setConfirmResetLock(false)
      setLocalPresence(workstation.isPresent !== false)

      const hasIssues =
        (workstation.active_issues && workstation.active_issues.length > 0) ||
        (workstation.open_issues_count || 0) > 0 ||
        Boolean(assistanceRequest) ||
        workstation.status === 'flagged' ||
        workstation.status === 'under_repair'

      const hasStudent = Boolean(workstation.session_override || workstation.assignment)

      if (hasIssues) {
        setActiveTab('issues')
      } else if (hasStudent && Boolean(onTogglePresence)) {
        setActiveTab('rollcall')
      } else {
        setActiveTab('specs')
      }
    }

    prevIsOpenRef.current = isOpen
    prevWorkstationIdRef.current = workstation.id
  }, [isOpen, workstation?.id, workstation?.status, workstation?.open_issues_count, assistanceRequest, onTogglePresence])

  // Keep local presence synchronized whenever workstation.isPresent changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (workstation) {
      setLocalPresence(workstation.isPresent !== false)
    }
  }, [workstation?.isPresent])

  // Keep destination stations selection valid
  useEffect(() => {
    const validStations = availableWorkstations.filter((w) => w.id !== workstation?.id)
    if (!validStations.some((w) => w.id === selectedTargetWsId)) {
      setSelectedTargetWsId(validStations[0]?.id || '')
    }
  }, [availableWorkstations, workstation?.id, selectedTargetWsId])

  // Keep displaced students selection valid
  useEffect(() => {
    if (displacedStudents && displacedStudents.length > 0) {
      if (!displacedStudents.some((s) => s.enrollmentId === selectedDisplacedEnrollmentId)) {
        setSelectedDisplacedEnrollmentId(displacedStudents[0].enrollmentId)
      }
    } else {
      setSelectedDisplacedEnrollmentId('')
    }
  }, [displacedStudents, selectedDisplacedEnrollmentId])

  if (!isOpen || !workstation) return null

  // Active issues with optimistic exclusion
  const activeIssues = (workstation.active_issues || []).filter(
    (issue) => !resolvedIssueIds.includes(issue.id)
  )
  const activeCount = activeIssues.length + (assistanceRequest ? 1 : 0)
  const student = workstation.session_override || workstation.assignment
  const hasStudent = Boolean(student)
  const rollNumber = student?.roll_number
  const enrollmentId =
    workstation.assignment?.enrollment_id ||
    (workstation.session_override as any)?.enrollment_id
  const isTemporary = Boolean(workstation.session_override)

  // Quick preset titles based on selected category
  const titlePresets = [
    'No Display / Monitor Blackout',
    'Windows BSOD / Kernel Panic',
    'LAN Cable Fault / No Network',
    'Keyboard Keys Jammed / Unresponsive',
    'Mouse Clicker / Sensor Broken',
    'System Overheating / Shuts Down',
    'Power Supply Failed / Won\'t Boot',
    'Missing Required Lab Software',
  ]

  const handleCategorySelect = (catId: string) => {
    setSelectedCategoryId(catId)
    const cat = categories.find((c) => c.id === catId)
    if (cat) {
      setIssueSeverity(cat.default_severity)
      if (!issueTitle) {
        setIssueTitle(cat.name)
      }
    }
  }

  // 1. Toggle Attendance
  const handleToggleAttendance = (setPresent: boolean) => {
    if (isLocked || !rollNumber || !onTogglePresence) return
    setLocalPresence(setPresent)
    onTogglePresence(rollNumber)
    setSuccessMessage(setPresent ? 'Student marked present.' : 'Student marked absent.')
    setTimeout(() => {
      setSuccessMessage(null)
    }, 1500)
  }

  // 2. Quick Reassign (Tier 2)
  const handleReassignStudent = async () => {
    if (!selectedTargetWsId || !enrollmentId || !onAssignOverride) return
    setIsSubmittingOverride(true)
    setErrorMessage(null)
    try {
      await onAssignOverride(selectedTargetWsId, enrollmentId)
      const targetStationName = destinationStations.find((w) => w.id === selectedTargetWsId)?.label || 'station'
      setSuccessMessage(`Student temporarily relocated to ${targetStationName} for this session.`)
      setTimeout(() => {
        setSuccessMessage(null)
      }, 2500)
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Failed to reassign seat.')
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingOverride(false)
    }
  }

  // 3. Quick Seat Displaced Student
  const handleAssignDisplacedStudent = async () => {
    if (!selectedDisplacedEnrollmentId || !onAssignReplacement || !workstation) return
    setIsSubmittingDisplaced(true)
    setErrorMessage(null)
    try {
      await onAssignReplacement(workstation.id, selectedDisplacedEnrollmentId, 'Assigned from Workstation Sidebar')
      setSuccessMessage(`Student assigned to ${workstation.label} for this session.`)
      setTimeout(() => {
        setSuccessMessage(null)
      }, 2500)
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to seat student.'
      setErrorMessage(msg)
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingDisplaced(false)
    }
  }

  // 4. Submit Problem Report
  const handleSubmitReport = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!issueTitle.trim()) {
      setErrorMessage('Please provide an issue title or description.')
      return
    }

    setErrorMessage(null)
    setSubmitting(true)

    try {
      const res = await reportWorkstationIssue({
        workstation_id: workstation.id,
        category_id: selectedCategoryId || null,
        title: issueTitle.trim(),
        description: issueDescription.trim() || null,
        severity: issueSeverity,
        photos: issuePhotos,
      })

      if (!res.success) {
        throw new Error(res.error || 'Failed to submit issue report.')
      }

      setSuccessMessage('Problem reported successfully. Lab In-Charge has been notified.')
      // Reset form
      setIssueTitle('')
      setIssueDescription('')
      setIssuePhotos([])

      // Refresh parent state immediately
      await onSuccess()
      broadcastSync('workstations', { stationCode: workstation.label })

      setTimeout(() => {
        setSuccessMessage(null)
        setActiveTab('issues')
      }, 1000)
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Submission failed.'
      setErrorMessage(msg)
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false)
    }
  }

  // 5. Resolve Issue Action
  const handleResolveIssue = async (issueId: string) => {
    if (!resolutionNotes.trim()) {
      setErrorMessage('Please enter resolution notes describing the corrective service performed.')
      return
    }

    setErrorMessage(null)
    setSubmitting(true)

    try {
      const res = await resolveWorkstationIssue({
        issue_id: issueId,
        resolution_notes: resolutionNotes.trim(),
        create_maintenance_log: createLogbookEntry,
        parts_replaced: partsReplaced.trim() || null,
      })

      if (!res.success) {
        throw new Error(res.error || 'Failed to resolve issue.')
      }

      // Optimistically hide the resolved issue immediately
      setResolvedIssueIds((prev) => [...prev, issueId])
      setResolvingIssueId(null)
      setResolutionNotes('')
      setPartsReplaced('')
      setSuccessMessage('Issue certified as resolved and recorded in Service Logbook.')

      // Refresh parent state immediately
      await onSuccess()
      broadcastSync('workstations', { stationCode: workstation.label })

      setTimeout(() => {
        setSuccessMessage(null)
      }, 2500)
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Resolution failed.'
      setErrorMessage(msg)
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false)
    }
  }

  // 6. Reset Hardware Lock Action (Inline Protected Flow)
  const executeResetHardwareLock = async () => {
    if (!workstation) return

    setIsResettingLock(true)
    setErrorMessage(null)
    try {
      const res = await resetWorkstationHardwareLock(workstation.id)
      if (res.success) {
        setSuccessMessage(`Hardware lock released on ${workstation.label}. Station unbound and ready for new physical pairing.`)
        setConfirmResetLock(false)
        await onSuccess()
        broadcastSync('workstations', { stationCode: workstation.label })
      } else {
        setErrorMessage(res.error || 'Failed to reset hardware lock.')
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Error resetting hardware lock.'
      setErrorMessage(msg)
    } finally {
      setIsResettingLock(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex justify-end bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs transition-opacity animate-in fade-in duration-150 cursor-pointer"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        data-testid="workstation-drawer"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        className="relative flex h-full w-full max-w-lg md:max-w-xl flex-col bg-[#101726] border-l border-white/[0.08] shadow-2xl overflow-hidden animate-in slide-in-from-right duration-200 cursor-default"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Enterprise Command Header Bar */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32]/90 px-5 py-4 backdrop-blur-md">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div
              className={`flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border shadow-sm ${
                workstation.status === 'flagged' || assistanceRequest
                  ? 'border-amber-500/50 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400'
                  : workstation.status === 'under_repair'
                  ? 'border-cyan-500/50 bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-400'
                  : 'border-emerald-500/50 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400'
              }`}
            >
              {workstation.status === 'flagged' || assistanceRequest ? (
                <ShieldAlert className="h-5 w-5" />
              ) : workstation.status === 'under_repair' ? (
                <Wrench className="h-5 w-5" />
              ) : (
                <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5" />
              )}
            </div>

            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <h3 className="font-heading font-extrabold text-lg text-white">
                  {workstation.label}
                </h3>
                <span className="rounded-md bg-white/[0.06] px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs text-slate-300">
                  {workstation.row_label || 'Workstation'}
                </span>
                {workstation.machine_guid ? (
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-mono text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-500/30 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shadow-xs">
                    <ShieldCheck className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-400" />
                    <span>Silicon Bound</span>
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-500 bg-white/[0.04] border border-white/5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                    Unbound
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                Status:{' '}
                <span
                  className={
                    workstation.status === 'operational' && !assistanceRequest
                      ? 'text-emerald-400 font-semibold'
                      : workstation.status === 'under_repair'
                      ? 'text-cyan-400 font-semibold'
                      : 'text-amber-400 font-semibold'
                  }
                >
                  {workstation.status === 'operational' && !assistanceRequest
                    ? 'Operational (Ready)'
                    : workstation.status === 'under_repair'
                    ? 'Under Repair / Servicing'
                    : `Flagged (${activeCount} Active Issue${activeCount > 1 ? 's' : ''})`}
                </span>
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] p-2 text-slate-400 transition-colors hover:bg-white/[0.06] hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="h-5 w-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Unified 4-Tab Enterprise Command Center Navigator */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-4 border-b border-white/[0.08] bg-[#0E1524]">
          {/* Tab 1: Specs & Silicon Telemetry */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('specs')}
            className={`py-3 text-center text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors border-b-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'specs'
                ? 'border-indigo-500 text-indigo-400 bg-indigo-500/5'
                : 'border-transparent text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
            }`}
          >
            <Cpu className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span className="truncate">Specs</span>
            {workstation.machine_guid ? (
              <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 shrink-0" title="Silicon Bound" />
            ) : (
              <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-600 shrink-0" title="Unbound" />
            )}
          </button>

          {/* Tab 2: Live Seating & Attendance */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('rollcall')}
            className={`py-3 text-center text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors border-b-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'rollcall'
                ? 'border-indigo-500 text-indigo-400 bg-indigo-500/5'
                : 'border-transparent text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
            }`}
          >
            <UserCheck className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span className="truncate">Seating</span>
            {hasStudent && (
              <span className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full shrink-0 ${localPresence === false ? 'bg-rose-400' : 'bg-emerald-400'}`} />
            )}
          </button>

          {/* Tab 3: Active Faults & Issues */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('issues')}
            className={`py-3 text-center text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors border-b-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'issues'
                ? 'border-indigo-500 text-indigo-400 bg-indigo-500/5'
                : 'border-transparent text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
            }`}
          >
            <AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span className="truncate">Issues</span>
            {activeCount > 0 ? (
              <Badge className="bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/30 text-[9px] font-mono px-1 py-0 h-4 min-w-4 flex items-center justify-center">
                {activeCount}
              </Badge>
            ) : null}
          </button>

          {/* Tab 4: Report Fault */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('report')}
            className={`py-3 text-center text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors border-b-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'report'
                ? 'border-indigo-500 text-indigo-400 bg-indigo-500/5'
                : 'border-transparent text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
            }`}
          >
            <Wrench className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span className="truncate">Report</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Global Feedback Notifications */}
        {errorMessage && (
          <div className="mx-5 mt-4 rounded-xl border border-rose-500/40 bg-rose-500/10 p-3 text-xs text-rose-300">
            {errorMessage}
          </div>
        )}
        {successMessage && (
          <div className="mx-5 mt-4 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-500/10 p-3 text-xs text-emerald-300">
            {successMessage}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Drawer Content Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-5 space-y-4">
          {/* ============================================================== */}
          {/* TAB 1: SILICON TELEMETRY & HARDWARE DIAGNOSTICS DECK           */}
          {/* ============================================================== */}
          {activeTab === 'specs' && (() => {
            const specs = workstation.hardware_specs as WorkstationHardwareSpecs | null
            const freeGb = specs ? specs.disk_c_free_gb : 0
            const totalGb = specs ? specs.disk_c_total_gb : 0
            const usedPct = specs
              ? Math.min(100, Math.max(5, specs.disk_c_used_pct || Math.round(((totalGb - freeGb) / (totalGb || 1)) * 100)))
              : 0
            const isLowDisk = freeGb < 15.0
            const isCriticalDisk = freeGb < 5.0

            return (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {specs ? (
                  <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#0E1526] p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-xl space-y-4 relative overflow-hidden">
                    <div className="absolute -top-12 -right-12 w-40 h-40 bg-indigo-500/10 rounded-full blur-2xl pointer-events-none" />

                    {/* Telemetry Header */}
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/[0.06] pb-3.5">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div className="h-9 w-9 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/15 border border-indigo-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-indigo-400 shadow-sm">
                          <Cpu className="h-5 w-5" />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <h4 className="font-heading font-extrabold text-sm uppercase tracking-wider text-white">
                            Silicon Telemetry
                          </h4>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                            Physical Node Architecture &amp; System Health
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-mono text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-500/30 px-3 py-1 rounded-full shadow-xs">
                        <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                        <span>Agent Synced (v{specs.agent_version || '1.0.0'})</span>
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    {/* 2-Column Compute & Memory Bento Grid */}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                      {/* Processor Core Card */}
                      <div className="rounded-xl bg-[#141E34] border border-white/[0.06] p-3.5 space-y-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="text-[10.5px] uppercase font-mono tracking-wider text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <Activity className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-400" />
                            Processor
                          </span>
                          <Badge className="bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border-indigo-500/30 text-[9.5px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0">
                            {specs.cpu_cores} Cores
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-white font-bold text-xs leading-snug line-clamp-2" title={specs.cpu}>
                          {specs.cpu}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
                          x64 Physical Compute Core
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Memory Card */}
                      <div className="rounded-xl bg-[#141E34] border border-white/[0.06] p-3.5 space-y-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="text-[10.5px] uppercase font-mono tracking-wider text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <Server className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
                            RAM Installed
                          </span>
                          <Badge className="bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/30 text-[9.5px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0">
                            Verified
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-white font-extrabold text-lg font-heading tracking-tight">
                          {specs.ram_gb} GB
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
                          DDR System Memory
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Storage Allocation & Headroom Meter (Drive C:) */}
                    <div className="rounded-xl bg-[#141E34] border border-white/[0.06] p-3.5 space-y-2.5">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                        <span className="font-mono text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium">
                          <HardDrive className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                          System Volume (Drive C:)
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-mono font-bold text-white tabular-nums">
                          {specs.disk_c_free_gb} GB Free / {specs.disk_c_total_gb} GB
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {/* Graduated Multi-Tone Bar */}
                      <div className="h-2.5 w-full rounded-full bg-[#0B0F19] overflow-hidden p-0.5 border border-white/5">
                        <div
                          className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500 ${
                            isCriticalDisk
                              ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-600 to-rose-400 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(244,63,94,0.6)] animate-pulse'
                              : isLowDisk
                              ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-600 to-amber-400 shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(245,158,11,0.5)]'
                              : 'bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 via-cyan-400 to-emerald-400 shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(16,185,129,0.4)]'
                          }`}
                          style={{ width: `${usedPct}%` }}
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono">
                        <span className="text-slate-400">
                          {usedPct}% Allocated ({(specs.disk_c_total_gb - specs.disk_c_free_gb).toFixed(1)} GB in use)
                        </span>
                        {isCriticalDisk ? (
                          <span className="text-rose-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-1 animate-pulse">
                            <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3 text-rose-400" />
                            <span>Storage Critical (&lt;5 GB Free)</span>
                          </span>
                        ) : isLowDisk ? (
                          <span className="text-amber-300 font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
                            <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3 text-amber-400" />
                            <span>Low Storage Warning (&lt;15 GB)</span>
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-emerald-400 font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3" />
                            <span>Optimal Headroom</span>
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* OS & Network Topology Ribbon */}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs font-mono">
                      <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#141E34] border border-white/[0.06] space-y-1">
                        <div className="text-[10px] uppercase text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Monitor className="h-3 w-3 text-indigo-400" /> Operating System
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-slate-200 font-semibold text-[11.5px] truncate" title={specs.os_caption}>
                          {specs.os_caption}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                          Build {specs.os_build} • 64-bit Kernel
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#141E34] border border-white/[0.06] space-y-1">
                        <div className="text-[10px] uppercase text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Wifi className="h-3 w-3 text-cyan-400" /> Station Link &amp; MAC
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-slate-200 font-semibold text-[11.5px]">
                          {specs.lan_ip}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                          MAC: {specs.mac_address}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Silicon TOFU Hardware Lock Card */}
                    {workstation.machine_guid ? (
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/25 bg-emerald-950/20 p-3.5 space-y-3">
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
                          <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                            <div className="h-7 w-7 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5 shadow-xs">
                              <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4" />
                            </div>
                            <div>
                              <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <span>Silicon TOFU Lock Enforced</span>
                                <Badge className="bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/30 text-[9px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0">
                                  Anti-Spoof
                                </Badge>
                              </div>
                              <div className="text-[10.5px] text-slate-400 font-mono mt-0.5">
                                Bound to physical silicon ({workstation.machine_guid.slice(-17)}). Zero URL spoofing permitted.
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          {isPrivileged && (
                            <div className="shrink-0">
                              {confirmResetLock ? (
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                  <Button
                                    type="button"
                                    variant="destructive"
                                    size="sm"
                                    disabled={isResettingLock}
                                    onClick={executeResetHardwareLock}
                                    className="h-8 px-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white font-bold text-xs gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-md"
                                  >
                                    <RotateCcw className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${isResettingLock ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                                    <span>Confirm Unbind</span>
                                  </Button>
                                  <Button
                                    type="button"
                                    variant="ghost"
                                    size="sm"
                                    disabled={isResettingLock}
                                    onClick={() => setConfirmResetLock(false)}
                                    className="h-8 px-2.5 rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-white text-xs cursor-pointer"
                                  >
                                    Cancel
                                  </Button>
                                </div>
                              ) : (
                                <Button
                                  type="button"
                                  variant="outline"
                                  size="sm"
                                  disabled={isResettingLock}
                                  onClick={() => setConfirmResetLock(true)}
                                  className="h-8 px-3 rounded-xl border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 hover:bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 font-bold text-xs gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors shadow-xs"
                                  title="Unbind current hardware GUID to allow new physical machine pairing"
                                >
                                  <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                                  <span>Reset Hardware Lock</span>
                                </Button>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        {confirmResetLock && (
                          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-500/30 text-[11px] text-rose-300">
                            <strong>Motherboard or NIC replaced?</strong> Resetting will release the cryptographic lock on {workstation.label}. The next computer executing <code className="font-mono text-white">labsync-agent.ps1</code> with station code &quot;{workstation.label}&quot; will automatically bind to this station.
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-950/15 p-3.5 space-y-2.5">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-amber-300 font-bold text-xs">
                          <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
                          <span>Awaiting Physical Machine Enrollment</span>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">
                          This station is not locked to physical silicon. Run the client agent on the lab PC to bind telemetry and enforce anti-spoofing.
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-white/10 bg-[#0E1526]/50 p-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center space-y-3">
                    <div className="h-12 w-12 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-500/10 border border-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-400 flex items-center justify-center">
                      <Cpu className="h-6 w-6" />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-heading font-extrabold text-sm text-white">
                        No Hardware Telemetry Registered
                      </h4>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 max-w-sm mt-1 leading-relaxed">
                        Workstation <strong className="text-white font-mono">{workstation.label}</strong> has not yet synced with the native client agent.
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="w-full max-w-md pt-3 text-left space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10.5px] font-mono text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                        <span>Technician Enrollment Command:</span>
                        {copiedSetupCmd ? (
                          <span className="text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold">
                            <Check className="h-3 w-3" /> Copied
                          </span>
                        ) : null}
                      </div>
                      <div
                        onClick={() => {
                          navigator.clipboard?.writeText(
                            `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\\scripts\\client-agent\\labsync-agent.ps1 -StationCode "${workstation.label}"`
                          )
                          setCopiedSetupCmd(true)
                          setTimeout(() => setCopiedSetupCmd(false), 2500)
                        }}
                        className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/5 font-mono text-[11px] text-indigo-300 hover:border-indigo-500/40 cursor-pointer select-all overflow-x-auto flex items-center justify-between gap-2"
                        title="Click to copy setup command"
                      >
                        <code className="truncate">
                          powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\client-agent\labsync-agent.ps1 -StationCode &quot;{workstation.label}&quot;
                        </code>
                        <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Direct Operational Quick Links */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-1">
                  <Link
                    href={`/terminal/${encodeURIComponent(workstation.label)}`}
                    target="_blank"
                    className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] hover:bg-white/[0.06] border border-white/5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate">
                      <Monitor className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-400 shrink-0" />
                      <span className="truncate">Student Gateway</span>
                    </div>
                    <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-500 shrink-0" />
                  </Link>

                  <Link
                    href={`/maintenance?search=${encodeURIComponent(workstation.label)}`}
                    target="_blank"
                    className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] hover:bg-white/[0.06] border border-white/5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate">
                      <Wrench className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
                      <span className="truncate">Service Logbook</span>
                    </div>
                    <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-500 shrink-0" />
                  </Link>
                </div>
              </div>
            )
          })()}

          {/* ============================================================== */}
          {/* TAB 2: ROLL-CALL & SEATING ALLOCATION                           */}
          {/* ============================================================== */}
          {activeTab === 'rollcall' && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {student ? (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] p-4 shadow-sm space-y-4">
                  {/* Seated Student Biographical Header */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="h-12 w-12 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-white/20 bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-md">
                      {(student as any).photo_url ? (
                        <img
                          src={(student as any).photo_url}
                          alt={student.student_name}
                          className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-300 font-heading">
                          {student.student_name.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                        <h4 className="font-heading font-extrabold text-base text-white truncate">
                          {student.student_name}
                        </h4>
                        <Badge className="bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border-indigo-500/30 font-mono text-[10.5px]">
                          Roll {student.roll_number}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                        {isTemporary ? (
                          <span className="text-amber-300 font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
                            <ArrowRightLeft className="h-3 w-3 inline shrink-0" />
                            Temporarily Relocated (Session Override)
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          'Baseline Cohort Seating Allocation'
                        )}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Attendance Controls */}
                  <div className="pt-3 border-t border-white/5 space-y-2.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                      <span className="text-slate-400 font-medium">Session Attendance Status:</span>
                      <Badge
                        className={
                          localPresence === false
                            ? 'bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-300 border-rose-500/30'
                            : 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/30'
                        }
                      >
                        {localPresence === false ? 'Marked Absent' : 'Marked Present'}
                      </Badge>
                    </div>

                    {onTogglePresence && (
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                        <Button
                          type="button"
                          variant="outline"
                          onClick={() => handleToggleAttendance(true)}
                          disabled={isLocked || localPresence === true}
                          className={`h-11 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                            localPresence === true
                              ? 'border-emerald-500/60 bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 shadow-sm'
                              : 'border-white/10 text-slate-300 hover:bg-white/5'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-400" />
                          <span>Mark Present</span>
                        </Button>

                        <Button
                          type="button"
                          variant="outline"
                          onClick={() => handleToggleAttendance(false)}
                          disabled={isLocked || localPresence === false}
                          className={`h-11 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                            localPresence === false
                              ? 'border-rose-500/60 bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 shadow-sm'
                              : 'border-white/10 text-slate-300 hover:bg-white/5'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <XCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-rose-400" />
                          <span>Mark Absent</span>
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Tier 2 Temporary Reassignment */}
                  {onAssignOverride && (
                    <div className="pt-3 border-t border-white/5 space-y-2 text-xs">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider text-[10.5px]">
                          Temporary Reassign (Tier 2):
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Today only</span>
                      </div>

                      {destinationStations.length === 0 ? (
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 italic">
                          No other operational vacant stations available for reassignment.
                        </p>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="flex gap-2">
                          <select
                            value={selectedTargetWsId}
                            onChange={(e) => setSelectedTargetWsId(e.target.value)}
                            className="flex-1 h-9 px-3 rounded-xl bg-[#0B0F19] border border-white/10 text-white text-xs"
                          >
                            {destinationStations.map((w) => (
                              <option key={w.id} value={w.id}>
                                {w.label} ({w.description || 'Empty & Operational'})
                              </option>
                            ))}
                          </select>
                          <Button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={handleReassignStudent}
                            disabled={isSubmittingOverride || !selectedTargetWsId}
                            className="h-9 px-3.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-bold text-xs gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shrink-0 shadow-sm"
                          >
                            {isSubmittingOverride ? (
                              <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                            ) : (
                              <ArrowRightLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                            )}
                            <span>Reassign</span>
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/5 bg-[#151E32]/50 p-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center space-y-4">
                  <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-400 flex items-center justify-center">
                    <Monitor className="h-5 w-5" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-heading font-semibold text-white text-sm">Station Available / Unassigned</h4>
                    <p className="mt-1 max-w-xs text-xs text-slate-400">
                      No student is currently assigned or seated at {workstation.label}.
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Assign Displaced Student if any are waiting */}
                  {onAssignReplacement && displacedStudents && displacedStudents.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="w-full max-w-md pt-4 border-t border-white/5 text-left space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="font-bold text-amber-300 uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Users className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          <span>Assign Waiting / Displaced Student ({displacedStudents.length})</span>
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Tier 2 Quick Seat</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex gap-2">
                        <select
                          value={selectedDisplacedEnrollmentId}
                          onChange={(e) => setSelectedDisplacedEnrollmentId(e.target.value)}
                          className="flex-1 h-9 px-3 rounded-xl bg-[#0B0F19] border border-white/10 text-white text-xs truncate"
                        >
                          {displacedStudents.map((ds) => (
                            <option key={ds.enrollmentId} value={ds.enrollmentId}>
                              Roll {ds.rollNumber} — {ds.studentName} ({ds.originalWsLabel !== 'Unassigned' ? `Displaced from ${ds.originalWsLabel}` : 'Unassigned'})
                            </option>
                          ))}
                        </select>
                        <Button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={handleAssignDisplacedStudent}
                          disabled={isSubmittingDisplaced || !selectedDisplacedEnrollmentId}
                          className="h-9 px-3.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 text-white font-bold text-xs gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shrink-0 shadow-sm"
                        >
                          {isSubmittingDisplaced ? (
                            <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                          ) : (
                            <ArrowRightLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          )}
                          <span>Seat Here</span>
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Quick Link to Student Terminal Gateway */}
              <div className="pt-2">
                <Link
                  href={`/terminal/${encodeURIComponent(workstation.label)}`}
                  target="_blank"
                  className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] hover:bg-white/[0.06] border border-white/5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Monitor className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-400" />
                    <span>Open Student Terminal Gateway</span>
                  </div>
                  <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-500" />
                </Link>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ============================================================== */}
          {/* TAB 2: ACTIVE ISSUES & ASSISTANCE REQUESTS                      */}
          {/* ============================================================== */}
          {activeTab === 'issues' && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {/* Assistance Request Banner (Real-Time Student Ping) */}
              {assistanceRequest && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 p-4 shadow-sm space-y-2.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-amber-500/20 pb-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                      <span className="relative flex h-2.5 w-2.5">
                        <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-amber-400 opacity-75" />
                        <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2.5 w-2.5 bg-amber-500" />
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-300 truncate">
                        Help Request &bull; {workstation.label}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    {onAcknowledgeAssistance && (
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        size="sm"
                        onClick={async () => {
                          await onAcknowledgeAssistance(assistanceRequest.id)
                        }}
                        className="h-7 px-3 rounded-lg bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-bold text-xs gap-1 cursor-pointer shadow-sm transition-all"
                        title="Acknowledge student help notification"
                      >
                        <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-950" />
                        <span>Acknowledge</span>
                      </Button>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <h4 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-white leading-snug">
                      {assistanceRequest.title}
                    </h4>
                    {assistanceRequest.studentName && (
                      <p className="text-xs text-zinc-300">
                        from <strong className="text-amber-200 font-semibold">{assistanceRequest.studentName}</strong>
                        {assistanceRequest.studentRoll && (
                          <span className="text-indigo-300 font-mono ml-1 font-bold">
                            (Roll {assistanceRequest.studentRoll})
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </p>
                    )}
                    {assistanceRequest.description && (
                      <p className="text-xs text-zinc-300/90 italic bg-black/40 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-white/5 mt-1 leading-relaxed">
                        &ldquo;{assistanceRequest.description}&rdquo;
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Direct Link to Maintenance Workbench */}
              <div>
                <Link
                  href={`/maintenance?search=${encodeURIComponent(workstation.label)}`}
                  target="_blank"
                  className="block"
                >
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="outline"
                    className="w-full h-9 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/10 hover:bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 font-bold text-xs gap-2 cursor-pointer shadow-xs transition-colors"
                  >
                    <Wrench className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-amber-400" />
                    <span>Open Maintenance Workbench</span>
                    <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3 ml-auto text-amber-400/70" />
                  </Button>
                </Link>
              </div>

              {/* Active Logged Database Tickets */}
              {activeIssues.length === 0 && !assistanceRequest ? (
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-10 text-center">
                  <div className="rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 p-4 text-emerald-400 mb-3">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="h-8 w-8" />
                  </div>
                  <h4 className="font-heading font-semibold text-white">All Diagnostics Normal</h4>
                  <p className="mt-1 max-w-xs text-xs text-slate-400">
                    No active faults or hardware defects reported for {workstation.label}.
                  </p>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setActiveTab('report')}
                    className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white shadow-lg transition-transform hover:bg-indigo-500 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <span>Report Problem</span>
                    <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : (
                activeIssues.map((issue) => (
                  <div
                    key={issue.id}
                    className="rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] p-4 shadow-sm space-y-3"
                  >
                    {/* Header */}
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                          {issue.category && (
                            <span
                              className="rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white shadow-sm"
                              style={{ backgroundColor: issue.category.color || '#6366F1' }}
                            >
                              {issue.category.name}
                            </span>
                          )}
                          <span
                            className={`rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${
                              issue.severity === 'critical'
                                ? 'bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30'
                                : issue.severity === 'high'
                                ? 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30'
                                : 'bg-slate-700/50 text-slate-300'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {issue.severity}
                          </span>
                          <span className="rounded-md bg-white/[0.05] px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-400 capitalize">
                            Status: {issue.status.replace('_', ' ')}
                          </span>

                          {/* Reporting Origin Attribution */}
                          {issue.source === 'student_terminal' ? (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-indigo-500/15 border border-indigo-500/30 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-300">
                              <User className="h-3 w-3" />
                              <span>Student Terminal {issue.student_roll ? `• Roll ${issue.student_roll}` : ''}</span>
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-white/[0.06] border border-white/5 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-400">
                              <Wrench className="h-3 w-3" />
                              <span>Faculty / In-Charge</span>
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <h4 className="font-heading font-semibold text-sm text-white pt-1">
                          {issue.title}
                        </h4>
                        {issue.student_name && (
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                            Reported by <strong className="text-slate-200">{issue.student_name}</strong> {issue.student_roll ? `(Roll ${issue.student_roll})` : ''}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Description */}
                    {issue.description && (
                      <p className="rounded-lg bg-black/30 p-2.5 text-xs text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
                        {issue.description}
                      </p>
                    )}

                    {/* Attached Evidence Photos */}
                    {issue.photos && issue.photos.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                          Photo Evidence ({issue.photos.length})
                        </p>
                        <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1">
                          {issue.photos.map((photo, i) => (
                            <a
                              key={i}
                              href={photo.url}
                              target="_blank"
                              rel="noreferrer"
                              className="group relative h-16 w-16 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-black/40"
                            >
                              <img
                                src={photo.thumbnailUrl || photo.url}
                                alt={`Evidence ${i + 1}`}
                                className="h-full w-full object-cover transition-transform group-hover:scale-110"
                              />
                            </a>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>

export function WorkstationMobileView({
  workstations,
  onSelectWorkstation,
  onToggleCanvasMode,
  isCanvasModeActive = false,
}: WorkstationMobileViewProps) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('')
  const [selectedFilter, setSelectedFilter] = useState<string>('all')

  // Extract unique rows dynamically
  const rowLabels = useMemo(() => {
    const rows = new Set<string>()
    workstations.forEach((w) => {
      if (w.row_label) rows.add(w.row_label)
    })
    return Array.from(rows).sort()
  }, [workstations])

  // Filtered workstations
  const filteredWorkstations = useMemo(() => {
    return workstations.filter((ws) => {
      // 1. Search Query
      if (searchQuery.trim()) {
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim()
        const matchLabel = ws.label.toLowerCase().includes(q)
        const matchRow = ws.row_label?.toLowerCase().includes(q)
        const matchIssue = ws.active_issues?.some((i) => i.title.toLowerCase().includes(q))
        if (!matchLabel && !matchRow && !matchIssue) return false
      }

      // 2. Chip Filter
      if (selectedFilter === 'issues') {
        return ws.open_issues_count > 0
      }
      if (selectedFilter === 'operational') {
        return ws.open_issues_count === 0
      }
      if (selectedFilter !== 'all') {
        return ws.row_label === selectedFilter
      }

      return true
    })
  }, [workstations, searchQuery, selectedFilter])

  const flaggedCount = workstations.filter((w) => w.open_issues_count > 0).length

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      {/* Mobile Control Strip: Search & Canvas Toggle */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <div className="relative flex-1">
          <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search PC (e.g. PC-04)..."
            className="w-full rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] pl-8 pr-3 py-2 text-xs text-white placeholder-slate-500 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
          />
          {searchQuery && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
              className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[10px] text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
            >
              Clear
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {onToggleCanvasMode && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onToggleCanvasMode}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
              isCanvasModeActive
                ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300'
                : 'border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            {isCanvasModeActive ? (
              <>
                <Layers className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                <span>Grid View</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Map className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                <span>Floor Map</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 scrollbar-none">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setSelectedFilter('all')}
          className={`flex-shrink-0 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
            selectedFilter === 'all'
              ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
              : 'border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
          }`}
        >

        {flaggedCount > 0 && (

            type="button"
            onClick={() => setSelectedFilter('issues')}
            className={`flex-shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
              selectedFilter === 'issues'

            }`}
          >
            <ShieldAlert className="h-3 w-3" />
            <span>Issues ({flaggedCount})</span>
          </button>
        )}

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setSelectedFilter('operational')}
          className={`flex-shrink-0 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
            selectedFilter === 'operational'

          }`}
        >
          Operational

        {rowLabels.map((row) => (

            onClick={() => setSelectedFilter(row)}
            className={`flex-shrink-0 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
              selectedFilter === row
                ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                : 'border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
            }`}
          >
            {row}

        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Visual Compact Matrix Grid (3 to 4 Columns) */}
      {filteredWorkstations.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] p-8 text-center">
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">No workstations match the selected filter.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5">
          {filteredWorkstations.map((ws) => {
            const isFlagged = ws.status === 'flagged'
            const isUnderRepair = ws.status === 'under_repair'
            const isTeacher = ws.row_label?.toLowerCase().includes('teacher') || ws.label.toLowerCase().includes('teacher')

            let borderStyle = 'border-slate-800 bg-[#151E32] hover:border-slate-600'
            let ledColor = 'bg-emerald-400 shadow-[0_0_6px_#34d399]'

            if (isFlagged) {
              if (ws.highest_severity === 'critical') {
                borderStyle = 'border-rose-500/80 bg-rose-950/20 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(244,63,94,0.25)]'
                ledColor = 'bg-rose-500 animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_8px_#f43f5e]'
              } else {
                borderStyle = 'border-amber-500/80 bg-amber-950/20 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(245,158,11,0.2)]'
                ledColor = 'bg-amber-400 shadow-[0_0_6px_#fbbf24]'
              }
            } else if (isUnderRepair) {
              borderStyle = 'border-blue-500/80 bg-blue-950/20 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(59,130,246,0.2)]'
              ledColor = 'bg-blue-400 animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_6px_#60a5fa]'

                className={`relative flex flex-col items-center justify-between rounded-xl border p-2 text-center transition-transform active:scale-95 ${borderStyle}`}

                {ws.open_issues_count > 0 && (

import React from 'react'
import {
  Monitor,
  Laptop,

import type { WorkstationWithIssues } from '@/types/workstations'
import type { WorkstationSeatAssignment } from '@/lib/types/seat-plans'

interface WorkstationNodeProps {
  workstation: WorkstationWithIssues & {
    assignment?: WorkstationSeatAssignment | null
    session_override?: {
      override_id: string
      student_name: string
      roll_number: number
      reason?: string | null
      photo_url?: string | null
    } | null
    isPresent?: boolean | null
  }
  isLayoutMode?: boolean
  isSeatPlanMode?: boolean
  isSelected?: boolean
  isDropTarget?: boolean
  isFocused?: boolean
  isAssistanceRequested?: boolean
  assistanceRequest?: {
    id: string
    title: string
    description?: string | null
    severity?: string
    studentName?: string | null
    studentRoll?: string | null
  } | null
  onAcknowledgeAssistance?: (id: string) => void
  density?: 'standard' | 'compact' | 'projector'
  terminalScale?: number
  isStandby?: boolean
  onClick?: () => void
  onDragStart?: (e: React.PointerEvent, ws: any) => void
  onDragOver?: (e: React.DragEvent) => void
  onDragLeave?: (e: React.DragEvent) => void
  onDrop?: (e: React.DragEvent, ws: any) => void
}

export function WorkstationNode({
  workstation,
  isLayoutMode = false,
  isSeatPlanMode = false,
  isSelected = false,
  isDropTarget = false,
  isFocused = false,
  isAssistanceRequested = false,
  assistanceRequest = null,
  onAcknowledgeAssistance,
  density = 'standard',
  terminalScale = 1,
  isStandby = false,
  onClick,
  onDragStart,
  onDragOver,
  onDragLeave,
  onDrop,
}: WorkstationNodeProps) {
  const isFlagged = workstation.status === 'flagged'
  const isUnderRepair = workstation.status === 'under_repair'
  const isTeacher =
    workstation.row_label?.toLowerCase().includes('teacher') ||
    workstation.label.toLowerCase().includes('teacher')

  const assignment = workstation.assignment
  const sessionOverride = workstation.session_override

  const hasUnresolvedIssues =
    Boolean(isAssistanceRequested) ||
    isFlagged ||
    (workstation.open_issues_count ?? 0) > 0 ||
    Boolean(workstation.active_issues && workstation.active_issues.some((i) => i.status !== 'resolved'))

  const unresolvedCount = Math.max(
    (workstation.open_issues_count || 0) + (isAssistanceRequested && (!workstation.open_issues_count || workstation.open_issues_count === 0) ? 1 : 0),
    workstation.active_issues?.filter((i) => i.status !== 'resolved').length || 0,
    isAssistanceRequested ? 1 : 0
  )

  // Status border, led, screen background, and persistent glowing aura
  let statusBorder = 'border-white/[0.08] group-hover:border-slate-500'
  let ledColor = 'bg-emerald-400 shadow-[0_0_8px_#34d399]'
  let screenBg = 'bg-gradient-to-b from-[#151E32] to-[#0B0F19]'
  let haloGlow = ''
  const isTemporary = Boolean((assignment as any)?.is_override || sessionOverride)

  if (hasUnresolvedIssues && !isUnderRepair) {
    // UNRESOLVED ISSUE INVARIANT: Persistent alert glow remains until issue is resolved or marked under servicing
    const isCritical =
      workstation.highest_severity === 'critical' ||
      assistanceRequest?.severity === 'critical' ||
      Boolean(workstation.active_issues?.some((i) => i.severity === 'critical' && i.status !== 'resolved'))
    statusBorder = isCritical
      ? 'border-rose-500/90 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(244,63,94,0.55)]'
      : 'border-amber-400/80 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(245,158,11,0.5)]'
    ledColor = isCritical
      ? 'bg-rose-500 animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_12px_#f43f5e]'
      : 'bg-amber-400 animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_12px_#fbbf24]'
    screenBg = isCritical
      ? 'bg-gradient-to-b from-rose-950/50 via-[#151E32] to-[#0B0F19]'
      : 'bg-gradient-to-b from-amber-950/40 via-[#151E32] to-[#0B0F19]'
    haloGlow = isCritical
      ? 'ring-2 ring-rose-500/70 shadow-[0_0_24px_rgba(244,63,94,0.45)] animate-pulse'
      : 'ring-2 ring-amber-400/60 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(245,158,11,0.4)] animate-pulse'
  } else if (isUnderRepair) {
    statusBorder = 'border-cyan-500/80 shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(6,182,212,0.4)]'
    ledColor = 'bg-cyan-400 animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_10px_#22d3ee]'
    screenBg = 'bg-gradient-to-b from-cyan-950/40 to-[#0B0F19]'
    haloGlow = 'ring-2 ring-cyan-500/50 shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(6,182,212,0.3)] animate-pulse'
  }

  // Attendance-specific halo ring in Live Mode (only applied when nominal and no unresolved issues)

'use client'

import React, { useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Camera, Image as ImageIcon, X, Loader2, ZoomIn } from 'lucide-react'
import { compressImage } from '@/lib/image-compression'
import type { WorkstationPhoto } from '@/types/workstations'

interface WorkstationPhotoCaptureProps {
  photos: WorkstationPhoto[]
  onChange: (photos: WorkstationPhoto[]) => void
  maxPhotos?: number
  disabled?: boolean
}

export function WorkstationPhotoCapture({
  photos,
  onChange,
  maxPhotos = 3,
  disabled = false,
}: WorkstationPhotoCaptureProps) {
  const cameraInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
  const [compressing, setCompressing] = useState(false)
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [lightboxUrl, setLightboxUrl] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const handleFiles = async (fileList: FileList | null) => {
    if (!fileList || fileList.length === 0) return
    if (photos.length >= maxPhotos) {
      setErrorMsg(`Maximum of ${maxPhotos} photos reached.`)
      return
    }

    setErrorMsg(null)
    setCompressing(true)

    try {
      const remainingSlots = maxPhotos - photos.length
      const filesToProcess = Array.from(fileList).slice(0, remainingSlots)
      const newPhotos: WorkstationPhoto[] = []

      for (const file of filesToProcess) {
        // Compress using client-side canvas utility
        const result = await compressImage(file, {
          maxDimension: 1200,
          quality: 0.72,
          maxFileSize: 2 * 1024 * 1024,
        })

        // Convert blob to base64 data URL for direct jsonb persistence
        const base64Url = await new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
          const reader = new FileReader()
          reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string)
          reader.onerror = reject
          reader.readAsDataURL(result.file)
        })

        newPhotos.push({
          url: base64Url,
          name: result.file.name,
          size: result.compressedSize,
          thumbnailUrl: base64Url,
        })
      }

      onChange([...photos, ...newPhotos])
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to compress image'
      setErrorMsg(msg)
    } finally {
      setCompressing(false)
      // Reset inputs so user can pick the same file again if desired
      if (cameraInputRef.current) cameraInputRef.current.value = ''
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = ''
    }
  }

  const removePhoto = (index: number) => {
    const updated = photos.filter((_, i) => i !== index)
    onChange(updated)
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <label className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
          Photo Evidence (Optional, Max {maxPhotos})
        </label>
        <span className="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-slate-500">
          {photos.length} / {maxPhotos}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Hidden Native Inputs */}
      <input
        ref={cameraInputRef}
        type="file"
        accept="image/*"
        capture="environment"
        className="hidden"
        disabled={disabled || compressing || photos.length >= maxPhotos}
        onChange={(e) => handleFiles(e.target.files)}
      />
      <input
        ref={fileInputRef}
        type="file"
        accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
        multiple
        className="hidden"
        disabled={disabled || compressing || photos.length >= maxPhotos}
        onChange={(e) => handleFiles(e.target.files)}
      />

      {/* Action Buttons */}
      {photos.length < maxPhotos && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          {/* Mobile Camera Button */}
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={disabled || compressing}
            onClick={() => cameraInputRef.current?.click()}
            className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-indigo-500/40 bg-indigo-500/5 px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-300 transition-colors hover:border-indigo-500/80 hover:bg-indigo-500/10 active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {compressing ? (
              <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-indigo-400" />
            ) : (
              <Camera className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-400" />
            )}
            <span>Snap Camera</span>
          </button>

          {/* Gallery / File Picker */}
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={disabled || compressing}
            onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
            className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-700 bg-slate-900/60 px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 transition-colors hover:border-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-800 active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <ImageIcon className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-400" />
            <span>Upload File</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Error Notice */}
      {errorMsg && (
        <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-400">{errorMsg}</p>
      )}

      {/* Preview Grid */}
      {photos.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-1">
          {photos.map((photo, idx) => (
            <div
              key={idx}
              className="group relative aspect-video overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-slate-700 bg-slate-950"
            >
              {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
              <img
                src={photo.url}
                alt={photo.name || `Evidence ${idx + 1}`}
                className="h-full w-full object-cover transition-transform group-hover:scale-105"
              />

              {/* View / Zoom Overlay */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setLightboxUrl(photo.url)}
                className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"
              >
                <ZoomIn className="h-4 w-4 text-white drop-shadow" />
              </button>

              {/* Remove Button */}
              {!disabled && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation()
                    removePhoto(idx)
                  }}
                  className="absolute right-1 top-1 rounded-full bg-black/75 p-1 text-slate-300 backdrop-blur-sm transition-colors hover:bg-rose-600 hover:text-white"
                  title="Remove photo"
                >
                  <X className="h-3 w-3" />
                </button>
              )}

              {/* Size Badge */}
              {photo.size && (
                <div className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-1 left-1 rounded bg-black/70 px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-mono text-slate-300">
                  {(photo.size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Simple Lightbox Modal */}
      {lightboxUrl && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm"
          onClick={() => setLightboxUrl(null)}
        >
          <div className="relative max-h-[90vh] max-w-[90vw]">
            {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
            <img
              src={lightboxUrl}
              alt="Evidence Full View"
              className="max-h-[85vh] max-w-[88vw] rounded-xl object-contain shadow-2xl"
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setLightboxUrl(null)}
              className="absolute -right-3 -top-3 rounded-full bg-slate-800 p-2 text-white shadow-lg hover:bg-slate-700"
            >
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
